jobs.title: Analog Design Engineer (Graduate)
jobs.excerpt: THE COMPANY Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions.
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Analog Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design of high-performance serial links and data converters for our chiplet solutions. Working alongside experienced analog designers, you will help design, simulate and verify ADC, DAC, RX, TX and PLL building blocks on advanced FinFET technology nodes, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in analog circuit design who want to learn fast through deep, hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Analog & Mixed-Signal Block Design: Design and optimise sub-blocks of ADC, DAC, RX, TX and PLL circuits (e.g. amplifiers, comparators, bias circuits, references, clock buffers) under the guidance of senior designers.
  • Simulation and Validation: Run transistor-level simulations (DC, AC, transient, noise, Monte Carlo and PVT corners) and mixed-signal verification using Cadence, AMS and SystemVerilog to confirm robust performance across operating conditions.
  • Performance Optimisation: Learn and apply design techniques to improve key parameters such as gain, bandwidth, linearity, noise, jitter, power consumption and speed.
  • Layout Collaboration: Work closely with layout engineers to communicate matching, symmetry and parasitic-sensitive nets, and run post-layout extracted simulations to close the design.
  • Modelling & Scripting: Build behavioural models (e.g. Verilog-A) and scripts (e.g. Python, SKILL or OCEAN) to speed up simulation, analysis and design-check flows.
  • Silicon Characterization Support: Help prepare test plans and support lab characterisation and debug of silicon as projects progress.
  • Design Documentation: Document your designs, simulation results and design-review material clearly, supporting efficient knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Technology Awareness: Keep learning about advances in high-speed SerDes, data converters and chiplet interfaces such as UCIe.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a related field, with a focus on analog/mixed-signal circuit design (recent graduates and those graduating within the next 6 months are welcome)
  • 0–2 years of industry experience, including internships, placements or research projects
  • Strong grasp of analog fundamentals: CMOS device physics, small-signal analysis, feedback and stability, noise, and mismatch
  • Hands-on circuit design and simulation experience with Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre or similar tools, through coursework, thesis or internship projects
  • Understanding of at least one of: data converters (ADC/DAC), PLLs/clocking, or high-speed TX/RX circuits
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail
Nice-to-have:
  • Thesis, research or internship work on FinFET or other advanced-node technologies
  • A completed tape-out and/or lab measurement experience
  • Familiarity with Verilog/SystemVerilog, Verilog-A or AMS modelling
  • Scripting experience (Python, MATLAB, SKILL or shell) and comfort in a Linux environment
  • Publications or conference contributions in circuits (e.g. ISSCC, VLSI, CICC, ESSCIRC)

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset, open to learning from design reviews
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star:We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely:We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact:Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn’t disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work:We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we’ll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real analog IP used in customer silicon
  • Supportive team culture – a dedicated manager and a team of colleagues ready to help
  • Competitive, transparent compensation– adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview(90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. HR & Culture Call (45 min)–values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  5. Offer & Next Steps– we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.
Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

Location: Barcelona, Spain / Eastern Europe / Remote (for those countries only)

Crisalix is looking for a hands-on, technically capable individual who is confident using modern AI tools and can apply them to solve real business challenges.
This is not a research role or a theoretical AI position. The focus is on using current AI technologies, automation platforms and programming skills to quickly develop practical applications, prototypes and working solutions that improve internal workflows and business efficiency.
The role involves working closely with colleagues across different departments to understand business needs and turn ideas into functioning solutions.
While speed and creativity are important, we also value technical quality. Applications should not only work but also be well-structured, reliable and maintainable so they can be improved or developed further.
What the role involves
  • Participating in internal discussions to understand business problems and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Building rapid prototypes using AI tools, programming and automation platforms.
  • Developing internal applications, AI assistants and automated workflows.
  • Connecting different tools and business systems through APIs and integrations.
  • Reviewing, debugging and improving code, including AI-generated code.
  • Testing solutions, gathering feedback and making improvements.
  • Ensuring applications are properly structured, documented and maintainable.
  • Preparing prototypes that can be handed over to developers for further development or production.
  • Identifying opportunities where AI can improve efficiency and automate manual processes.
The expectation is that candidates can move quickly from concept to working prototype while understanding the technology behind what they build.

our ideal candidate would have:

We are looking for someone who is already comfortable working with modern AI tools and automation platforms. This is not an internship designed to teach someone AI from scratch.

Candidates should be practical, technically curious and capable of building applications rather than simply discussing ideas.
Importantly, we are looking for someone with enough programming knowledge to understand, troubleshoot and improve the code behind their solutions, including code generated with AI assistance.
Ideally, candidates will have experience with:
  • Modern AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Grok, Microsoft Copilot and OpenAI APIs / GPT Agents.
  • Prompt engineering and developing structured AI workflows.
  • Automation platforms such as Zapier, Jotform, Make, n8n, Airtable Automations, Pipedream, Retool, Bubble and Flowise.
  • Basic-to-intermediate programming skills, preferably Python and/or JavaScript.
  • Understanding and improving AI-generated code rather than relying entirely on AI to produce working solutions.
  • Connecting applications through APIs, webhooks and integrations.
  • Low-code or no-code development environments.
  • Basic software development principles, including clean code, debugging, testing and documentation.
  • Rapid prototyping, testing and improving applications based on feedback.
Essential requirements
  • Practical experience building AI-powered applications, automations or workflows.
  • A good understanding of at least one programming language.
  • Strong spoken and written English, allowing effective communication within an international team.
  • The ability to work independently and solve technical problems.
  • Availability for a minimum of 3 months, ideally 6 months.
We are not looking for an experienced software engineer, but candidates should have sufficient technical knowledge to build solutions that can be understood, maintained and improved by others.

we also value very positively:

Additional qualities

  • Sharp, analytical thinking and the ability to understand new problems quickly.
  • Strong business understanding, ideally with a background or interest in business operations.
  • A genuine passion for AI and regularly experimenting with new technologies, tools and integrations.
  • A hands-on mindset and the ability to turn ideas into practical solutions quickly.
  • Experience with Git, version control or collaborative development.
  • The ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non-technical colleagues.
  • Good organisational skills, attention to detail and a willingness to learn from feedback.
  • Previous personal, academic or professional projects demonstrating practical AI or programming experience.
A strong interest in business operations and efficiency is important. Understanding how companies work and identifying where technology can make a meaningful difference is just as valuable as technical curiosity.
What this internship offers
  • The opportunity to work on real internal AI and automation initiatives.
  • Direct exposure to business operations and product development.
  • Hands-on experience creating applications that can have a measurable impact.
  • An international working environment with collaboration across departments.
  • The opportunity to explore and experiment with modern AI technologies.
  • A fast-moving environment where ideas can quickly become working solutions.
  • The possibility of continuing in a full-time role depending on performance and company needs.
Locations

Our preferred locations are:

  • Barcelona, Spain (preferred).
  • Other locations within Spain.
  • Eastern Europe
    NB: Please only apply if you are in one of the locations listed above (even for a remote role)
Duration
The minimum internship duration is 3 months, although a 6-month commitment is strongly preferred to allow sufficient time to develop, implement and evaluate the results of AI initiatives.
Compensation
This is a paid internship with a monthly stipend depending on location.
How to apply
Please submit your CV in English, together with a short description of AI tools, automations or applications you have already built. Links to GitHub repositories, project demonstrations or examples of your work are particularly welcome.
To strengthen your application, we also encourage you to include a short video introduction (1–2 minutes) in English, explaining:
  • The AI tools and technologies you regularly use.
  • Examples of automations, applications or prototypes you have developed.
  • Your personal contribution to these projects and the programming skills you used.

This helps us better understand your communication skills, technical experience and how you approach practical challenges.

jobs.excerpt: Position Title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer Location: Remote (In the U.
jobs.description:
Position Title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
Location: Remote (In the U.S)

Other Considerations: U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Required)

POSITION SUMMARY

Sprezzatura is seeking a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to serve as the technical security engineering lead supporting cybersecurity modernization for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA).

The Senior DevSecOps Engineer will lead hands-on engineering efforts to identify and remediate security and control deficiencies across the platform's cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, shared platform services, and supporting systems. This position will help move the Platform toward a modern, engineering-first approach to cybersecurity by translating security requirements and identified control gaps into durable technical solutions.

This role will work closely with security and RMF personnel to translate control deficiencies, vulnerabilities, assessment findings, and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) into actionable engineering work. The Senior DevSecOps Engineer will then lead or directly implement remediation through infrastructure, configuration, access policy, system rules, pipeline, and code changes.

The ideal candidate combines deep cloud and DevSecOps engineering experience with a strong understanding of cybersecurity, vulnerability remediation, secure software delivery, and federal security requirements. This individual should be comfortable operating as both a hands-on senior engineer and technical security SME in a complex, large-scale cloud environment.

This position will participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the team's senior technical security engineering lead and Security Engineering Subject Matter Expert (SME)
  • Lead hands-on remediation of security vulnerabilities, control deficiencies, and technical security debt across platform infrastructure and shared services
  • Translate security control requirements, assessment findings, vulnerabilities, and POA&Ms into actionable engineering solutions
  • Implement security remediation through code, infrastructure, configuration, system rules, access policies, and other technical changes
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated security quality gates within GitHub Actions and platform CI/CD pipelines
  • Integrate and improve capabilities including SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), secrets detection, dependency scanning, and other automated security checks
  • Develop and maintain secure configuration baselines for cloud infrastructure and Platform components
  • Implement and improve centralized secrets management and secure credential-handling practices
  • Lead vulnerability remediation efforts across AWS infrastructure, containers, applications, dependencies, CI/CD pipelines, and shared Platform components
  • Provision, secure, and sustain resilient CI/CD runner infrastructure within VA cloud environments
  • Implement automation supporting patching, vulnerability remediation, and security configuration management
  • Improve security logging, monitoring, and alerting capabilities to support timely detection and response to security events
  • Integrate Platform systems with security monitoring and telemetry capabilities, including applicable CSOC and continuous-monitoring requirements
  • Configure and improve cloud-native security capabilities such as AWS GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub CSPM, and related AWS security services
  • Lead or support technical implementation associated with DAST/WASA, SAST, secrets detection, and runtime security
  • Partner with RMF and security personnel to determine appropriate technical remediation for NIST SP 800-53 control deficiencies
  • Partner with the Security Automation Engineer to ensure implemented controls generate reliable security evidence and measurable security posture data
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to VA.gov product and engineering teams implementing security requirements
  • Lead technical planning and requirements definition when remediation requires coordination across multiple systems or engineering teams
  • Document implemented security controls, technical remediation, architecture decisions, and operational procedures necessary to sustain improvements
  • Participate in technical reviews, incident response, troubleshooting, and a 24/7 engineering on-call rotation as required

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Significant hands-on experience in DevSecOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or security engineering
  • Advanced experience with AWS, preferably including experience supporting complex production cloud environments
  • Strong experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitHub Actions
  • Experience implementing security controls through infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, automation, or software development
  • Experience with vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation, and validation
  • Experience implementing or operating application and infrastructure security tooling, including SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, container scanning, or comparable capabilities
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management technologies
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security, IAM, secrets management, network security, logging, monitoring, and secure configuration practices
  • Experience working with containerized workloads and modern cloud-native architectures
  • Proficiency with one or more scripting or programming languages used for infrastructure and security automation
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex production infrastructure and security issues across multiple layers of a technology stack
  • Ability to communicate technical security risks and remediation approaches to engineering, security, product, and program stakeholders
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the background investigation and access required to support Department of Veterans Affairs systems
  • Ability to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting federal systems operating under the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF)
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security controls and experience translating control requirements into technical implementations
  • Experience supporting systems operating at FISMA Moderate or High impact levels.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or VA Enterprise Cloud (VAEC) environments
  • Experience with AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, IAM, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, or comparable cloud security capabilities
  • Experience developing or maintaining GitHub Actions runners and secure CI/CD execution infrastructure
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and container security
  • Experience with Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and software supply-chain security
  • Experience with continuous monitoring, security telemetry, or integration with enterprise security operations capabilities
  • Experience remediating findings resulting from security assessments, vulnerability scans, penetration testing, WASA/DAST, or similar activities
  • Familiarity with federal ATO processes, POA&Ms, control implementation evidence, and independent controls assessments
  • Experience serving as a technical lead or SME responsible for coordinating security engineering work across multiple teams

WORKING CONDITIONS

Standard Business hours are Monday through Friday. Occasional extended or weekend hours may be required based on operational needs. Travel may be required from time to time for customer meeting and industry events.

PAY RANGE

The base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $170,000 annually, depending on geographic work location, relevant experience, skills, education, internal equity, security clearance, and contract requirements. Geographic salary ranges are determined in accordance with the company's compensation practices and represent a good-faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting.

BENEFITS

Sprezzatura offers a comprehensive and flexible benefit package to include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Health Saving Account (when enrolled in eligible plan) with Company contribution
  • Company paid Life, Accidental Death, Short-term & Long-term Disability
  • Voluntary Accident, Hospital Indemnity, & Critical Care Insurance
  • Voluntary Medical & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Accrued Paid Time Off & Company Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company match

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Sprezzatura participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Sprezzaturais a mission-driven, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that thrives at the intersection of technology, innovation, and impact. We specialize in secure, scalable, and human-centered digital solutions that accelerate government transformation. Our work spans DevSecOps, health IT modernization, intelligent automation, benefits delivery, and digital communications. We partner with agencies ready to evolve—delivering not just strategy, but measurable execution. Rooted in operational excellence and driven by curiosity, we help our clients navigate complexity with clarity—turning ambitious ideas into real-world outcomes. No buzzwords. Just impact.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENT

This position may require Public Trust clearance. Candidates must undergo a background investigation, including a review of employment history, education, criminal record, and financial history. The clearance process ensures that the candidate is reliable, trustworthy, and of good conduct and character. Employment offers are contingent upon successful passing a public trust clearance process.

EEO STATEMENT

Sprezzatura is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Applicants have the right to discuss, disclose, or inquire about compensation without retaliation. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

This job description is not intended to be an employment contract and does not guarantee employment for any specific duration.

jobs.excerpt: How will you make a difference to PMI?  We are looking for a Creator & Social Video Producer to develop engaging, social-first content across PMI’s organic and paid social channels.
jobs.description:
How will you make a difference to PMI? We are looking for a Creator & Social Video Producer to develop engaging, social-first content across PMI’s organic and paid social channels. This hands-on role will partner closely with the Manager, Social Media to build and grow a strong user-generated content (UGC) pillar while bringing PMI’s brand and stories to life through compelling, platform-native content. You’ll own the creative process from concept to delivery, including concepting, scripting, capturing, editing, writing, and versioning video, photography, motion, and static assets. We’re looking for someone with strong production skills, sharp brand judgment, and a deep understanding of social platforms, trends, and audience behaviors who can turn briefs, insights, and real-time moments into timely, relevant content. You’ll also support content capture at PMI events, partnering with internal stakeholders to plan coverage, identify engaging moments, and quickly deliver polished, channel-ready assets.

What you’ll bring to the role:

Own the end-to-end development of trend-led and UGC-style social content, including ideation, research, scripting, storyboarding, shot planning, production, on-camera participation, editing, caption writing, versioning, exporting, and final delivery. Concept, film, photograph, and edit high-quality short-form video and visual content using both mobile devices and professional camera equipment, selecting the production approach that best fits the story, platform, timeline, and audience. Serve as a primary on-site content creator at PMI's premier events, capturing keynote moments, attendee experiences, behind-the-scenes stories, executive and subject matter expert interviews, community perspectives, and other real-time brand storytelling opportunities. Plan event coverage in close partnership with stakeholders and cross-team partners — developing content concepts, shot lists, interview prompts, schedules, equipment plans, and rapid-turn workflows — and publish or deliver timely content during and immediately following events. Create platform-native content for TikTok, Instagram Reels and Stories, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, Facebook, and emerging channels, adapting hooks, pacing, framing, audio, text treatments, aspect ratios, duration, and calls to action for each placement. Write and refine captions, headlines, scripts, interview questions, on-screen text, and calls to action in PMI's brand voice, ensuring content is clear, inclusive, accessible, and aligned with campaign and business objectives. Create, adapt, and export branded graphics, thumbnails, title cards, motion elements, and other visual assets using approved templates and brand systems; repurpose existing footage and design assets into new social-first executions. Monitor platform culture, audience behaviors, emerging creators, sounds, formats, visual styles, and cultural moments; identify relevant opportunities early and rapidly translate them into original, brand-appropriate concepts for the UGC-focused content pillar. Monitor content performance across the trends and UGC pillar and apply optimization insights — hooks, formats, pacing, creative approach — to continually improve results. Build repeatable content series and maintain an always-on pipeline that balances planned campaigns, educational storytelling, community content, event coverage, and timely trend-led opportunities. Partner with the Manager, Social Media and the broader Social team, along with cross-functional marketing stakeholders such as Creative, Brand, Product Marketing, Events, and Communications, to translate briefs and larger campaign ideas into effective social-first executions. Apply performance data, audience feedback, testing, and creative insights to strengthen hooks, retention, watch time, engagement, and other campaign outcomes; document learnings and use them to improve future content. Organize and maintain footage, project files, releases, selects, templates, and final assets using established naming, storage, rights-management, and archival practices. Manage multiple productions and rapid-turn assignments simultaneously, communicate status and risks, respond constructively to feedback, and deliver accurate, brand-safe work on deadline. Use AI-powered creative tools and modern production workflows responsibly to support ideation, transcription, captioning, editing, versioning, and efficiency while maintaining human accountability for accuracy, originality, rights, and final quality.

Role Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, film/video production, journalism, design, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 5-7 years of experience creating social-first content, short-form video, digital storytelling, or related creative work for a brand, agency, publisher, or creator-led organization. A portfolio or reel demonstrating personally created work across concepting, shooting, on-camera storytelling, editing, writing, and final delivery is required. Demonstrated experience capturing live events, interviews, behind-the-scenes content, and rapid-turn social assets in dynamic, high-visibility environments. Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and external production or agency partners while independently owning day-to-day content creation. Creator-first mindset with strong instincts for concepts, hooks, pacing, visual composition, and concise social storytelling; comfortable both behind and in front of the camera. Proficiency with mobile and professional video production and editing — camera operation, lighting, audio capture, CapCut, and at least one professional non-linear editing platform such as Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro. Ability to create, resize, and export brand-aligned static and motion graphics using tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or Canva. Deep platform fluency across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, and emerging channels — native formats, audience expectations, and publishing best practices. Strong writing skills, with the ability to distinguish fleeting trends from durable audience behaviors and translate both into clear, brand-appropriate content. Working knowledge of content performance metrics and brand/visual systems, with the ability to convert insights into specific creative improvements. Strong organization and production-planning skills — able to work independently, manage multiple deadlines, and make sound decisions in live event settings. Comfortable using AI tools to improve creative efficiency while maintaining accountability for accuracy, brand alignment, and final quality. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). Up to 25%, including multi-day domestic and international events; evening and weekend availability may be required during event coverage.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $250k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role will be fully remote, based anywhere in the Pacific Northwest

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara.

In this role you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within your territory
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Strategically outbound prospect
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Minimum of 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience selling full-cycle sales into complex environments (preferably within Public Sector - Local Gov, K-12, High Education)
  • Must have a strong track record of overachievement to quota
  • Cold calling, generating outreach, building relationships excites you
  • Solid understanding of SFDC and accurate forecasting methodology
  • Must be able to travel up to twice per quarter for onsites

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Experience public speaking in front of executive level personas
  • Passion in closing large, complex deals

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

About CoVet

At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

What you'll do

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst / CRO to own marketing analytics, reporting and conversion rate optimisation at CoVet. You will report to the Product Marketing Manager and work closely with the performance marketing, lifecycle and product teams.

This is a hands-on role for an analyst who enjoys both the data and the decisions it drives. You will build reliable reporting, find where the funnel leaks, and run the tests that improve conversion from first visit to first record to paying subscription.

You will:

  • own marketing reporting and dashboards, so teams can see funnel performance by market, channel and source
  • analyse the full funnel from visit to sign-up, activation, subscription and retention, and find where conversion is lost
  • design, run and read A/B and multivariate tests on landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding and email
  • improve attribution and measurement across paid channels, the website and the CRM
  • build and maintain cost, conversion and cohort analyses by market, replacing estimates with measured figures
  • turn findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for marketing, product and leadership

Cross-functional collaboration

This role will work closely with:

  • Product Marketing: to improve activation and onboarding, and to prioritise conversion work
  • Performance Marketing and Lifecycle: to measure channels and campaigns, and to design tests
  • Product and Engineering: to instrument events, ship experiments and understand in-app behaviour
  • RevOps, Sales and Enterprise: to align on lead and pipeline definitions and CRM data
  • Leadership: to supply the numbers behind planning and board reporting

What success looks like

In this role, success means conversion improves at every stage of the funnel, and the business can see why. It means reporting people trust, tests that give clear answers, and decisions made faster because the data is ready.

You should expect to be measured on conversion and activation gains, the number and quality of tests run, the reliability of reporting, and the impact of your recommendations.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is:

  • an experienced analyst in a marketing, growth or product analytics role
  • strong in SQL, and comfortable working in a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery

  • HubSpot or another CRM as a reporting source
  • Python or R for analysis

Why this role matters

This role gives CoVet clear visibility of what drives growth. Every point of conversion this role recovers means more customers from the same spend, and faster, more confident decisions across marketing.

  • Competitive compensation

jobs.description:
Job Title: Scrum Master

Term: 12 months

Location: Nairobi, Kenya

Reports to: Technical Program Manager

Level: Intermediate/ Senior (4-8 years of relevant experience).

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate and coordinate Scrum ceremonies (Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Retrospective) with clear agendas, time-boxing, and documented outcomes (decisions, risks, actions, owners, due dates).
  • Own and maintain the team's delivery metrics dashboard (sprint velocity, burndown/burnup, defect rates, cycle time, cumulative flow), surfacing trends and escalating concerns to the TPM.
  • Actively identify, track, and remove constraints blocking squad members from delivering sprint goals; escalate cross-organizational blockers to the TPM within agreed SLAs.
  • Coach squad members and relevant stakeholders on agile principles, Scrum practices, and delivery best practices, progressively building internal agile capability.
  • Facilitate cross-squad coordination where multiple technical work streams (Backend, Frontend, API, Data) have interdependent sprint commitments.
  • Support knowledge transfer by ensuring that process documentation, decision logs, and sprint artefacts are maintained in the agreed shared workspace.
  • Report on delivery health metrics at fortnightly steering cadence, partnering with the TPM for programme-level reporting.

Measurable Outcomes & Deliverables

First 30 Days

  • Attend all Scrum ceremonies and produce baseline assessment of ceremony health, compliance, and documentation gaps.
  • Own the delivery metrics dashboard and report on velocity, burndown, defect rates, and cycle time and report any present gaps.
  • Produce a cross-squad dependency register across Backend, Frontend, API, and Data workstreams.
  • Confirm fortnightly steering cadence with the TPM and key stakeholders.

Days 31–60

  • Sprint velocity stabilizing; at least two consecutive sprints with 80% sprint goal achievement.
  • DoD compliance rate tracked and reported; 90% of completed stories meet DoD criteria.
  • Backlog health confirmed: two sprints of stories refined and sprint-ready at all times.
  • At least one agile coaching session delivered to client counterparts or junior squad members.
  • Delivery metrics dashboard live and shared with TPM and stakeholders.

Days 61–90

  • Retrospective improvement actions tracked; demonstrable improvement in at least two delivery metrics since sprint 1.
  • Agile maturity assessment (informal) of squad completed; coaching plan for remaining engagement period produced.
  • All sprint ceremonies running to time and rated as useful by squad members (informal pulse check).
  • Knowledge transfer - one squad member or stakeholder who has visibly adopted improved Scrum practices through coaching

Ongoing KPIs

  • Enable the squad to consistently achieve agreed sprint goals through effective planning and execution.
  • Ensure stories meet the agreed Definition of Done before acceptance.
  • Proactively identify, escalate, and facilitate resolution of delivery blockers and dependencies.
  • Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog that supports upcoming sprint planning and delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement by facilitating effective sprint ceremonies and retrospectives and ensuring agreed improvement actions are followed through.

Stakeholders & Ways of Working

Agile Ceremonies Owned: Sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement.

Reporting Cadence:

  • Fortnightly delivery health summary to TPM.
  • Sprint metrics dashboard updated at end of each sprint.
  • Ad-hoc impediment escalation to TPM as required.

Cross-Functional Touchpoints:

  • All squad roles (API Engineer, Backend, Frontend, Data Scientist, UI/UX Designer).
  • Product Owners and stakeholders attending sprint reviews.
  • TPM for programme-level dependency and risk alignment.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–8 years of experience in Scrum Master or agile delivery roles, with at least 2 years in technology delivery environments.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification required.
  • Proven ability to facilitate agile ceremonies for cross-functional technical teams, including engineers, data scientists, and designers.
  • Experience tracking and improving delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, burndown, DoD compliance).
  • Strong coaching and facilitation skills; ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and remove impediments at both team and organizational level.
  • Experience working in embedded client-side or consulting delivery contexts preferred.
  • Familiarity with backlog management tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent).
  • Understanding software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, integration, and release processes.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SAFe Agilist or equivalent scaled agile certification.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or mobile money delivery environments.
  • Familiarity with Kanban or hybrid Scrum/Kanban delivery models.
  • Prior experience embedding within a client organisation in a consulting or secondment capacity.
  • Experience facilitating agile transformations or team capability-building programmes.
  • Exposure to API integration, backend, or data science delivery workstreams.

Tools & Technologies

  • Backlog and sprint management: Jira / Azure DevOps / equivalent
  • Documentation and knowledge base: Confluence / SharePoint
  • Communication: Microsoft Teams
  • Metrics and reporting: Jira dashboards / Excel / Azure DevOps dashboards

jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.
Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How We Support You:
  • Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting
  • Paid leave for all new parents
  • Learning & Development stipend for employees
  • Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays + Winter Break (3 Days) + Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) + Floating Holiday (1 Day)
  • Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0-1 years of employment + 20 days for 1-3 years of employment
  • Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!
Come As You Are!
In Tandem provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Job Title: Senior Health Data Operations Analyst - Compass

Job Location: New York City, NY

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Health Data Analyst, you will focus on analyzing health data within the Veeva Compass product suite. Veeva Compass delivers record-level prescription and medical claims data to power longitudinal, de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases—including patient journey, market landscape, and provider engagement.
You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and standardization within the Terminology Reference Library (TRL) by managing reference data for key attributes found across prescription and medical claims—including drug information, ICD-10 diagnosis codes, procedure and lab codes, as well as payer and plan data. In this role, you will query prescription and medical claims datasets to support the evaluation and integration of new inbound data sources into core schemas. Additionally, you will define and track key quality metrics via interactive dashboards, contributing to technical documentation and validation reports to ensure our reference data remains accurate, scalable, and seamlessly integrated across all Veeva products.

What You’ll Do

    • Drive TRL Governance: Maintain and expand the Terminology Reference Library (TRL), managing core reference datasets across prescription and medical claims (including drug information, ICD-10 codes, procedure/lab codes, and payer/plan data).
    • Evaluate & Integrate New Data: Conduct deep-dive data querying, field mapping, and structural analysis on potential new data sources to evaluate fit and integrate them into existing core schemas.
    • Execute Quality & Cleansing Workflows: Perform exploratory data analysis to identify discrepancies, handle missing values, execute deduplication, and ensure data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
    • Continuous Product Improvement: Investigate data anomalies within the Veeva Compass product suite, testing both planned and unplanned data changes to assess downstream customer impact.
    • Build Metrics & Documentation: Develop interactive dashboards to track key data quality metrics, contributing to technical documentation, validation reports, and team process improvements.
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Developers to articulate data quality nuances, uncover root causes, and build robust data pipelines.

Requirements

    • 4+ years of experience analyzing record-level prescription and medical claims datasets.
    • 4+ years of experience in health data quality analysis, data profiling, and data governance principles.
    • Advanced SQL proficiency, with extensive experience querying, manipulating, and aggregating large-scale relational databases.
    • Deep working knowledge of healthcare code sets and industry standards, including NDC, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, LOINC, and payer/plan reference data.
    • Proven track record in data storytelling: Experience analyzing, visualizing, and demonstrating data quality findings to stakeholders using Excel, BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma), or interactive dashboards.
    • Strong problem-solving mindset: Eagerness to dive deep into complex, unstructured healthcare data issues, identify root causes, and propose innovative solutions.
    • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM, quantitative, or healthcare informatics field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

    • Experience in Python
    • Experience with the BI tool Sigma
    • Experience in life science industry

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Job Title: Manager - Veeva Batch Release Strategy - Europe

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Batch Release helps life sciences companies modernize the decision to release a batch by connecting the quality, manufacturing, laboratory, document, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) information needed for disposition. In this European Strategy role, you will work with customers, partners, and Veeva teams to shape how the market understands and adopts the application. This is a highly customer-facing role for someone who combines regulated-manufacturing knowledge with experience turning complex processes into practical software, services, and field strategies.

What You'll Do

    • Lead strategic discovery with European life sciences customers to understand their batch-disposition process, systems landscape, release bottlenecks, stakeholder model, and business case for change
    • Work with account teams to advance priority customers from working-level interest to senior-sponsored engagement and a clear next step
    • Act as the European domain lead, helping Sales, Strategy, Solution Consulting, Services, Product, Marketing, and partners understand how quality, manufacturing, laboratory, document, and ERP processes come together in release
    • Turn customer, partner, and market learning into clear product, services, implementation, and field recommendations
    • Build reusable European enablement, including discovery guides, stakeholder maps, account-entry plays, and positioning across ERP, manufacturing execution, laboratory, quality, and document systems
    • Develop relationships with systems integrators, consultancies, advisory partners, and industry organizations, and represent Veeva in customer meetings, executive discussions, webinars, and industry events

Requirements

    • 10+ years of combined experience in life sciences manufacturing, quality, or related enterprise software and consulting
    • Direct working knowledge of batch disposition or release and the regulated manufacturing evidence and stakeholders behind the decision
    • Experience translating manufacturing or quality processes into customer-facing software, consulting, implementation, or transformation programs
    • Senior customer-facing experience in strategy, solution consulting, implementation advisory, enterprise software, or management consulting
    • The judgment and presence to lead substantive conversations with Quality, Manufacturing, Qualified Person or release, IT, and executive stakeholders
    • Working knowledge of SAP or another ERP platform and several of manufacturing execution, laboratory, quality, document, and integration systems
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex processes into clear recommendations and reusable field material
    • Ability to travel within Europe and occasionally globally for customer meetings, internal workshops, and industry events

Nice to Have

    • Direct responsibility for batch disposition, Qualified Person certification, or release-process ownership
    • Experience with SAP Batch Release Hub, TrackWise, Veeva Vault Quality, or comparable manufacturing and quality platforms
    • Relationships with European systems integrators, consultancies, advisory firms, or organizations such as ISPE; or experience with external or contract manufacturing networks where release evidence crosses company and system boundaries

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Work Anywhere
    • Flexible paid time off
    • An annual budget for health and wellness programs

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 75,000 - 140,000 EUR

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Team

This emerging team will report into a Product Specialist - Sales Director and consist of specialist sellers aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with Samsara Connected Maintenance, and will be incentivized on growth targets across a single AVP org. Sellers will drive growth through strategic, high-value deal execution; establishing the business case for emerging products at flagship reference customers; and cross-functionally partnering to establish the infrastructure and resources for other AEs across the segment to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a public utility. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pilot strategy and success metrics for early adoption
  • Own executive-level discovery and storytelling for emerging SKUs
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and shape roadmap
  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Drive Maintenance sales cycles end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Build frameworks, assets, and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle enterprise solution sales
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $500k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders in SLED/Government entities
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability thriving in a dynamic, fast paced environment
  • Clear, confident communicator with strong customer instincts
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit and ability to lead through influence

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Ability to operate in strategic partnership with senior AEs and account teams

Job Title: Sr. Advisor, Molecular Pharmacology – Neuroscience

Job Location: Remote, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Overview:

Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company,is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as aGreat Place to Work® in 2026.

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, collaborative, and scientifically rigorous contributor (at the Associate Director level) to provide scientific leadership for molecular pharmacology activities supporting neuroscience discovery and development programs. The successful candidate will bring a strong foundation in pharmacology and apply broad scientific expertise to address questions related to compound pharmacology, receptor and target biology, signaling mechanisms, and translation across relevant experimental systems.

The ideal candidate will combine deep scientific expertise with curiosity, strategic thinking, and the ability to identify and implement experimental approaches that address evolving program needs. The individual will work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and with internal and external scientific partners to develop pharmacology strategies, guide experimental work, interpret complex data, and advance therapeutic programs.

Responsibilities

  • Provide scientific leadership and strategic direction for molecular pharmacology activities supporting neuroscience discovery and development programs

  • Develop pharmacology strategies and experimental plans to address key questions related to compound activity, receptor and target biology, signaling, mechanism of action, and translation

  • Design, guide, and interpret pharmacological studies using recombinant, endogenous, native, or other relevant experimental systems

  • Guide advanced characterization of therapeutic compounds using appropriate functional, binding, mechanistic, cellular, molecular, or translational approaches

  • Apply expertise in molecular pharmacology and receptor biology to identify scientific questions and experimental approaches that can inform program decisions

  • Integrate pharmacological and biological data across experimental systems and disciplines to develop clear scientific conclusions and recommendations

  • Collaborate closely with medicinal chemistry, in vivo pharmacology, DMPK, translational sciences, and other scientific partners to advance program objectives

  • Establish productive scientific partnerships with internal collaborators and external research organizations; provide appropriate scientific direction while leveraging complementary expertise

  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex scientific and experimental challenges

  • Mentor scientists and contribute to a collaborative environment characterized by scientific rigor, intellectual curiosity, and high-quality execution

  • · Evaluate emerging technologies, methodologies, and scientific approaches and apply them where they can meaningfully advance research programs

  • · Communicate scientific strategy, results, and recommendations effectively to multidisciplinary project teams and research leadership

Basic Requirements:

  • · PhD in Pharmacology, Neuroscience, or a closely related scientific discipline with substantial experience in supporting drug discovery research

  • · 6+ years of experience within the biopharmaceutical industry

  • · Strong foundation in molecular pharmacology, with expertise in one or more areas such as receptor pharmacology, GPCR biology, cellular signaling, mechanistic pharmacology, neuroscience, or related disciplines

  • · Broad understanding of experimental approaches used to characterize compound pharmacology, receptor and target biology, and biological mechanisms

  • · Experience developing scientific strategy and independently addressing complex experimental and drug discovery questions

  • · Demonstrated ability to integrate data across experimental systems and scientific disciplines

  • · Experience directing collaborative research activities involving internal and/or external scientific partners

  • · Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop scientists

  • · Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, multidisciplinary research environment and manage multiple scientific priorities

  • · Excellent scientific judgment, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

Additional Preferences:

  • · Intrinsically curious and deeply passionate about the work we do.

  • · Embrace ambiguity and push for new practices and technologies.

  • · Adaptive problem solver - turn issues into opportunities and translates ideas into solutions, even when the path isn’t clear.

  • · Leverage technical depth and a growth mindset to make impact; imagine what’s possible and pursue it with intention and energy.

  • · Demonstrate curiosity and drive self-identified innovation, especially in the exploration of artificial intelligence and digital.
