jobs.excerpt: About HostGPO: HostGPO is the leading group purchasing organization for the short-term rental and hospitality industry.
jobs.description:
About HostGPO:
HostGPO is the leading group purchasing organization for the short-term rental and hospitality industry. We help operators save money, move faster, and simplify the way they furnish and operate properties.

Our members include boutique hotels, vacation rental operators, corporate housing providers, outdoor hospitality brands, real estate developers, and large-scale hospitality groups across North America. Through our collective buying power and vendor partnerships, they get access to better pricing, stronger procurement options, and a more efficient way to buy what they need.

We are growing quickly and building the procurement backbone for the next era of hospitality.

About the role

HostGPO is hiring an Outbound Strategic Account Lead to drive top-of-funnel growth for our Strategic Accounts team.

This is a true hunter role. You will own outbound prospecting across phone, email, LinkedIn, and live events, with a focus on identifying and engaging high-potential hospitality and short-term rental operators. Your job is to find the right prospects, qualify the opportunity, create momentum, and route strong-fit accounts into the right Strategic Account sales motion.

You will not be waiting for inbound interest. You will be building pipeline from the ground up.

The right person for this role is energized by cold outreach, confident on the phone, curious about the industry, and motivated by the early work it takes to create new business. You should be comfortable starting conversations with operators who may not know HostGPO yet, helping them understand the value quickly, and knowing when an account is ready for a deeper consultative sales conversation.

This role is also ideal for someone who wants to become deeply embedded in the hospitality and short-term rental space. Our members are sophisticated operators, and the best sales conversations come from understanding their world: furnishing cycles, procurement friction, linen programs, amenities, opening timelines, vendor complexity, and the constant pressure to control costs without compromising guest experience.

You do not need to know all of that on day one. You do need to want to learn it quickly.

What you'll do

  • Build New Pipeline
    • Own outbound prospecting for the Strategic Accounts team across cold calls, cold emails, LinkedIn, and event-based outreach.You will target high-value account types including short-term rental operators, boutique hotels, corporate housing providers, glamping and outdoor hospitality brands, developers, multifamily operators, and other businesses with meaningful hospitality procurement needs.
  • Qualify Strategic Opportunities
    • Assess prospect fit, understand business needs, surface pain points, confirm decision-making structure, and determine whether an account belongs in the Strategic Accounts sales motion.
    • When an opportunity is ready for the next step, you will complete a warm handoff to the appropriate Strategic Account Representative or Strategic Account Manager with clear context and next steps.
  • Represent HostGPO At Industry Events
    • Attend industry conferences, hospitality expos, STR events, and other relevant gatherings throughout the year.
    • You will help HostGPO build presence in the market by working the room, starting conversations, capturing leads, strengthening relationships, and following up with prospects after the event.
    • This is an important part of the role. The best person for this seat enjoys being in the industry, not just selling from the outside.
  • Support Follow-Up And Reactivation
    • Help keep strong prospects from going quiet after consultations by sending thoughtful follow-up and re-engagement touchpoints.
    • You will also support outreach to dormant, stalled, or non-ordering accounts where there may be renewed opportunity. Some prospects and members need the right message at the right time. You will help restart those conversations and route re-engaged accounts back to the right owner.
  • Keep The Team Aligned
    • Maintain clean, accurate records in HubSpot so the team can work from shared context. Calls, emails, LinkedIn touches, meetings, notes, and handoffs should be logged clearly and consistently.
    • You will also participate in Strategic Accounts team meetings and share what you are learning from the field: which messages are resonating, which objections are coming up, which account types are responding, and where we may need to adjust.

Qualifications

  • Outbound Sales Experience
    • You have 3-5+ years of B2B outbound sales experience and a demonstrated ability to create pipeline from scratch.
    • You are comfortable with cold calls, cold emails, LinkedIn prospecting, conference follow-up, and the steady discipline that outbound requires. You understand that good outbound is both numbers and judgment: enough activity to create momentum, enough personalization to earn attention.
  • Strong Phone And Event Presence
    • You are confident picking up the phone and starting a conversation with someone who was not expecting your call.
    • You are also comfortable representing a company in person: walking a conference floor, working a booth, introducing yourself to strangers, and building real relationships in the market.
  • Industry Curiosity Or Relevant Experience
    • Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality, travel, procurement, furniture/FF&E, real estate, corporate housing, multifamily, or another adjacent space is strongly preferred.
    • If you do not come from the industry directly, you should bring a clear desire to learn it. Our members can tell when someone understands their operating reality. Curiosity, preparation, and specificity matter here.
  • Qualification Judgment
    • You can quickly determine whether a prospect is a good fit, what problem they are trying to solve, who needs to be involved, and what should happen next.
    • You know how to create momentum without pushing the wrong accounts into the wrong process.
  • Self-Starting Mentality
    • You are comfortable working in a small, fast-growing company where not everything is perfectly scripted.
    • You can take direction, but you do not need constant direction. You bring ideas, test messaging, learn from what is working, and help improve the playbook as you go.
  • Clear Communication
    • You write like a person. Your emails are concise, specific, and relevant. You know how to follow up without sounding generic, over-automated, or oddly intense.
    • You can communicate clearly with prospects, teammates, and leadership.
  • CRM Discipline
    • You have experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and understand why clean records matter. Good handoffs depend on good context.
  • Comfort With Modern Sales Tools
    • You are comfortable using Slack, HubSpot, LinkedIn, and AI tools to support research, prospecting, and message refinement.

Bonus Points

You may be especially strong for this role if you have experience in any of the following areas:

  • Short-term rental, hospitality, boutique hotel, corporate housing, multifamily, or outdoor hospitality sales
  • Procurement, FF&E, interior design, furniture, linens, amenities, or hospitality operations
  • Membership-based sales, group purchasing, marketplace, or procurement platform sales
  • High-growth startup or early-stage company environments
  • Event-based lead generation or conference-heavy sales motions
  • Consultative sales where the value proposition requires more than a simple product pitch

The primary focus of this role is pipeline generation and qualified handoff, but closing ability is a meaningful plus. If you know how to recognize the right opportunity and move it across the finish line, that will serve you well here.

Compensation And Benefits

  • Base salary of $75,000-$85,000
  • OTE of $130,000-$150,000+ with uncapped commission and performance incentives
  • Stock options in a rapidly growing company
  • Health insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Flexible PTO
  • Learning and development reimbursement
  • Free HostGPO membership
  • Covered conference and event travel

Why This Role Matters

HostGPO is a community built for hosts, by hosts. We care about the operators we serve, and we are building something practical, valuable, and needed in a fragmented industry.

This role is important because new relationships drive the next stage of our growth. You will be one of the first people many strategic prospects meet from HostGPO. The way you open the door, understand their business, and create trust will shape the opportunities that follow.

For the right person — someone who likes outbound, wants ownership, enjoys the hospitality world, and is excited by the chance to build a market presence from the ground up — this role has real upside.

HostGPO is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and celebrates diversity across our team.

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Recruiting has run on the same model for decades: firms charge a fixed percentage of a hire's first-year salary for work that is largely manual, sourcing, screening, and outreach done one candidate at a time. That pricing made sense when the work required a person doing it by hand. It doesn't anymore.

Market Context

Foundry is an AI-native recruiting firm built around a simple idea: use AI agents to handle sourcing, screening, and candidate evaluation, and keep a small human team focused on what still requires a person: building trust with clients and candidates, exercising judgment on close calls, and closing the placement. That shift in who does the work lets us offer clients a fee that's a fraction of what traditional firms charge, without cutting corners on quality.

This is where we believe recruiting is headed. AI-native service firms are starting to emerge and prove the model works, and we're building toward that shift deliberately.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilot placements with design-partner companies, convert them to paid retained relationships, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Deep domain expertise in recruiting, staffing, or talent acquisition, as a builder operator or agency leader

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

RTI's Center for Clinical Research is seeking qualified candidates for a full-time Principal Investigator/Senior Research Epidemiologist/Biostatistician based in Research Triangle Park, NC or as a domestic teleworker. The Center provides research leadership, study and trial design expertise, and biostatistical support for multi-center domestic and international clinical studies and research networks, with expertise in statistical design and analysis, randomized clinical trials, clinical project management, and governance/operations management for Administrative and Data Coordinating Centers. A Principal Investigator/Senior Research Epidemiologist/Biostatistician serves as the leader or co-leader of Coordinating Centers for multi-center, single and multi-protocol clinical studies, and provides long-range direction on research activities in the Center.


What You'll Do

Responsibilities:

  • Serves as overall project leader for coordinating centers of multi-site clinical research projects, including randomized clinical trials.
  • Provides senior leadership for operational and scientific aspects of the project, including study/trial design, protocol development, study implementation, site oversight, quality control, data analysis, and presentation of study results.
  • Typically serves as a member of a research network steering committee and as the primary liaison with the funding agency/client and the Data and Safety Monitoring Board.
  • Guides and assists multi-disciplinary project teams in the operational aspects of the coordinating center, including data management and potentially clinical center subawards.
  • Maintains effective communication with funding officials, study site leadership, collaborators from universities and other organizations, central laboratories, clinical centers, and other specialized core facilities such as specimen storage or imaging.
  • Functions as the most senior point of escalation within a project, e.g., the coordinating center and/or research team.
  • Oversees contractual and fiscal aspects of the Coordinating Center (e.g., ensuring timely reporting and deliverables, maintaining an adequate and appropriate staff mix for all project activities).
  • Leads business and proposal development activities for grant, cooperative agreement, and contract opportunities, including supplemental funding and other growth opportunities.
  • Leads development of manuscripts for refereed journals and mentors junior investigators on manuscript and scientific presentations.
  • Presents research findings at scientific conferences.
  • Monitors overall process and quality of studies and/or activities.
  • Accountable for adherence to project budget, timeline/schedule, and contractual deliverables
  • Serves in a leadership role in strategic planning, business development, including writing and leading proposals, and staff mentoring.

What You'll Need

Qualifications:

  • A doctorate in epidemiology or related field and at least 8 years’ experience working in multi-center clinical research, preferably including randomized trials.
  • Successfully led or co-led at least two public health research projects, including multi-site coordinating centers and/or prospective data collection.
  • Experience in obtaining funding and leading or co-leading National Institutes of Health and other federally-funded research projects is strongly preferred.
  • 6 + years experience working on FDA-regulated trials, including new drug and device studies, is required.
  • Demonstrable track record of leadership in developing and sustaining a climate that fosters growth in research funding, staff capabilities, and scientific excellence and reputation.
  • Focus in 1-2 research areas of chronic or acquired health conditions, as evidenced by leadership experience and a corresponding record of scientific stature is preferred.
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams including senior, mid-level and early career researchers, statisticians, data managers, technologists, and research coordinators/project managers.
  • A record of scientific stature in presentation and publication of study results in peer-reviewed journals and other venues.
  • Experience working with sites (domestic/international), data sharing, and data use is beneficial.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence/machine learning approaches is beneficial.
  • Excellent skills in communication, negotiation, compromise, and building consensus within and between groups of various backgrounds.
  • To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require now, or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

For Applicants in Massachusetts Only: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The anticipated pay range for this role is listed below. Our pay ranges represent national averages and may vary by location as a geographic differential may be applied to some locations within the United States. RTI considers multiple factors when making an offer including, for example: established salary range, internal budget, business needs, and education and years of work experience possessed by the applicant. Further, salary is merely one element to our offer.

At RTI, we demonstrate our commitment to rewarding individual and team achievement through a total rewards package. This package includes (among other things) a competitive base salary, a generous paid time off policy, merit based annual increases, bonus opportunities and a robust recognition program. Other benefits include a competitive range of insurance plans (including health, dental, life, and short-term and long-term disability), access to a retirement savings program such as a 401(k) plan, paid parental leave for all parents, financial assistance with adoption expenses or infertility treatments, financial reimbursement for education and developmental opportunities, an employee assistance program, and numerous other offerings to support a healthy work-life balance.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Kong’s API Management suite includes the Kong Enterprise Gateway, the Konnect SaaS platform and a variety of Managed Gateways in public clouds like AWS, Azure and GCP. This suite of products helps customers in different industries (like finance, banking, eCommerce, airlines, etc.) manage their API platforms and operations at scale. Our customers expect secure, reliable, high scale, low latency offerings from Kong whether running on-premise or in the public cloud.

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop high-performance Go runtime, CLI engines and declarative state managers. You will architect the software that thousands of engineering teams use every day to interact with Kong's runtime — including deck (Kong’s state management & drift detection engine), the Kong Terraform Provider, official Go SDKs and automated spec-driven API tooling.

What You Will Build & Own:

You will balance Software Development with APIOps Architecture:


1. Declarative Engine

  • State & Drift Management Engines: Design and optimize algorithms in Go for state diffing, validation, and real-time drift detection across large-scale multi-tenant API topologies.

  • Go SDK & Core Libraries: Architect and maintain enterprise-grade, high-performance Go SDKs used by Kong’s internal microservices and external clients to interface with the Konnect SaaS platform.

  • API Design & Standardization: Define clean, extensible REST API contracts across Kong’s platform runtimes.

  • Code Generation & Tooling Pipelines: Architect spec-driven tooling (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI) to dynamically generate SDKs, client libraries, and IaC definitions without manual developer toil.

2. APIOps & IaC Ecosystem

  • Core CLI Engineering: Build modern, fast, and intuitive CLI-first developer experiences designed for both human developer workflows and high-concurrency CI/CD automation pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).

  • Terraform & Provider Ecosystem: Build and extend high-reliability Terraform Providers to enable seamless IaC operations.

  • Support for Next-Gen Runtimes: Bring new runtime capabilities into the declarative management ecosystem as native API primitives.

    What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience designing and delivering production-grade backend systems and developer tools using Golang.

  • API Design Mastery: Proven experience crafting intuitive, developer-friendly API schemas (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI), with a strong focus on backwards compatibility, versioning and developer experience (DX).

  • Hands-on IaC / Platform Understanding: Production exposure to Terraform provider development, Kubernetes operators or stateful CI/CD automation pipelines.

  • Engineering Rigor: Strong commitment to clean code, comprehensive automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), benchmarking and robust software architecture.

  • Communication & Technical Leadership: Ability to articulate complex technical decisions, mentor junior engineers and collaborate across global backend and platform teams.


Why Join Kong?

  • Build for Engineers: Your work is open-source adjacent and directly impacts millions of developers and Fortune 500 enterprises around the globe.

  • Solving Deep Technical Problems: Move beyond standard CRUD services to solve high-impact problems in declarative state sync, API governance and distributed connectivity.

  • High-Growth Pre-IPO Startup: Scale your career alongside a market-leading company driving the future of API management and AI connectivity.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Director of Analytics
jobs.excerpt: About Mass Culture Mass Culture is a growth media agency.
jobs.description:
About Mass Culture

Mass Culture is a growth media agency. We help mission-driven scale-ups connect brand and performance so they grow faster, more profitably, and with purpose.

About the Role

Mass Culture's model depends on one discipline: knowing what's actually working, and why. The Director of Analytics owns that discipline agency-wide. You will build the measurement infrastructure, attribution models, and reporting standards that turn campaign data into business decisions, for every client, across every channel.

This is not a dashboarding role. Clients and leadership come to you for the answer behind the numbers: what's driving growth, what's wasting budget, and what to do next. You will set the analytical standard the entire agency works toward, and make sure every team is making decisions on real signals instead of noise.

It is also the role that makes our thesis defensible. We believe brand drives conversion, not the other way around, and we work alongside Brains, a world-class branding agency. Believing that is easy. Proving it is your job. Incrementality tests, geo experiments, holdouts, and media mix modeling are how brand investment earns its budget instead of asking for it on faith.

Responsibilities

Measurement Strategy & Infrastructure

  • Own agency-wide measurement architecture: attribution models, incrementality testing frameworks, and reporting standards used across every client account.
  • Build the tracking, tagging, and data infrastructure that makes cross-channel measurement reliable, and audit it regularly for gaps.
    ●Own the metric dictionary: one documented definition for every metric we report, with its source, its owner, and its known caveats.
    ●Define what measurement maturity looks like at each stage of a client relationship, and move every account up that ladder deliberately.
  • Set the standard for what good measurement looks like at Mass Culture, and hold every team accountable to it.

Data Narrative & Decision Quality

  • Own the standing narrative for each account: one continuous arc of what we believed, what we tested, what we learned, and what changed.
  • Hold every number we ship to one standard: what happened, why, what it means for the business, what we are doing about it, and what we need from the client.
  • State confidence explicitly. Separate signal from noise, and say plainly when a movement is not yet a result.
  • Name what would have to be true for a recommendation to be wrong, and what evidence would change our mind. We kill our own conclusions before a client has to.
  • Make findings survive translation. The same insight has to hold up for a channel specialist, an account strategist, and a founder or CFO, without quietly changing meaning on the way up.
  • Guard the line between narrative and spin. A good story that runs ahead of the evidence is a failure of this role, not a win.
  • Set and teach the house standard for how Mass Culture writes about data, and coach analysts and strategists to write to it.

Insight & Business Impact

  • Proactively turn raw performance data into clear, decision-ready insight: what's driving revenue and margin, what's not working, and what to test next.
  • Partner with Account Strategists and media channel leads to connect channel-level data to client business outcomes.
  • Lead the analytical narrative in QBRs and strategic reviews, presenting findings directly to senior client stakeholders.
  • Contribute measurement expertise to new business pitches and client onboarding.

Testing & Experimentation

  • Partner with strategy to design and run incrementality tests, holdout studies, geo experiments, and media mix experiments that validate, or kill, strategic assumptions.
  • Build and maintain a multi-year learning agenda per account: a testing roadmap tied to the business questions that actually matter, not a backlog of curiosities.
  • Own the experiment record. Every test carries a documented hypothesis, design, minimum detectable effect, result, and the decision it changed. Findings get applied, not filed away.
  • Champion radical transparency in reporting: when something isn't working, the data says so before the client has to ask.

Creative Measurement

  • Own creative measurement end to end, including creative attribution, fatigue, and testing frameworks, in partnership with Brains and our creative strategy team.
  • Make sure creative decisions are made on evidence, and that what we learn about creative travels across accounts instead of dying in one.

Platform & Product Partnership

  • Co-own the measurement roadmap for the Mass Culture client portal with agency leadership: metric definitions, experiment tracking, attribution lenses, and how uncertainty gets represented to clients.
  • Build in the platform directly. You will author KPIs, widgets, and reporting views yourself rather than describing them to someone else.
  • Own the tools and platforms that power agency-wide reporting (the portal, GA4, Looker Studio, data warehouses, and similar), and make the build-versus-buy calls.

Team & Process Leadership

  • Manage and develop the analytics function, including the Agency Insights Lead and data analysts, setting clear standards for rigor and output quality.
  • Train account and channel teams on measurement fundamentals so good analytical thinking isn't confined to one department.

Tools, Automation & AI

  • Evaluate and implement AI and automation tools that improve forecasting speed, pattern detection, and reporting efficiency.
  • Ensure automation strengthens analytical rigor rather than replacing it. We expect AI to make good analysts sharper, not to stand in for judgment.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 10+ years of analytics, measurement, or marketing data experience, with at least 3 years managing analysts.
  • Fluent SQL. You can go straight to the warehouse and answer your own question without waiting on anyone.
  • Proven ability to build and run attribution models, incrementality tests, and cross-channel measurement frameworks in a performance marketing context.
  • Strong command of analytics and visualization tools (GA4, Looker Studio, or comparable), and the instinct to fix a reporting surface rather than work around it.
  • Experience translating complex data into clear, business-relevant recommendations for senior stakeholders, including clients. In writing, not just in a room.
  • A track record of being right in public and wrong in public. We will ask you about a call you got wrong and what you changed because of it.
  • Practical experience incorporating AI tools into analytical workflows.

●Agency environment experience required.

Nice to Have

  • Python or R for statistical analysis and automation.
  • Experience with marketing mix modeling (MMM) or multi-touch attribution (MTA) platforms.
  • Familiarity with retail media measurement (Amazon Marketing Cloud, closed-loop attribution) and paid social and search platform reporting.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Postgres).

Compensation:

Salary Range - $140,000-$180,000 USD

Why Mass Culture

We are not a traditional agency. We work inside our clients' businesses, connect media strategy to real commercial outcomes, and treat growth as a system. Our sister company, Brains, is a world-class branding agency, and that relationship is real. We love brand as much as we love performance.

No hacking. No smoke and mirrors. Real growth.

Mass Culture on Inclusion:
We hire great people from a wide breadth of backgrounds, not only because it’s the right thing to do, but also because it makes our work, our company and our communities stronger. Mass Culture is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, national origin or any other federal, state or local protected class.

jobs.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

The Financial Accounting Analyst is responsible for providing relevant, accurate and timely financial analysis and guidance in support of the Financial Shared Services–Advertising leadership as well as our local business units. The Financial Accounting Analyst provides direct support that includes but is not limited to, monthly and quarterly review of the GL reported revenue, preparation of journal entries and variance analyses of reported revenue and year end closings. The Financial Accounting Analyst also ensures adherence to internal controls and other compliance requirements, including review of proposed rate programs and contracts for alignment with company and industry standard policies, and multiple element analysis of proposed and reported revenue. The Financial Accounting Analyst is responsible for accurate and timely analytical reports, communication of financial performance to members of the leadership team and delivering strong customer service to both the finance leadership and the business units.

Primary Responsibilities/Tasks:

Develops relationships and provides support to finance leadership and staff at business units.

Performs detailed reviews of actual revenue results and investigates variances to expected results, prepares required journal entries, and provides explanations.

Maintains financial security by adhering to internal controls.

Performs detailed reviews of proposed rate programs and contracts for compliance with company revenue recognition policies.

Provides information to management by assembling and summarizing data; preparing reports; making presentations of findings, analyses, and recommendations.

Assists with the development and implementation of standardized analytical tools and reporting as well as ad hoc reporting when needed.

Works with other Revenue Recognition team members and leadership team on various projects as assigned.

Works to identify areas for improvement, form solutions, and implement process improvements.

Required Competencies:

Strong knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

Financial analysis and compliance acumen

Passion for results

Customer/client orientation

Strong communication at all levels

Support multiple customers simultaneously

Teamwork and team leadership

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

Business degree in Accounting/Finance with 2+ years of accounting and financial analysis experience or comparable work experience

Strong Excel skills

Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work with internal and external stakeholders

Experience in a consolidated financial environment

Demonstrated customer service

Big picture perspective and ability to manage vision but also the ability to perform the detailed assignments as needed

Knowledge of BPC a plus

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $55000 and $62000. Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education level, location, and union representation, if applicable

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Engineering Lead, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead an AI-native content intelligence and publishing venture.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead an AI-native content intelligence and publishing venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Orbitwell is an AI-first content workflow that turns a professional's own judgment and stories into a consistent, firm-approved public presence. The platform captures private input through conversation, audio, and dictation, drafts voice-matched content grounded in that person's real expertise, and routes every draft through configurable firm guardrails and human verification before it reaches a ready-to-publish queue. Rather than another point solution for capture, writing, or scheduling, Orbitwell is designed to be the system of record for expert-driven publishing inside professional-services firms.

The venture begins with an initial product, 30+ validation interviews, and a working prototype to accelerate iteration and go-to-market. We are now seeking a founder to lead the venture from here.

Market Context

  • ~500,000+ US professional-services firms in wealth and legal alone (33,000 RIAs, 418,000–463,000 law firms), most under 10 people

  • Professional-services AUM/revenue is growing and consolidating: RIA assets under management +22.3% YoY to $176.8T; RIA M&A hit a record 322 deals in 2025, up from 272; law firm employment +1.4% in 2025

  • The category proving willingness to pay for this workflow, personal/employee advocacy software, is a $0.5B–$2.2B market in 2026, growing at double-digit CAGR through the early 2030s

  • Generative AI content creation, the underlying technology wave, is a $14.8B market in 2024 projected to reach $80.1B by 2030 (32.5% CAGR)

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

  • Strategy — Define the ICP wedge (creators vs. teams vs. agencies), pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Expand from internal design partners to external users (creators, teams, agencies), validate retention and willingness to pay, and build the go-to-market motion through creator-led distribution

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to the creator economy, marketing tech, social platforms, or knowledge work tooling, with familiarity in AI agents/LLMs

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to unlock intelligence? If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the role

Our docs get used in a few different ways. Some people land on a page in the middle of a task and just need the answer. Others are working out how to run Kong across a whole company, with real traffic and a lot of teams. The docs also power agent workflows, ours and our customers', like MCP servers and AI assistants. So when a page is wrong, it's wrong everywhere.

You'll own the docs for at least one product area, and you'll decide what to work on based on what you see. What features are releasing? Where are people getting stuck? What are the field teams hearing? You won't spend all your time in your area, though. You'll work with the other docs writers every day, check in with them when your work is done, ask for help when you're buried, and weigh in on each other's problems. You'll also work closely with product managers and engineers, and you'll be in their conversations early.

We own our docs platform, too. If a workflow could be better, you can build a better one. Add Vale rules, upgrade the platform, set up auto-generated docs. We have a docs engineer that can help you turn your needs into real features!

What you'll do

Own your product area

  • Own the documentation strategy for your area. That means getting into the product, seeing what's about to ship, deciding what needs writing, and planning the work. Share that plan with the docs team so everyone knows what's in motion. If something looks off, we'll sort it out together.

  • Work with product and field teams to find where a docs gap is blocking someone, and bring the data: user behavior, field feedback, adoption numbers. Who asked loudest shouldn't decide what gets written.

  • Sit in on product management discussions and say what you're seeing, so the docs and the product strategy stay in step.

Write it and test it

  • Write and edit how-to guides, reference documentation, and the pages that point people where they need to go, like landing pages and overviews.

  • Test everything you write. You're usually the first person outside engineering to use a new feature, so run the software, talk to the experts, and use the command line and API testing tools. If the steps don't work, the page isn't finished.

  • Review docs for technical accuracy and make sure they follow our guidelines.

Keep it all current

  • Maintain what's already published. Update it, revise it, and deprecate what's out of date.

  • Improve how we do docs, including document management and version control in Git, and help plan docs work so it ships on schedule.

What you bring

Must have

  • You've worked alongside other technical writers on a docs team, not just with engineers or a manager, and you're comfortable giving and getting reviews

  • You've worked as a technical writer at a software company or a startup

  • Experience working with AI and AI-native workflows (building skills using MCP servers)

  • An understanding of how to test software, including APIs and command line tools, and hands-on experience doing it

  • Comfort working in the command line, and solid Git experience

  • Experience maintaining, managing, and reviewing docs in a docs-as-code environment

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit .

Compensation Range: $130K - $148K

  2. Own the Product Management for Advanced Ads (Interim): You will drive the strategy, growth, and execution of Advanced Ads—our leading ad-management platform powering over 150,000 websites worldwide.

You don't just build features to check boxes; you build solutions that move the needle on business goals, and you enable the PMs on your team to do the same.

Core Responsibilities

1. Leadership & Product Operating Model Excellence

  • Mentorship & Coaching: Serve as a player-coach to other Product Managers, guiding them to elevate their product craft, execution, and strategic thinking.
  • Outcome over Output: Evangelize the shift from feature-factory mindsets to an outcome-driven culture. Train PMs to obsess over business results and customer impact rather than sprint velocity and story points.
  • Framework Standardizing: Implement modern product operating model principles (e.g., product trios, data-informed decision making, rapid prototyping, and de-risking assumptions).
  • Evangelize Kaizen: Introduce continuous feedback loops and structured retrospective frameworks to scale product management maturity across the entire organization.

2. Product Ownership: Advanced Ads

  • Strategy & Vision: Define and execute the long-term product vision for Advanced Ads, integrating its flexible ad injection, targeting, and Google Ad Manager capabilities deeper into the MonetizeMore ecosystem.
  • Continuous Discovery: Lead continuous product discovery to uncover publishers' deepest pain points, validating ideas for usability, feasibility, viability, and value before writing code.
  • Revenue & Growth: Take end-to-end ownership from monetization strategy to GTM. Prioritize the roadmap based on clear ROI, keeping a laser focus on customer lifetime value (LTV) and monthly recurring revenue (MRR).
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and Growth to ensure features aren't just shipped, but successfully adopted and commercialized.
  • Long-Term Plan: Determine the long term needs of this business line: resource requirements, investment, propose and collaborate on the best organizational design for the success of the product.
Who You Are
  • The Experienced Leader: You have 8+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years leading or mentoring other PMs. Ad tech, SaaS, or WordPress ecosystem experience is a massive plus.
  • The Operating Model Expert: You have deeply practical experience working within a modern, empowerment-based Product Operating Model. You know what "good" looks like and possess the empathy and patience to coach others there.
  • The Owner Mindset: You treat your product like your own business. You aren't afraid to dive into raw data to find hidden patterns or jump on a customer call to understand friction points.
  • Data-Driven & Courageous: You monitor product health metrics religiously. If the data shows a feature is failing to deliver the expected outcome, you have the courage to pivot or kill it.
  • The Clear Communicator: You effortlessly translate complex technical logic or abstract product frameworks into digestible, high-impact value propositions for stakeholders, engineers, and your team.

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with a flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.

jobs.description:
We're hiring a business development leader to take over the team that builds and runs our investor network: six associates, one number, and a direct line to both co-founders.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and those investors join our network as members. Founders pay for the access to those relationships and for the investor relations work our team does around every introduction, and that work is ultimately the product we sell.

The two co-founders have led this team themselves until now. It has grown to around six associates, which is past the point where two founders can coach it hands on while running the rest of the company, so we are hiring the person who takes it over.

The role
You lead the investor relations team and report to both co-founders. Each associate holds a book of investor members and runs several things at once, new investor relationships, the nurturing of existing ones, and the introductions we make for our clients, plus the follow-up work from there. Your job is to make that team excellent and keep it at full leverage, which means every associate knows what is expected, gets coached every week, can measure their own progress, and hears it the same day when something is off.

What you will do

  • Run the weekly rhythm, a pipeline and network review (CRM), a review of every win and loss, KPIs, and a one to one with every associate.

  • Coach every associate on their calls and their introductions.

  • Hire, onboard and, when needed, let people go, against a written bar for what good looks like.

  • Own the health of the entire Pairs network, more active members every month, and every member getting founders that fit at the pace they asked for.

  • Work with our client success team on each client's plan, so what your team works on matches what the client expects, and with our founder relations team, who build relationships with top founders long before they become clients.

  • Spot the constraint that holds the team back and fix it, with a process or together with our engineers, which takes someone who knows which problem is worth solving.

  • Bring the two co-founders the weekly numbers, investor calls, newly active members, introductions sent, founder calls and referrals, and what you are changing because of them.

What you bring

  • You have run a sales, business development or investment team of five or more for at least two years, the number you carried was the team's, and you can name what the team achieved under you and who you promoted.

  • People respected you and still wanted to work for you, without you needing to be liked. You give straight feedback and you hold the standard when it is uncomfortable.

  • Ego and politics are not part of how you work. You talk about the team's results before your own, and your last team would say the same about you.

  • Systems are how you think. You have built the CRM discipline, the reporting or the playbook that others then ran on, and you can find the one constraint in a team and remove it.

  • Incentives and retention make sense to you. You know what makes the right behavior pay and what makes a team stick together, and you have the retention to show for it.

  • You play the long game. You would not squeeze one month at the cost of the next three, and you go for quality over quantity with investors and founders alike.

  • The investor world is one you know well enough to coach. You have sold high ticket to senior buyers, raised capital, or built an investor or executive network yourself, and years in venture capital or at a fund are a plus on top of the team you led.

Backgrounds we expect to see are high ticket competitive sales, consulting, banking and investment teams. This is not the seat for a great dealmaker who has never led a team, our associate role is the right application for that, and investor relations at a listed company or LP reporting at a fund is a different job from this one.

What good looks like

  • By day 30 you have familiarized yourself closely with the associate work and what we expect from it.

  • Ninety days in, the weekly rhythm runs on your numbers and every associate has a written plan they measure themselves against.

  • Every month the network has more active members and every client's introductions went out on fit and on time.

  • Every quarter one constraint is gone from the team's way, through a process or through engineering.

  • After a year the associates have grown, and the relationships with investors and founders are stronger than they were, since everything here is built to compound over years.

Compensation and how we work
US$200K to US$300K+ total compensation, base plus a bonus on the team's results. Fully remote, your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours. The best AI tooling is paid for, so the admin runs itself and your hours go to people. You work next to our client success lead, our founder relations team and our engineers, each of them running their own lane.

How to apply
Hit apply, which takes you to a short form with four questions. The two co-founders read every application. The process from there is a first call, final conversations with both co-founders, and three references.

No ego is the first rule here, the team's result comes before anyone's name, the co-founders included. And everything is built to compound, so every relationship and every number should be stronger next year than it is now.

This role combines strong data analysis and data science capabilities with core business analysis skills to ensure that data is effectively leveraged to inform strategic decision making, improve processes, and influence solution design.

  • Monitor and enhance data quality through profiling, validation, remediation, and alignment with organizational priorities

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business analysis, statistics, computer science, data science, or related fields
  • 2-5 years of experience in data analysis, data science, business analysis, product analytics, or similar roles
