jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Hiring at NFF includes a multi-step selection process.
jobs.description:
Hiring at NFF includes a multi-step selection process. We do not make job offers through third-party job search tools such as LinkedIn. NFF will never ask for payment of any kind during the process. We encourage all job seekers to remain vigilant throughout their job search and verify the source of any recruitment-related communication, as individuals may attempt to impersonate organizations.

Applications closed on August 24, 2026. If you submitted an application after August 24, we will consider your application if we need additional candidates.

Position Reports to: Senior Director, Consulting
Department: Consulting
Location: US-based remote, with a strong preference for candidates within commutable distance to one of NFF’s Offices (Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Oakland, and Los Angeles)
Salary Range: $66,000 - $70,200

About Nonprofit Finance Fund 

Nonprofit Finance Fund® (NFF®) is a nonprofit lender, consultant, and advocate.Since 1980, we’ve helped organizations access the money and resources they need to realize their communities’ aspirations. Alongside others, we’re working to build community wealth and well-being and put affordable housing, essential services, quality jobs, and excellent education within reach of more people. To learn more, visit nff.org. Learn more about our work to achieve our vision through our Theory of Change and Values. 

About the Role

NFF’s Consulting team works with nonprofit organizations, funders, coalitions, networks and other mission-driven partners to support capacity building and financial sustainability. The team partners with nonprofit leaders navigating growth, change, and systemic challenges by providing strategic advice, financial analysis, and capacity-building support. Through customized consulting engagements nationwide, NFF helps organizations strengthen their capacity, sustainability, and impact.

NFF seeks an Initiative Support Associate to strengthen project execution operational effectiveness and client service delivery within the Consulting Department. The Associate will partner closely with consulting staff to coordinate projects and initiatives, maintain accurate project information, track progress against key milestones, and support the operational processes that underpin high quality consulting engagements. While this role is grounded in project coordination and department operations, the Associate will work across teams to facilitate communication, organize information, support compliance and invoicing requirements, and ensure critical project data and documentation remain current and accessible. The Associate will also assist with the review and analysis of client materials, including financial statements and impact data, helping project teams effectively manage information and advance client engagements.

NFF has offices in Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Oakland, and Los Angeles. This is a US-based remote role, with a strong preference for candidates within commutable distance to one of NFF’s offices. NFF has core business hours where we expect all staff to be available from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm local time, and occasional travel (20%) is required.

What You Will Do

Essential responsibilities for this role include, but are not limited to:

Project Coordination & Execution Support (40%) 

  • Coordinate project logistics and maintain project plans, action item trackers, timelines, deliverables, and other tools that support effective project execution
  • Support client-facing administrative processes, including report timelines, invoicing and billing, tracking re-grant disbursements, and coordinating documentation with internal and external partners
  • Prepare meeting materials, agendas, notes, and follow-up communications 
  • Monitor assigned tasks and proactively communicate progress, risks, and support needs 
  • Contribute to high quality client deliverables, including PowerPoint presentations, engagement letters, research reports, and workshop/training curriculum
  • Identify opportunities for improvements; recommend policy or process changes as appropriate

Research, Analysis & Deliverable Development (25%) 

  • Update and maintain Salesforce data, ensuring financial, impact, and project records are accurate, organized, and current
  • Conduct research and gather information from a variety of sources to support consulting engagements 
  • Compile, organize, and analyze quantitative and qualitative data 
  • Support the development of presentations, reports, summaries, and other client-facing deliverables 
  • Synthesize information into clear findings, observations, and recommendations 
  • Review work products for accuracy, consistency, and completeness prior to delivery 

Knowledge Management & Continuous Learning (15%) 

  • Identify recurring themes, trends, and insights across projects, clients, and engagements 
  • Contribute to development and maintenance of tools, templates, resources, and knowledge repositories 
  • Support efforts to capture lessons learned and effective practices from consulting engagements 
  • Share observations and emerging insights that may strengthen future project design and delivery 

Client & Team Support (10%) 

  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across projects to support successful engagement outcomes 
  • Participate in client and internal meetings, contributing notes, follow-up actions, and logistical support 
  • Lead event logistics and support the delivery of client-facing workshops, training sessions, and convenings, including scheduling, participant coordination, materials preparation, and virtual or in-person execution
  • Build positive working relationships with clients, partners, and colleagues 
  • Seek feedback, clarification, and guidance to ensure alignment with project goals and expectations. 
  • Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and solutions-oriented team environment 

Meetings and Other Duties as Assigned (10%) 

  • Participate in department, team, and organizational meetings 
  • Engage in professional development and learning opportunities 
  • Support special projects, initiatives, and organizational priorities as assigned 
  • Contribute to NFF as a learning organization that seeks to advance the sector
  • Perform other duties consistent with the scope and level of the position 

Who You Are and Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution or equivalent combinations of relevant education, training, and experience 
  • One (1) year of professional work experience 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain strong attention to detail 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 
  • Demonstrated analytical, research, and problem-solving skills 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook 
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a team environment 

The Strongest Candidates Will 

  • Be committed to NFF’s values, mission, and approach to community impact  
  • Bring experience in nonprofit, public sector, consulting, financial services, or related environments 
  • Understand or be eager to learn about CDFIs and community-centered finance  
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships and collaborate effectively across teams, geographies, and perspectives in a highly matrixed organization 
  • Be able to work with large amounts of data to independently create reports and presentations
  • Work independently, communicate proactively, and take ownership of outcomes 
  • Demonstrate curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth 
  • Thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment where priorities evolve and ambiguity is common 

Benefits and Compensation 

NFF offers a generous benefits package that currently includes up to twenty (20) paid holidays/business closure days, three (3) floating holidays, flexible time off, group medical insurance with a funded health reimbursement account, dental and vision plans, life insurance and disability plans, a retirement plan with both a non-elective employer contribution (4%) and additional match contribution (up to 2%), a “work from home” fund, and flexible spending accounts to cover health, dependent care, and commuter costs.

This is a full-time role with a compensation range of $66,000 - $70,200. A compensation offer is based on a candidate’s background and years of relevant experience, with consideration for internal equity. Because of our strong commitment to equity and growth, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

    • Collaboration without competition: peers root for each other’s success, leadership is entirely accessible, and we tackle complex problems with a strict "no-ego" approach.

The ability to travel domestically and abroad is required (VISA not being handled by Veeva). The ideal candidate will be fluent in English and ideally one of the following languages: French, German, Italian, or Spanish. The role is ideally based in the area of a Veeva office (Barcelona, London, Paris, Frankfurt, Berlin), but other EU locations will be considered.

    • Leading business process discovery and application design workshops
    • Translating complex client process requirements into a workable solution design
    • Overseeing the solution build, test, and deployment
    • Creating process documentation and project deliverables
    • Planning and establishing post-go-live activities, including ongoing support

    • Able to travel approximately 20%

We believe great content is a superpower.     • Define and evolve our content marketing roadmap across web, email, social, thought leadership, and more.

  • Distribution & SEO
    • Develop a smart distribution plan to get our content in front of the right people—across channels and communities.
    • Own our organic content growth through modern SEO strategies, internal linking, and experimentation.
  • Brand Voice & Tone
    • Craft and maintain a clear, confident, and consistent voice across all touchpoints—from blog to byline to billboard.
    • Build our content guidelines so anyone writing on our behalf sounds unmistakably like us.
  • Analytics & Optimization
    • Set KPIs, measure performance, and continuously refine our content based on data and feedback.
    • Know what works and double down on it.

🏆 You are...

  • Have 4–8 years of experience in B2B content marketing, ideally at a high-growth tech company.
  • Can show a portfolio of thoughtful, strategic content—you’ve written blog posts, case studies, newsletters, and perhaps even scripts or decks.
  • Know how to balance storytelling and strategy—you think in brand and in pipeline.
  • Are comfortable operating at both 30,000 ft and 3 inches—you can set a vision and roll up your sleeves to get it done.
  • Thrive in an early-stage environment: ambiguity energizes you, you are obsessed, and you default to action.

Why This Role Matters

This isn’t just another marketing seat—it’s a foundational hire. You’ll play a pivotal role in defining how the world sees us. And at least at the start, you’ll be reporting to our CEO directly.

We value Curiosity and learning in our employees. We promote open-mindedness, embrace mistakes, and encourage challenging questions for personal growth. We create a culture of continuous learning to empower our team to tackle challenges and excel in their roles.

Salesforce Administrator

About the Company
Our client is a well-established UK-based Education Recruitment business specialising in connecting talented education professionals with schools and educational institutions across the United Kingdom.
With a strong focus on delivering exceptional recruitment services, the business is committed to using technology, data and efficient processes to support its recruitment teams and provide an outstanding experience for both candidates and clients.
They are looking for an experienced and proactive Salesforce Administrator to join their growing team remotely from South Africa.
About the Role
As the Salesforce Administrator, you will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, optimisation and ongoing development of the company's Salesforce platform. You will work closely with recruitment consultants, compliance teams, management and other key stakeholders to ensure Salesforce supports the business's recruitment operations effectively.
The ideal candidate will have strong technical Salesforce administration skills, excellent problem-solving abilities and a good understanding of recruitment workflows, ideally within the UK recruitment or education sector.

Salesforce Administration & Maintenance
  • Manage the daily administration, configuration and maintenance of Salesforce.
  • Create and manage user accounts, profiles, permission sets, roles and access controls.
  • Configure custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types and validation rules.
  • Maintain data accuracy, consistency and integrity across the platform.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues and provide technical support to users.
  • Manage Salesforce updates, releases and enhancements.
Workflow Automation & Process Improvement
  • Design, build and maintain automated workflows using Salesforce Flow.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline recruitment processes and reduce manual administration.
  • Optimise candidate management, client management, vacancy tracking and placement workflows.
  • Support automation across recruitment, onboarding and compliance processes.
  • Work with stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions.
Reporting & Data Management
  • Develop and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards to monitor recruitment performance and business KPIs.
  • Support reporting on candidate pipelines, job vacancies, placements, consultant activity and client engagement.
  • Manage data imports, exports, cleansing and deduplication.
  • Ensure data quality and reporting accuracy across the business.
  • Provide management with meaningful insights through Salesforce reporting.
Recruitment Systems & Integrations
  • Support Salesforce integrations with recruitment platforms, job boards, email systems and third-party applications.
  • Assist with the administration of recruitment-related applications built on or integrated with Salesforce.
  • Maintain efficient data flows between Salesforce and other business systems.
  • Support the ongoing improvement of candidate and client database functionality.
  • Liaise with external Salesforce consultants, developers and software providers where required.
User Support & Training
  • Act as the first point of contact for Salesforce-related queries and issues.
  • Provide training and guidance to recruitment consultants and internal teams.
  • Develop user guides, process documentation and best-practice materials.
  • Support user adoption of new Salesforce functionality.
  • Gather user feedback and recommend system improvements.
Compliance & Data Security
  • Maintain appropriate data security, access permissions and confidentiality controls.
  • Assist with the configuration and maintenance of recruitment compliance workflows.
  • Ensure candidate and client information is handled securely and appropriately.
Desirable Skills & Experience
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator certification.
  • Previous experience supporting a recruitment agency or staffing business.
  • Experience within UK Education Recruitment.
  • Knowledge of recruitment ATS/CRM systems built on Salesforce, such as Bullhorn for Salesforce, formerly Talent Rover, or other recruitment-focused Salesforce applications.
  • Familiarity with candidate sourcing, vacancy management, placements and onboarding processes.
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations and third-party applications.
  • Experience with advanced Salesforce reporting, dashboards and automation.
  • Familiarity with Agile project management or Salesforce change management processes.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for someone who is:
  • Proactive and solutions-focused: Able to identify system improvements and implement practical solutions.
  • Technically confident: Comfortable managing Salesforce independently and troubleshooting complex issues.
  • Highly organised: Able to manage multiple requests, projects and priorities.
  • Collaborative: Enjoys working with recruitment consultants and stakeholders across different departments.
  • Detail-oriented: Understands the importance of accurate recruitment data and efficient processes.
  • Adaptable: Comfortable working in a fast-paced recruitment environment where priorities can change quickly.
Working Arrangements
This is a fully remote position based in South Africa, supporting a UK-based business.
The successful candidate must be available to work UK business hours and have a reliable internet connection and a suitable home-working environment.
How to Apply
If you are an experienced Salesforce Administrator who enjoys improving systems, streamlining processes and supporting business growth, we would love to hear from you.

  • Minimum 12 months’ experience in a Salesforce Administrator role.

and dashboards.

  • Experience troubleshooting Salesforce issues and supporting end users.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with UK-based stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment during UK business hours.

  • A fully remote opportunity based in South Africa.
  • The opportunity to work with an established UK Education Recruitment business.

• Review and annotate document images to accurately identify text, paragraphs, tables, and other document elements.
  • Correct Optical Character Recognition (OCR) errors, including spelling mistakes, missing characters, formatting inconsistencies, and transcription inaccuracies.
  • Create, review, and adjust bounding boxes to precisely capture text blocks, paragraphs, tables, and other document regions.
  • Transcribe text exactly as it appears in source documents, preserving original characters, symbols, punctuation, diacritics, and formatting.
  • Review and annotate tables, mathematical expressions, and LaTeX equations while maintaining structural and textual accuracy.
  • Apply Markdown formatting consistently to represent document structures, including headings, lists, tables, and other elements.
  • Process multilingual documents while preserving language-specific characters, writing systems, and special symbols.
  • Follow project guidelines and annotation standards to ensure consistent, accurate, and reliable outputs.
  • Identify discrepancies in annotated data and make corrections in accordance with established instructions.
  • Maintain high levels of transcription accuracy and data quality while meeting project deadlines.
  • Review complex document layouts and technical content to ensure the integrity of digitized information.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders and follow quality requirements throughout the document annotation process.
  • Native or near-native proficiency in Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Luxembourgish, Norwegian, Norwegian Bokmål, Norwegian Nynorsk, or Swedish.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify minor errors in text, formatting, and document layouts.
  • Demonstrated ability to transcribe text accurately and reproduce exact characters, punctuation, symbols, tables, and mathematical expressions.
  • Familiarity with OCR text correction, document annotation, bounding box adjustment, or related data quality tasks.
  • Understanding of Markdown formatting and structured document representation.
  • Ability to review multilingual text while preserving special characters, diacritics, and language-specific writing conventions.
  • Strong reading comprehension and the ability to follow detailed instructions and annotation guidelines.
  • Ability to work independently, maintain consistent quality, and meet project deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when identifying discrepancies in document data.
  • Ability to work with complex document layouts, scanned images, tables, mathematical notation, and technical content.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in data annotation, OCR correction, document digitization, transcription, or data quality review.
  • Familiarity with scanned documents, complex layouts, tables, mathematical notation, and LaTeX equations.
  • Experience working with multiple languages, multilingual documents, or non-Latin scripts.
  • Experience following structured quality assurance procedures and annotation guidelines.
  • Ability to maintain high accuracy and consistency when processing large volumes of document data.

An enterprise client is seeking detail-oriented and quality-focused specialists to support document digitization and data accuracy initiatives. The role involves reviewing, annotating, and transcribing text and document regions from scanned images, ensuring accurate representation of written content through OCR correction, bounding box adjustment, and consistent Markdown formatting. The organization is looking for candidates with native or near-native proficiency in Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Luxembourgish, Norwegian, Norwegian Bokmål, Norwegian Nynorsk, or Swedish, strong attention to detail, and the ability to accurately process complex document layouts, tables, mathematical expressions, and multilingual text.

jobs.description:
About Nova Pioneer
Nova Pioneer is a pan-African network of schools reimagining education to develop innovators and leaders who will shape the future. With campuses across Kenya and South Africa, we deliver rigorous, values-driven learning that equips students to thrive in a rapidly changing world. We are extending this impact through blended digital and in-person programmes that help young people thrive after school.
About the Role
We are looking for a senior content leader to hold the quality bar across everything learners see in Quest and Quest Ascend. You will own final editorial review and approval of all learner-facing content before it is published, set the standards the content team works to, and make the judgement calls on what is ready and what is not.
This is an oversight role, not a production role. Content designers and contracted writers produce the material; you decide whether it is good enough, explain why when it is not, and raise the team's capability over time. You will work closely with the PSSP Lead and the content team across Quest, Quest Ascend and Quest Launchpad.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the final editorial review and approval of all learner-facing content across Quest, Quest Ascend and Quest Launchpad before it is published.
  • Set and maintain the content standards covering learning outcomes, voice, reading level, format-specific word limits, factual accuracy and cultural relevance; document them as a style guide the team works to.
  • Review content for pedagogical soundness, ensuring every activity has a clear learning outcome, sensible progression and assessment that measures what it claims to measure.
  • Verify that content intended for AI scoring is structured so that automated evaluation returns accurate, specific and useful feedback to learners.
  • Coach the Content Designer, Content Owner and contracted writers through structured feedback that improves the writer, not only the piece in front of you.
  • Validate the accuracy of post-school, university-application and careers guidance against current requirements in Kenya and the other markets we serve.
  • Run a predictable review cadence with agreed turnaround times and clear approve-or-revise decisions, so that review never becomes the bottleneck in the content pipeline.
  • Audit published content periodically against learner completion data and feedback, and commission revisions where the evidence shows it is not working.
  • Advise the PSSP Lead on content strategy, sequencing and gaps across both products, and flag risks to quality early.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Senior experience in curriculum leadership, instructional design or editorial direction for education products, with a track record of setting standards that others work to.
  • Deep understanding of pedagogy, learning progression and assessment design, with the judgement to tell genuinely good content from content that merely looks finished.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and approving the work of others at volume, with feedback that is specific, actionable and developmental.
  • Excellent command of written English, editorial precision, and the discipline to hold a defined house style consistently across many contributors.
  • Familiarity with digital and blended learning formats, and a practical sense of how content behaves differently on a mobile product than on a page.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, managing a review queue to agreed turnaround times without day-to-day supervision.

CORE SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES


Nice-to-haves
  • Experience in post-school transition, university applications, careers guidance or entrepreneurship education.
  • Experience reviewing AI-generated or AI-assisted learning content, with the judgement to see where automation helps and where it quietly degrades quality.
  • Working knowledge of the Kenyan secondary and tertiary landscape, including CBE pathways, KCSE and university placement.

SUCCESS MEASURES

  • All learner-facing content is reviewed and approved against a documented standard before publication.
  • A content style guide exists, is kept current, and the team works to it without needing individual direction on every piece.
  • Review turnaround keeps pace with production, so content ships on schedule and the pipeline does not stall at approval.
  • Content quality is visible in learner completion and feedback, and revisions can be traced to that evidence.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Excellent communication, attention to detail and a collaborative approach to working with content designers, programme staff and product teams.
  • Commitment to youth safeguarding, learner privacy, accessible learning and the responsible use of AI.
  • Alignment with Nova Pioneer's mission to develop the next generation of African innovators and leaders.

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Title: Sustainable Forest and Management Plan Development for Thamma Raksa Project

Location: Thailand

Team: Operations Asia

Reports to: Project Manager

Status: External Consultant

PUR Description

PUR is a global, impact-focused B-Corp specializing in the development of environmental restoration projects, known as ‘nature-based solutions’ (NbS). Since 2008, we have been helping the world’s largest organizations meet their ESG targets, reduce their environmental footprint, and regenerate the ecosystems they depend on across complex supply chains. Having developed over 45 projects in more than 30 countries, PUR is recognized as both a pioneer and leader in a sector that is now at the forefront of global efforts to address the ongoing climate and biodiversity crisis.

At the heart of our mission is a commitment to fostering and operationalizing insetting strategies—interventions by companies within their own value chains designed to reduce GHG emissions while creating positive impacts for communities, landscapes, and ecosystems. By championing this insetting approach, we aim to create a holistic range of benefits that extend beyond ecological restoration, encompassing social and economic dimensions through enhanced agricultural yields and resilience to climate change-induced stresses, among others.

One of the distinctive features of our work is our ability to tailor projects to the specific needs of different regions and communities. By recognizing the unique characteristics of each ecosystem and the cultural context of the communities involved, we ensure our initiatives are contextually relevant and have a meaningful and sustainable impact. All our projects are developed in close collaboration with local actors, including cooperatives, NGOs, governments, and corporations. Today, we employ 200 staff across 16 countries with key offices in Paris (HQ) and Toronto.

Thamma Raksa Project | PUR

PUR is looking for an experienced Sustainable Forest Management Consultant to support the development of a comprehensive Sustainable Forest Management Plan (SFMP) for the Thamma Raksa Project in Isaan, Thailand.

The project focuses on agroforestry and small-scale forest plantations across several provinces in Northeast Thailand. The consultant will develop practical forest management, selective harvesting, post-harvesting and farmer training approaches that support long-term forest health, carbon storage and farmer needs.

About the Assignment

The main objective of this consultancy is to develop a practical and comprehensive Sustainable Forest Management Plan aligned with:

  • Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) Version 5.0

  • VM0047

  • ABACUS Label

  • Symbiosis Quality Criteria

The plan will cover different planting models, tree species and ecological and socio-economic contexts across Isaan, Thailand.

Key Responsibilities

The consultant will be responsible for:

  • Developing the Sustainable Forest Management Plan for the Thamma Raksa project.

  • Developing appropriate maintenance practices, including pruning, thinning, weeding and pest management.

  • Developing guidelines for selective harvesting, including tree selection, harvesting volumes, timing and methods.

  • Conducting tree growth, biomass and harvesting analysis to support harvesting schedules and carbon-stock projections.

  • Developing recommendations for post-harvesting management, replanting and natural regeneration.

  • Considering Thailand's forestry regulations, land tenure and socio-economic context.

  • Developing a practical monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) framework.

  • Supporting farmer engagement and developing practical training materials.

  • Translating technical recommendations into practical guidance for farmers and field implementation partners.

Key Deliverables

The consultancy will include:

  1. Sustainable Forest Management Plan – English, Word and PDF

  2. Farmer-friendly summaries – English and Thai

  3. Harvesting Schedule & Biomass Growth Impact Dataset – Excel

  4. Farmer Training Modules covering:

    • Site maintenance

    • Selective harvesting

    • Post-harvesting activities

For the detail, please refer to this Term of Reference (ToR)

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience

We are looking for a consultant with:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Forestry, Agroforestry or a related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience developing forest management plans, particularly for small-scale and/or community-based forestry projects.

  • Professional experience in Thailand or Southeast Asia in forestry, agroforestry or natural resource management.

  • Experience working on carbon projects, particularly Verra/VCS, Gold Standard or similar standards.

  • Familiarity with Thailand's forestry policies, land tenure systems and socio-economic context.

  • Experience with stakeholder engagement and participatory planning.

  • Strong experience in selective harvesting, harvesting volume estimation and tree growth analysis.

  • Strong analytical and report-writing skills.

  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

  • Proficiency in relevant technical software, such as GIS and statistical tools.

Consultancy Duration

Approximately 8 weeks, with the assignment commencing as soon as possible.

Key milestones include:

  • Inception Report: within 7 days of contract signing

  • Draft SFMP: 17 November 2026

  • Harvesting & Biomass Dataset: 30 November 2026

  • Final SFMP, summaries and training modules: 5 January 2027

Application Requirements

Interested consultants or consulting firms should submit:

  1. CV of the lead consultant and relevant team members

  2. Technical Proposal – maximum 5 pages, including proposed methodology, work plan and understanding of the assignment

  3. Financial Proposal – including consultancy fees, travel and other associated costs

  4. At least two references from organizations where similar work has been undertaken

Application Deadline

13 October 2026, 23:59 ICT

Applications should be submitted to , with in copy.

Email subject: TR_SFMP_[Organisation Name]

Highlights

Lead sustainable forest management, harvesting & carbon planning for PUR’s Thamma Raksa agroforestry project in Thailand.

KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

  1. Online assessment or practical task

jobs.excerpt: This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones.
jobs.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.

A Different Kind Of Job Description

At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.

What's hard about this job

Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.

Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.

The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.

It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.

Why it might be the best career move you'll make

You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.

Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.

You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.

We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.

What You'll Own

  • Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

  • Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away

  • Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox

  • Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving

  • Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases

  • Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread

Your Hard Skillset

  • Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team

  • Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk

  • A tax background, either at a tax or accounting firm, at a tax software company, or preparing returns yourself. You don't need to be a preparer, but you should know your way around a return.

  • Familiarity with at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem

  • Bonus if you've used Linear or Jira, browser developer tools or screen recording to capture issues

Your Soft Skillset

  • Methodical: you change one thing at a time until you find what breaks

  • Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion

  • Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did

  • Calm and patient with customers who are under deadline pressure

  • You take ownership and follow a problem through to the fix

Who This Suits

  • People who enjoy hunting down a problem more than answering the same question twice

  • Support professionals who want to move into QA and product

  • Tax professionals who want to move into tech without leaving their expertise behind

How We Pay

Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone sees everyone else's salary, and compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone at the same level receives the same three offers.

This role is assessed at Level 1. The salary and equity bandings are:

  • Most Equity: $66,000 per year + $100,020 of equity

  • Great Equity: $72,000 per year + $66,680 of equity

  • Good Equity: $78,000 per year + $33,340 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months, so strong work is recognized quickly.

Benefits

  • Platinum-level medical insurance, fully covered for you, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well

  • Dental insurance

  • Vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

  • A minimum of 30 days of paid holiday every year

  • Your choice of the latest and greatest computers, plus a budget for your home office setup

  • Company-wide offsites every four months

The process

  • Quick intro call (30 minutes)

  • Bug reproduction exercise: we give you a real-style customer report, you reproduce the issue and write the ticket (60 minutes)

  • Final round with Rachel and the team (60 minutes)

About Filed

Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms. It works inside the software firms already use, and takes on the work surrounding the accountant so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and their clients. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog and Raine.

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadFieldstone, an AI-native accounting firm. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Fieldstoneis an accounting firm built from a blank page around an agent fleet. Agents run bookkeeping, reconciliation, workpapers, and first-pass tax returns continuously, and every human in the firm sits in a reviewer seat: applying judgment, signing off, and owning the client relationship. You bring your client relationships and your craft. A FutureSight technical co-founder works alongside you inside the practice, automating the work as you do it, so the product is built from real engagements from day one.

Market Context

US accounting services is a $150B industry, with an estimated $29B serviceable market across 900K US and Canadian businesses in the $1-20M revenue band. Demand is growing while supply collapses: over 300,000 accountants have left the profession since 2020, CPA exam candidates are down more than 30% over the past decade, and roughly 75% of active CPAs are retirement-eligible. Regional firms are turning away mid-market clients because they no longer have the capacity to serve them. That is Fieldstone's entry point.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and agent development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • A technical co-founder embedded in your practice from day one, building the agent fleet around your workflow

  • Venture building resources, including design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across fintech and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Clients: Bring over your founding client base and win new mid-market clients through your network

  • Practice: Own quality of work, review standards, and every client relationship as the firm's lead CPA

  • Product: Work side by side with the technical co-founder, turning your daily workflow into agents and your review corrections into accuracy gains

  • Licensing: Lead firm registration and CPA licensing across US states

  • Capital: Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team: Hire reviewer CPAs and establish the cultural foundation of the firm

Co-Founder Profile

  • Licensed US CPA with partner or senior manager experience at an accounting firm

  • An established book of client relationships you can bring into a new firm

  • Hands-on experimentation with AI tools in your own practice, and conviction that the firm model needs to change

  • Strong business development track record, winning and retaining clients on the strength of your work

  • Product mindset, with the curiosity to break down your own workflow and shape how it gets automated

  • Ability to build an investor narrative and close capital with FutureSight's support

  • Experience in bookkeeping, tax, and advisory for 1M–20M businesses

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadComparo, an AI-native residential appraisal venture.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadComparo, an AI-native residential appraisal venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Comparois an AI-native residential appraisal firm built for independent mortgage banks and private lenders. Today, a lender waits 5 to 10 days for an appraisal that takes under an hour of real analytical work. Comparo collapses that to 24 hours. Homeowners or data collectors capture the property with a phone scan, AI selects comparables, runs adjustments and drafts the full report, and a licensed appraiser reviews and signs. Comparo sells the finished, UAD 3.6-compliant appraisal rather than software, so it owns the workflow end to end and captures the full per-report fee. The same engine extends to tax appeals, insurance, estate valuations and continuous portfolio revaluation for lenders and mortgage-backed asset holders.

Market Context

The US residential appraisal industry is an $8.8-11.4B market, with roughly 5 million appraisals completed each year at $400-700 per report. Mortgage appraisals ordered by independent mortgage banks and private lenders represent a $1.5-2.1B serviceable market. The timing is sharp: UAD 3.6 becomes mandatory on November 2, 2026, expanding each report from roughly 700 to 3,600 data fields, while an aging workforce of 75,000–80,000 licensed appraisers shrinks.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across fintech, proptech and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with independent mortgage banks and private lenders, convert them to paid engagements, secure approved-panel status, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.

This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. You'll execute hands-on, with internal and external support, and tie every event back to pipeline and revenue goals. We're an experimentation-heavy culture. You'll be given room to ideate, experiment, measure, and repeat what works.

This is a manager-level individual contributor role. You already know how to set goals, manage a budget, and partner across teams, and you'll bring that experience on day one.

What You'll Do

  • Own the events portfolio: build the calendar across industry events, owned events, customer events, and field marketing, and decide where to place bets.

  • Run logistics end to end: venues, budgets, vendors, contractors, staffing, and the on-the-ground run of show.

  • Experiment deliberately and iterate quickly: test new formats, venues, and target audiences, and kill what doesn't work.

  • Get the right targets in the room and at our booth. Great events don't stop at a project plan; they rely on driving high-value attendees.

  • Connect events to revenue: define what success looks like for each event, track pipeline and revenue impact, and report results back to the business.

  • Partner cross-functionally: work closely with demand gen, product marketing, sales, CS, and business operations to align events with GTM priorities.

  • Manage event budgets and vendor relationships: negotiate contracts, manage contractor relationships, and keep spend accountable.

  • Build the playbook: turn what's worked into repeatable processes so the program scales as the business grows.

  • Represent events at the leadership level: bring recommendations and results directly to company leadership.

  • Source speaking opportunities at relevant industry and public events for executive leadership, including content submissions as needed.

Who You Are

  • 4-7+ years running B2B events in a fast-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.

  • You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.

  • You think like a marketer first and an event planner second: every event ties back to organizational goals.

  • You've worked closely with partners in Sales, Customer Success, and Executives.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. This program is evolving, and you'll be instrumental in building the playbooks and processes.

  • Bonus: experience in construction, home services, or a related built-world industry.

  • Bonus: experience at a startup or in AI, and genuine interest in how physical infrastructure gets built.

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist, Tax
jobs.excerpt: This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones.
jobs.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.

A Different Kind Of Job Description

At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.

What's hard about this job

The pace is fast. We're a young company growing quickly, and our customers are tax firms in the middle of their busiest weeks. When something isn't working for them, they need an answer today, not next week.

Tax season is tax season. You've lived it as a preparer, so you know. January to April is our busiest stretch too. The difference is that you'll be the one helping hundreds of preparers get through it, not grinding through your own stack.

Not every answer is in a help doc yet. We're building the playbook as we go. Some days you'll be the first person to see a problem, and you'll need to work out what's happening before anyone else can.

Customers aren't always calm. A preparer with a deadline and a stuck return isn't at their most patient. You'll need to stay steady, clear and kind when they're not.

Why it might be the best career move you'll make

You've done the work, so you're the one they trust. Most support teams can't tell a K-1 from a W-2. You can. When a firm calls in, you understand their problem in the first minute, and that makes you far more valuable than a typical support hire.

You'll learn how software gets built. You'll write the tickets our engineers work from, reproduce issues and test the fixes. Few roles give a tax professional this much exposure to how a product is made. People who start here move into QA, product, onboarding and customer success.

You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support team is still small. The people who join now will help shape how it's built and who it hires next.

You'll see the impact immediately. A workaround you find on Tuesday saves a firm hours on Wednesday. A ticket you write becomes a fix that every firm on the platform benefits from.

We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.

What You'll Own

As a Technical Support Specialist, you're the person a firm reaches when something isn't working, and the person who makes sure it gets fixed properly:

  • Answering customer questions quickly and clearly, in the support inbox and on calls

  • Troubleshooting issues inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

  • Reproducing problems so engineering can see exactly what the customer saw

  • Writing clear, complete Linear tickets that engineers can act on straight away

  • Finding workarounds that keep firms moving while the fix is being built

  • Spotting patterns in what customers report and flagging them before they spread

Your Hard Skillset

  • You've worked as a tax preparer and know what a correct return looks like

  • Experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk, and you're used to replying fast without cutting corners

  • Some QA or technical background: testing software, reproducing bugs, or writing up issues for a technical team

  • Comfortable in at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem

  • Bonus if you've written bug reports or worked in Linear, Jira or a similar tool

Your Soft Skillset

  • Calm under pressure, and patient with people who are stressed

  • Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion

  • Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did

  • Organized enough to juggle many open conversations without dropping any

  • You take ownership and follow a problem through to the end

Who This Suits

  • People who like solving problems more than they like preparing returns

  • People who want to move from tax into tech without leaving their expertise behind

  • People who want to grow quickly in a company that's growing quickly

How We Pay

Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone sees everyone else's salary, and compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone at the same level receives the same three offers.

This role is assessed at Level 1. The salary and equity bandings are:

  • Most Equity: $66,000 per year + $100,020 of equity

  • Great Equity: $72,000 per year + $66,680 of equity

  • Good Equity: $78,000 per year + $33,340 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months, so strong work is recognized quickly.

Benefits

  • Platinum-level medical insurance, fully covered for you, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well

  • Dental insurance

  • Vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

  • A minimum of 30 days of paid holiday every year

  • Your choice of the latest and greatest computers, plus a budget for your home office setup

  • Company-wide offsites every four months

The process

  • Quick intro call (30 minutes)

  • Support scenario exercise: a real-style customer issue to troubleshoot and write up (60 minutes)

  • Final round with Rachel and the team (60 minutes)

About Filed

Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms. It works inside the software firms already use, and takes on the work surrounding the accountant so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and their clients. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog and Raine.
