jobs.excerpt: As the APAC Partnerships & Ecosystems Leader at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just managing a channel; you are building our entire route to market in the region from scratch.
jobs.description:
As the APAC Partnerships & Ecosystems Leader at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just managing a channel; you are building our entire route to market in the region from scratch. Almost every AI Factory in Asia Pacific is sold through a partner, and there is no partner team in APAC today. You will be that team. You’ll sign the partners already selling AI Factories, turn them into pipeline our AEs accept and close, and own the number that comes with it. The pipeline you build pays for the next hires on your team.

As the APAC Partnerships & Ecosystems Leader, your role will include:

  • Partner recruitment and executive relationships: You’ll use your existing network to recruit and activate the top SIs, MSPs, VARs, OEMs and distributors across ASEAN, Japan, Korea, India and ANZ, along with NVIDIA’s regional and country teams. You’ll keep the portfolio small and go deep with each partner. Every one gets a signed agreement, a joint business plan with targets you both sign, and sellers who are enabled to sell vCluster.

  • Distribution and the MSP route: You’ll set up two-tier distribution through TD SYNNEX or a regional distributor, covering pricing and margin, services attach, deal registration, MDF and onboarding. MSPs and VARs will transact through it, and you’ll get vCluster and vMetal onto the OEM and NVIDIA reference configurations that partners sell in the region.

  • Co-sell and multi-party pursuits: You’ll run account mapping and joint pipeline with our AEs, and adapt the AI Factory Blueprint and Sovereign AI Infrastructure plays to each market. You’ll lead pursuits where an SI or MSP brings NVIDIA, the OEM, storage and vCluster together for one customer. POCs are time-boxed with written success criteria, and every pursuit has one partner of record.

  • Partner enablement: You’ll build sales, technical and go-to-market enablement that scales: plays, training, certifications and demo environments. You’ll also create an APAC partner playbook that partner sellers actually use. On the first call for any opportunity, you’ll confirm the tenancy model with Partner Solutions Engineering. Private nodes back every external, customer-facing service.

  • Forecast and operating rhythm: Every Monday you’ll review partner performance, pipeline and forecast using MEDDPICC. You’ll call each deal commit, likely or stretch, act quickly when something slips, and keep a scorecard the CEO can read in five minutes.

  • The voice of APAC in product: You’ll bring regional requirements back to product, such as data residency, sovereign security standards, local support, and regional hardware and network vendors. You’ll also help win a sovereign or telco AI Factory with a partner and publish it as a joint reference.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • APAC partner leadership: 12+ years in partner, channel or alliances roles in infrastructure software, cloud, IaaS or AI, with 5+ of those years covering APAC. You’ve driven cloud or IaaS revenue through partners and opened a region or partner motion from zero. Be ready to name the deals you sourced yourself.

  • A network you can use today: You have current relationships across APAC SIs, MSPs, VARs and distributors, plus NVIDIA regional teams and at least one server OEM (Dell, HPE or Supermicro).

  • Hands-on program building: You’ve built two-tier distribution and MSP programs yourself, including margin structures, deal registration, MDF and services attach.

  • How AI infrastructure gets bought in the region: You know the procurement cycles, local partner requirements, and government and regulated-industry expectations at AI Clouds, telcos and sovereign AI programs.

  • Enough technical depth to be credible: You understand cloud infrastructure well, with depth in GPU, HPC, Kubernetes or bare metal. That’s enough to hold your own with partner architects and turn what you learn into a CFO business case.

  • Forecasting discipline and autonomy: You qualify with MEDDPICC or an equivalent, forecast cleanly, and work on your own across time zones with a US-based leadership team. You communicate well with executives in fluent English.

Bonus points for:

  • Languages: Japanese, Korean or Mandarin.

  • Reference configurations: You’ve gotten a software product onto an OEM or NVIDIA reference architecture.

  • Sovereign or telco wins: You’ve closed a sovereign AI or telco AI Factory deal through a partner.

Location and travel: Singapore, Korea, Japan or another major APAC market. We’re flexible for the right person. Expect up to 40% travel across the region, plus NVIDIA GTC, SC, KubeCon and regional AI infrastructure events. Reports to the VP, Worldwide Partnerships & Ecosystems

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

You will design the guardrails, automation, and AI-powered tooling that let engineering teams ship securely by default, and you will prove they work with data.

You will work as a peer to engineering, architecture, and DevOps leaders and own outcomes across secure SDLC, CI/CD and supply chain integrity, WAF/WAAP and API protection, and AI/LLM security. The right person sees a recurring problem and builds the capability that makes it go away.


What you’ll do:

Secure SDLC & DevSecOps

  • Build security into the SDLC as paved roads, so the secure path is the easiest path for every engineering team.
  • Define the secure coding standards and reference patterns that teams across the enterprise build against.
  • Build the vulnerability prioritization capability that shows where real risk sits across code, pipelines, and deployed services, and drive remediation to measurable closure.
  • Establish a threat modeling practice for applications, APIs, and delivery pipelines that scale beyond a single team.

CI/CD & software supply chain security

  • Architect the security control layer for our CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps) so every pipeline inherits it by default.
  • Design the automated testing pipeline that runs SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning on every build, tuned for signal over noise.
  • Build the automation that keeps our attack surface visible: API discovery, dependency scanning, SBOM generation, and secrets detection.

AI/LLM security & AI-powered automation

  • Build reusable AI agent skills and workflows inside CI/CD (e.g., agentic coding tools, MCP-based integrations) that review every pull request for insecure patterns, authN/authZ gaps, secrets exposure, and risky dependency changes, and deliver CWE/OWASP-mapped findings developers can act on.
  • Build AI-driven security testing that generates targeted test cases (API abuse cases, fuzzing inputs, prompt-injection and jailbreak suites), triages SAST/SCA/DAST results to cut false positives and proposes remediation PRs for human review.
  • Define the guardrails AI agents operate under our pipelines: least-privilege tokens, human-in-the-loop approval, output-accuracy evaluation, and audit logging.
  • Build the AI-specific scanning capability that catches insecure LLM orchestration patterns before they ship.
  • Establish a reusable threat modeling approach for RAG architectures and autonomous agents.
  • Define the framework for secure AI adoption in enterprise applications, covering data security, access controls, model input/output handling, and misuse prevention.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph and similar orchestration frameworks

Partnership & enablement

  • Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives end-to-end, taking ownership of tasks, deliverables, and outcomes.
  • Shape product, platform, and DevOps roadmaps as trusted advisors, translating technical risk into business decisions.
  • Choose, implement, and prove the tooling that closes the gaps we have today, with metrics that show the impact.
  • Grow security capability inside engineering teams through mentoring secure coding and pipeline practices.
  • Help scale the Security Champions program into a self-sustaining network.

What you need to bring:

  • 6+ years in Application Security, Product Security, or Secure Software Development, with a track record of building capabilities, not only operating them.
  • Has designed security controls for CI/CD pipelines and source repositories (GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar) at scale.
  • Has built and tuned SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning, so developers trust and act on the results.
  • Has built and tuned WAF and API protections and driven vulnerability remediation to closure.
  • Applies SLSA and NIST SSDF to design build integrity, including secrets management and artifact signing.
  • Has designed security controls in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10 (Web & API), CWE, and secure coding practices.
  • Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.

Preferred

  • Has built LLM-powered developer or security tooling, including prompt/skill design, tool and MCP integration, and evaluation of output quality and false-positive rates.
  • Has implemented signing and provenance with Sigstore/Cosign or similar tooling.
  • Integrate SBOM generation and SCA into CI/CD workflows.
  • Has deployed runtime protection (API security platforms, RASP, container EDR).
  • Has built GitOps, IaC scanning (Terraform, CloudFormation), and policy-as-code guardrails.
  • Has led or shaped response to software supply chain or dependency poisoning incidents.
  • Relevant certifications: OSWE, CSSLP, GPCS, GWEB, GCSA.
  • Writes production-quality code in at least one language (Python, Java, Go, or JavaScript/Node.js) to build automation and tooling.

Soft skills

  • Influences developers, DevOps engineers, and leadership through clear communication and well-built tooling, not mandates.
  • Automation-first: if a task happens twice, you build the capability that removes it.
  • Measures success by outcomes, balancing security with delivery velocity.

jobs.description:
USA TODAY is looking for an innovative, high-energy, data-driven Audience Editor to lead audience engagement strategy for our Sports coverage.

As a key member of our reimagined USA TODAY audience team, you will utilize your expertise to enhance audience growth, discoverability and revenue generation for USA TODAY Sports. This role is right for you if you live and breathe sports, understand how audiences discover and engage with sports journalism, and are constantly exploring what is next across social media, video, newsletters, search and emerging platforms. You are both a strategist and an experimenter, combining strong news judgment with audience insights to test new approaches, identify opportunities and turn successful ideas into repeatable practices.

The ideal candidate is as comfortable interpreting data and platform analytics as they are connecting with audiences on TikTok, Reddit, Instagram or through a newsletter. You understand that the audience is at the heart of everything we do. You will also be expected to monitor trends in the broader creator industry and identify ways to translate relevant tactics into strategies for our newsrooms.

This highly-collaborative role will be accountable for translating broader business and newsroom strategies into actionable steps for the journalists on Sports team. The successful candidate will oversee a small team of content creators to put our best foot forward at every step of the audience journey. As such, you should be comfortable leading through both direct management and influence, building productive relationships with peers and partners throughout the organization.

We recognize that culture change is challenging, and the right editor will embrace the opportunity to introduce new ideas, improve established practices and help colleagues adapt to a rapidly evolving audience landscape. You will bring energy, resilience and a commitment to turning strategy into measurable action.

This role may require working extended hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays, sometimes unexpectedly, when news requires it.   This role is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska, Hawaii and Wyoming. If you live near one of our local newsrooms, you may have the option to use that as a base of operations.  

Responsibilities:

Develop strategies, workflows and best practices to rapidly achieve audience growth and increase discoverability through social, newsletters, emerging platforms and search in collaboration with the greater USA TODAY audience team and the USA TODAY Sports leadership team.   Monitor analytics for USA TODAY Sports both on platform and on social, in newsletters and alerts, translating that data into action steps for journalists on your direct team and on the broader Sports team. Lead audience planning for major sporting events, tentpoles and breaking news, determining how journalism should be packaged, distributed and presented at each stage of the audience journey. Create, edit or optimize audience-focused content during major events and breaking news when needed. Partner crossdivisionally on new efforts to monetize our journalism and grow audience on social media and distributed platform channels. Manage a team of content creators charged with ensuring consistent brand strategy, voice and execution across platforms for USA TODAY Sports, including social channels, newsletters, section fronts, app alerts and wherever our journalism meets the audience. Create and monitor reporting and KPI progress, including metrics for loyalty, engagement, relevance and other business goals. Be an innovative, creative thinker that is willing to experiment to support company's goals. 

Requirements: 

Bachelor's or master’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.  At least 5 years of newsroom experience, preferably in an audience development role at a digitally-focused media organization with expertise in entertainment. Journalism experience and prior management experience are mandatory. A proven passion and experience with storytelling via social media, search and newsletters, with expertise in platforms such as Reddit, Discord, WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Threads and more. Passion for helping news organizations distribute indispensable journalism and building trusted relationships with readers. Proactive leader that can manage their time and prioritization of tasks independently.

Application Instructions We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

  • Your resume – one to two pages. 2. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

#LI - Remote The annualized base salary for this role will range between $93,000 and $95,000.  Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

jobs.excerpt: The Sr.  Paid Search Specialist role is focused on defining strategy and driving success for top brands across the National, Enterprise and Multi-Location team.
jobs.description:
The Sr. Paid Search Specialist role is focused on defining strategy and driving success for top brands across the National, Enterprise and Multi-Location team. In this role, you will act as an advisor and investigator, understanding the clients’ business goals, analyzing current campaigns, the results, the set up, and recommending modifications and appropriate capabilities and implementation skillsets needed to help achieve set benchmarks.  This role will own the strategic recommendation elements to help campaigns reach client goals. This role will also take an active role in our pre-sales process and in making initial client recommendations prior to onboarding. The role we play is significant and we strive to exceed our goals and client expectations, while learning, growing, and having fun as a team along the way. Are you in? Come talk to us, we would love to tell you more!

About the job:

The Senior Paid Search Strategist will focus efforts around four core functions:

Discovery Implementation Optimization Results Leveraging our in-house reporting dashboards, you will identify and select campaigns to review based on shortfalls you see from established client expectations. In other circumstances, cases will come directly to you from our Sales and Brand Management team, soliciting your advice on recommendations to correct campaign performance. Some brands will be existing, while new, large brands will be also folded in as they are closed by our sales team. Our brands today are primarily focused on SEM, and you will work to ensure that this tactic is delivering stellar results across each brand and account within the brand, while helping to partner with colleagues to make strategic recommendations on how to diversify this approach through other advertising platforms. Recommended changes will then be implemented.   Whether helping implement the changes directly or delegating tasks to associated client success managers attached to the brands, you will be accountable for ensuring implementation is completed correctly.  From there, continuous optimization will occur with consistent reviews that you will conduct leveraging reporting tools to help tell the story to clients. Results will then be shared with internal and external clients.  Using the same reporting platforms, we will share results and format it in such a way that it tells a story and provides clients valuable insights and recommendations. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports and will own the strategic elements of the client relationship while the current/existing managers will own people management of teams and execution disciplines.

Expectations:  You must have applied experience in SEM at an expert level, with an advanced knowledge of shopping ads and paid search ads outside of search engine platforms, such as Yelp and Amazon. You should also have a cross-section of skills spanning: 

Advertising Strategy Project Management Technology Attention to detail Consumer Insights Analytics Implementation of Data -Driven Decisions

Responsibilities:

Day-to-Day:

Develop and execute effective SEM and paid search strategies that align with clients’ goals and objectives. Conduct in-depth keyword research to identify high-value keywords and phrases for both organic and paid search campaigns. Oversee paid search campaigns, including budget management, ad copywriting, bid optimization, and performance tracking. Monitor and analyze performance metrics using tools like Google Analytics, Google Ads, and internal software, and provide regular reports to external and internal stakeholders. Stay current with industry trends, algorithm updates, and best practices in search marketing to ensure compliance and effectiveness. Conduct competitive analysis to identify opportunities and threats in the search marketing landscape. Collaborate with client or internal web development and UX teams to optimize landing pages and user experiences for improved conversion rates. Manage the search marketing budget, allocating effectively to maximize ROI. Foster cross-functional collaboration with other departments, such as sales, post-sales, creative, data science, customer experience and others, to integrate search marketing efforts with broader business objectives. Identify areas for improvement, conduct A/B testing, and implement optimization strategies to enhance clients’ SEM performance.

Strategy:

Digital Strategy - Act as an advisor, analyzing current campaigns, the results, the set up, and recommending modifications needed to help achieve set benchmarks. Provide proactive commentary on the overall health of an account, drive strategy, and actively make recommendations as appropriate. Plan & coordinate meetings with clients, and internal teams to ensure all strategic recommendations are shared, along with the campaign story of performance changes. Dive deep into campaign goals and make recommendations to help achieve results Partner with Data Science to build complementing reporting aspects related to campaign performance insights where needed.

Product:

Evolving Digital Marketing Landscape - Stay abreast of new and evolving digital marketing concepts, specifically related to Search, and develop and facilitate training sessions for team members to understand the evolving digital marketing concepts. Help to advise, even construct, Search proposals for new brands/RFPs or through the identified gaps in existing campaigns

jobs.description:
ABA Recruiter - Existing Market RBT Programs

Denver, CO | Full Time | Onsite

About the role
FronteraCare is seeking an experienced Recruiter to own and scale our Registered Behavior Technician hiring across our existing markets. Few workflows in our business have as direct a line to patient care as RBT recruiting: every RBT hired is a child who can start or continue therapy, which makes this one of the most impactful roles at FronteraCare. This is a high-volume role for someone who has already built strong recruiting instincts and is ready to take a program that's up and running and push it further, improving speed, quality, and consistency as we grow. You'll travel to New Mexico periodically to stay close to the market and the teams you're hiring for.

You'll report to the Talent Lead and work alongside a Recruiter focused on emerging markets, with this role dedicated specifically to owning full-cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles in FronteraCare's established markets. This is a great fit for someone who thrives in high-volume, fast-moving recruiting environments, finds genuine reward in the grind of consistent high-volume hiring, and brings both process discipline and compassion to every candidate interaction.

What is ABA?
Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) is a therapy that uses evidence-based techniques to help children with autism build communication, social, and daily living skills. Care is typically delivered one-on-one by Behavior Technicians and Registered Behavior Technicians under the guidance of a licensed Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), with progress tracked closely so each child's plan can be adjusted as they grow.

What you'll do

  • Own full cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles across FronteraCare's existing markets, from sourcing and screening through offer and onboarding handoff

  • Take ownership of established sourcing channels and candidate pipelines, refining and scaling what's already working rather than building from scratch

  • Maintain a high, consistent volume of active requisitions, balancing speed with quality in a fast-moving, high-turnover talent pool

  • Travel to New Mexico periodically to build local candidate and community relationships and stay close to market conditions

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, clinical leaders, BCBAs, and current RBTs to stay close to market needs, referral opportunities, and what makes candidates want to join and stay

  • Partner with the Talent Lead, the emerging markets Recruiter, onboarding, and HR to keep processes efficient and aligned across the broader recruiting team

  • Proactively source candidates using Indeed and other established sourcing platforms, with an eye toward continuous improvement of what's already in place

  • Post job openings on job boards and social media channels

  • Coordinate and schedule interviews, manage calendars, and lead candidate communications

  • Maintain accurate candidate records in Greenhouse and track key recruiting metrics

  • Support additional recruiting projects and initiatives as needed to help the team meet its hiring goals


What you'll bring

  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field

  • 3-5 years of recruiting experience in a high-volume setting, ideally in healthcare or behavioral health

  • Demonstrated experience recruiting for junior or entry-level profiles, with a genuine appreciation for the pace and repetition that high-volume hiring requires

  • A track record of taking an existing recruiting program and improving its speed, quality, or scale

  • Familiarity with sourcing tools such as Indeed, as well as applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse experience a plus)

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

  • Willingness and ability to travel to New Mexico periodically

  • A compassionate, people-first mindset, with genuine care for candidates and the families we serve

Bonus points

  • Experience recruiting for ABA roles or knowledge of Applied Behavior Analysis is highly valued

  • Bilingual in English/Spanish

  • Agency and internal recruitment experience

FronteraCare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

At Frontera, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and safe—period. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to maintaining an environment where harassment, discrimination, and retaliation have no place.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Discover your 100% YOU with MicroSourcing!


﻿Position: Mid Graphic Designer
Work setup & shift: Remote | Day ﻿Shift

Why join MicroSourcing?

You'll have:

Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses
A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities.
Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements.
Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a team that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture.

Your Role:

As a Mid Graphic Designer, you will:

  • Catalog Layout (InDesign): Build and format multi-page catalog spreads based on supplied pagination maps; apply creative offer layouts according to brand style guides.
  • Email & Web Asset Production: Layout promotional email offers inside established templates; crop, slice, and optimize images in Photoshop for web integration.
  • Image Processing & Asset Management: Color-correct and retouch library images; generate web-ready image variations and maintain organized file archives.
  • In-Store Ticket Generation: Create store pricing signage and offer tickets using Adobe InDesign and automated mail merge processes.
  • Proofing & Compliance: Self-audit artwork to verify pricing, copy, and offer accuracy; export and upload PDFs to digital proofing/annotation software (e.g., Ziflow, Workfront Proof).
  • Studio Workflow & Collaboration: Complete daily ad-hoc design tasks, take creative direction from Senior Designers or the Art Director, participate in daily Teams catch-ups, and submit end-of-day progress reports.

What You Need:

Non-negotiables

  • Software Mastery: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud—specifically Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • InDesign Production Features: Practical experience utilizing InDesign Mail Merge, style sheets (paragraph/character styles), and master pages for high-volume artwork generation.
  • Pre-Press & Proofing Attention to Detail: Exceptional self-editing skills to catch typographical errors, incorrect pricing, and broken layout structures before upload.
  • Digital Image Optimization: Understanding of color modes (CMYK vs. RGB), image slicing in Photoshop, resolution standards (DPI/PPI), and web asset export settings.
  • Communication & Accountability: Ability to follow studio processes, respond to creative feedback, attend daily check-ins, and deliver structured end-of-day logs.

Preferred skills/expertise

  • Prior experience in a high-volume retail design studio, e-commerce brand, or marketing agency environment.
  • Hands-on experience using online PDF annotation platforms (e.g., ProofHQ/Workfront Proof, Ziflow, or PageProof).
  • Knowledge of retail ticketing systems, POS signage, or database-driven print automation.
  • Willingness to take feedback and adapt quickly in a fast-paced production setting.

﻿-

With over 9,000 professionals across 13 delivery centers, MicroSourcing is the pioneer and largest offshore provider of managed services in the Philippines.

Our commitment to 100% YOU

MicroSourcing firmly believes that our company's strength lies in our people's diversity and talent. We are proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces individuals of all races, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and backgrounds. We provide space for everyone, embracing different perspectives, and making room for opportunities for each individual to thrive.

At MicroSourcing, equality is not merely a slogan - it's our commitment. Our way of life. Here, we don't just accept your unique, authentic self - we celebrate it, valuing every individual's contribution to our collective success and growth. Join us in celebrating YOU and your 100%!

Level 3 IT Technician

Why Digacore?

We’re a fast-paced, people-first MSP recently recognized as one of New Jersey’s Top Workplaces for 2026, with:

• Real career growth

• Autonomy to own projects and make decisions
• A collaborative culture (we back each other up — no egos)
• Paid certs, strong leadership support, and a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together

About the Role

Are you the engineer people rely on when complex issues need to be solved the right way? We’re looking for a Level 3 IT Technician to provide advanced technical support, handle escalations, and help maintain reliable, secure, and high-performing client environments.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong troubleshooting skills with professionalism, ownership, and a great client experience. You’ll work across servers, networking, cloud platforms, virtualization, and security while partnering closely with both internal teams and clients to resolve issues efficiently and thoroughly.

What You’ll Do

  • Handle advanced escalations and provide technical support for complex infrastructure and networking issues
    • Troubleshoot and support Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, and Azure environments
    • Configure and manage file shares, permissions, SharePoint environments, and identity-related services
    • Troubleshoot firewalls, VPNs, switching, routing, Wi-Fi, and site-wide networking issues
    • Support virtualization platforms including VMware, Hyper-V, and AVD environments
    • Use PowerShell and automation tools to streamline administration and operational tasks
    • Maintain strong documentation, communication, and operational follow-through across support requests and escalations
    • Collaborate with L1, L2, Projects, and Engineering teams to resolve issues and improve overall service delivery
    • Help identify recurring technical issues and contribute to operational improvements and standardization efforts
    • Deliver a high-quality support experience through professionalism, responsiveness, and technical ownership

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in an MSP or similar IT services environment
    • Strong experience with Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, DNS, and networking technologies
    • Experience troubleshooting complex server, firewall, VPN, wireless, and infrastructure-related issues
    • Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, and Azure Virtual Desktop
    • Experience working within RMM and PSA platforms
    • Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience preferred
    • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm under pressure
    • Strong communication skills and a professional, client-focused mindset
    • Strong documentation habits and operational follow-through
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience preferred

  • Competitive salary + $500 sign-on bonus
  • Medical & dental insurance — company covers 50% of employee premium

  • Company-provided equipment
  • Employee referral bonus
  • Employee recognition program
  • Paid training & certification assistance
  • Clear career advancement pathways

jobs.excerpt: About AbridgeFounded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care.
jobs.description:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge is hiring Members of Technical Staff to join our Strategic Research team. We are looking for candidates who combine strong computational and quantitative research skills with a deep understanding of clinical care—and who want to apply these skills in translational research to develop better clinical AI, establish better evidence, and support better care delivery.

You may be a clinician-engineer or clinician informaticist with an established record of high-impact research, or a computational scientist who has years of experience working closely with clinicians and health systems. You understand how care is delivered, have worked extensively with clinical data, and can lead scientific collaborations with experienced researchers and clinical leaders across health systems and research institutions.

In this role, you will drive research studies of Abridge models and products in partnership with health systems, leveraging large-scale clinical conversation data to generate new insights about care delivery, documentation quality, clinical decision-making, and downstream patient outcomes. Working closely with our science and product teams, your work will inform model development and evaluation frameworks. Your work will contribute to broader scientific understanding of how clinical AI systems affect patients and providers in the real world. Potential directions include evaluating clinical AI, measuring care quality and patient-clinician communication, developing feedback tools for medical education, and generating real world evidence from clinical conversations alongside electronic health records. You will help identify which questions matter most and develop methods and prototypes that can inform Abridge’s products.

About Strategic Research: The Strategic Research team at Abridge designs and conducts rigorous research to understand and improve the impact of ambient AI in clinical care, and supports external research efforts that use Abridge data. In addition to driving and supporting empirical studies of the impact of ambient AI-enabled technologies, the team works closely with our science and engineering teams on AI development and evaluation. The common thread to all our work is ensuring that every partner-facing research initiative meets the highest standards of rigour, credibility, and strategic value.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify clinically important research questions and lead projects from initial formulation through study design, implementation, analysis, and publication.

  • Engage with external researchers and other stakeholders on designing and conducting research on ambient AI and research that leverages Abridge data.
    Take ownership of moving research forward, working with collaborators to resolve data, tooling, and study-execution blockers and adapting plans when needed.

  • Develop a strong user-centric and patient-centric mindset, grounding the research in empathy for the real world experience of providers and patients

  • Work directly with clinical and product teams to ground research in real workflows and translate findings into product decisions and capabilities.

  • Write technical reports and give presentations to internal and external stakeholders

  • Actively contribute to the wider research community by publishing original research in leading peer-reviewed publication venues

  • Mentor research interns

What You’ll Bring

  • MD, PhD, or equivalent research background. Relevant PhD fields include computer science, biomedical or clinical informatics, statistics, biostatistics, and related disciplines. Physician applicants should bring substantial quantitative or computational research experience; a PhD is not required.

  • 3+ years of research experience within clinical environments or through sustained collaboration with clinicians and health systems in addition to research conducted during doctorate studies. This experience may include, but is not limited to, work conducted during research or clinical training.

  • Prior experience with applying ML/NLP methods to unstructured text data, as evidenced by significant coursework or research publications.

  • A strong record of leading rigorous research in clinical informatics, AI in healthcare, or related fields, demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications in top venues and clear ownership of the underlying work.

  • Strong judgment about clinical data and study design: you recognize when an outcome is poorly measured, a study is confounded, or an evaluation does not support the intended clinical claim.

  • The ability to lead substantive scientific discussions with experienced clinical investigators and researchers, explain methodological tradeoffs clearly, and build productive collaborations.

  • Rigor at speed. You can scope and execute scientifically rigorous work under compressed timelines. You make thoughtful tradeoffs to deliver credible evidence where and when it is needed most.

  • A problem-before-method mindset. You do not change the question to make it amenable to simple analysis. You use established methods when they are sufficient, learn unfamiliar approaches when needed, and develop new methods when existing ones fall short.

Must be willing to work from our New York City office at least 3x per week.

This position requires a commitment to a hybrid work model, with the expectation of coming into the office a minimum of (3) three times per week. Relocation assistance is available for candidates willing to move to New York City.

We value people who want to learn new things, and we know that great team members might not perfectly match a job description. If you’re interested in the role but aren’t sure whether or not you’re a good fit, we’d still like to hear from you.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Lead Software Engineer

Rocky Mountain Reserve | Remote | Full-Time

About Rocky Mountain Reserve

Rocky Mountain Reserve is a benefits administration company specializing in HSAs, FSAs, HRAs, and other consumer-directed benefit accounts. We help employers and employees get the most out of their benefits through great service and great technology. We're investing heavily in our engineering capabilities and are looking for a technical leader to help us build faster and smarter.

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer who represents the best of both worlds: someone who has fully embraced AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and similar) to ship software at a pace that wasn't possible a few years ago — and someone with the engineering depth to know exactly where those tools fall short.

You know the difference between moving fast and "vibe coding." You understand that AI-generated code still needs architecture, testing, security review, and thoughtful design — especially in a regulated industry handling sensitive health and financial data. And you're excited to teach others how to work this way.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll write code, set technical direction, and mentor our existing development team as they adopt AI-assisted workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and ship features across our benefits administration platform using modern, AI-accelerated development workflows
  • Establish best practices for AI-assisted development: when to lean on the tools, when to slow down, and how to review and validate generated code
  • Mentor and upskill our existing engineering team in using tools like Claude Code effectively and responsibly
  • Own architectural decisions and ensure our systems remain maintainable, secure, and scalable as development velocity increases
  • Champion engineering rigor — testing, code review, documentation, and observability — in an AI-augmented workflow
  • Help ensure our systems and processes meet HIPAA and SOC 2 requirements, working alongside our compliance team
  • Contribute to hiring and team growth as we scale

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a lead or senior role
  • Demonstrated, hands-on fluency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) in real production work — not just experimentation
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, testing strategy, code review, and debugging skills that let you catch what AI tools miss
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team
  • Experience building and operating production systems that handle sensitive data

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience in benefits, payroll, fintech, or HR tech — companies like Rippling, Gusto, Justworks, Lively, HealthEquity, or similar
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA compliance and SOC 2 audit processes from an engineering perspective
  • Experience integrating with financial systems (banking rails, custodial accounts, payment processing)
  • Familiarity with the consumer-directed benefits space (HSA/FSA/HRA/COBRA administration)

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 months: You're shipping meaningful features and have assessed our team's current workflows and tooling
  • Within 6 months: The team has adopted AI-assisted development practices you've established, with measurable improvements in velocity — without sacrificing quality or compliance posture
  • Within 12 months: You've built a development culture that moves fast, ships confidently, and serves as a model for how a regulated-industry engineering team can leverage AI

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Total Salary & Bonus Compensation: $175,000 – $225,000
  • Performance Bonus Eligible based on company and individual performance. RMR is a privately held company with no debt or outside investors. We don’t offer equity because we aren’t looking for the boom and bust of the VC world nor are we interested in going public or taking PE money. We are a profitable, stable company and rather than lottery ticket RSUs we pay fair base salaries with generous performance bonuses so that when the company makes money so do you.

  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • FSA & HSA Accounts

DESCRIPTION DE POSTE

Titre : Coordonnateur(trice) du programme course sur route et sentiers
Emplacement : travail à distance – Canada
Superviseur(e) immédiat(e) : Gestionnaire du marketing et des événements (Programmes nationaux)
Type d'emploi : Contractuel

Durée : 12 mois

VUE D’ENSEMBLE

Athlétisme Canada est l'organisme national de régie du sport pour les disciplines d’athlétisme sur piste et pelouse, de cross-country, de course sur route, de course sur montagne et de course sur sentier. Son objectif est de soutenir l'excellence de haute performance en athlétisme sur la scène internationale et nationale et d'offrir une direction au développement de l'athlétisme. Athlétisme Canada est un organisme de bienfaisance sans but lucratif qui exerce ses activités sous la direction d'un conseil d'administration élu par les membres provinciaux et territoriaux.

APERÇU DU POSTE

Athlétisme Canada recherche un(e) coordonnateur(trice) organisé(e), collaboratif(tive) et passionné(e) pour son programme de courses sur route et sentiers afin de soutenir la croissance et le développement continus de la course sur route, de la course sur sentiers et de la course en montagne à travers le Canada.

Le (ou la) candidat(e) retenu(e) jouera un rôle important dans la mise en œuvre des programmes et services nationaux du département de courses sur route et sentiers d'Athlétisme Canada, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le personnel d'Athlétisme Canada, les associations provinciales et territoriales, les organisateurs d'événements, les athlètes, les entraîneurs et les bénévoles. Le ou la titulaire du poste aura la responsabilité directe de plusieurs programmes nationaux tout en soutenant la tenue de plusieurs championnats canadiens et de l'équipe nationale de course en montagne et sur sentiers.

C'est une occasion idéale pour quelqu'un qui comprend la culture et le paysage de la course sur route, sur sentiers et en montagne, et qui est enthousiaste à l'idée d'aider à bâtir des programmes plus solides, accessibles et mieux connectés à travers le Canada.

Le poste relève du gestionnaire du marketing et des événements, tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le directeur des programmes nationaux et du sport sécuritaire sur le développement de programmes, la mise en œuvre de politiques, la gouvernance et la stratégie plus large d'Athlétisme Canada pour la course sur route et sur sentiers.

RESPONSABILITÉS CLÉS


1. Développement de programmes et engagement des parties prenantes

  • Développer de relations solides avec les associations provinciales et territoriales d'Athlétisme Canada, les organisateurs d'événements, les clubs, les athlètes, les entraîneurs, les officiels et d'autres parties prenantes de la communauté de course sur route et sur sentiers.
  • Assurer la direction du comité hors piste d'Athlétisme Canada et des groupes de travail connexes.
  • Surveiller les développements de la course sur route et sur sentiers au Canada et à l'international et identifiez des occasions d'amélioration des programmes.
  • Contribuer aux communications, aux ressources et aux documents de formation pour les organisateurs et les participants d’événements.
  • Recueillir et maintenir les données des programmes et fournir des mises à jour et rapports réguliers au personnel d'Athlétisme Canada.
  • Contribuer aux initiatives plus larges d'Athlétisme Canada qui soutiennent la participation, le développement des athlètes, la compétition et l'excellence en course sur route et sur sentiers.


2. Championnats canadiens de route, sur sentiers et de courses en montagne

Soutenez le gestionnaire du marketing et des événements dans la planification et la réalisation des Championnats canadiens de course sur route, sur sentiers et en montagne d'Athlétisme Canada, notamment :

  • Contribuer à la documentation des championnats, à la sélection des hôtes, à la contractualisation et à la coordination avec les organisations hôtes.
  • Assister à la planification des événements, aux échéanciers, aux communications et aux exigences opérationnelles.
  • Soutenir l'admissibilité au championnat, l'inscription, les informations techniques et celles les événements.
  • Soutenir les activités de marketing et de promotion des championnats.
  • Aider au rapport, à l'évaluation et à l'amélioration continue après l'événement.
  • Développer des relations de travail solides avec les directeurs de course, les comités locaux d'organisation et d'autres partenaires d'événements.


3. Programme de désignation de courses sur route

Diriger la mise en œuvre et le développement continus du programme de désignation des courses sur route d'Athlétisme Canada, notamment :

  • Gérer les demandes, les exigences en matière de désignation, les ententes et les communications avec les événements approuvés par la désignation de course sur route.
  • Servir de point de contact principal pour les organisateurs d'événements
  • Coordonner les exigences de l'événement, y compris la sanction, la certification des cours, les exigences techniques et d'autres normes d'Athlétisme Canada.
  • Soutenir le développement et la mise en œuvre des avantages événementiels, des possibilités de marketing et des communications destinées aux athlètes.
  • Surveiller la participation aux programmes et identifiez des occasions de renforcer la qualité, le profil et la portée du calendrier national des courses sur route.
  • Travailler avec le personnel et les associations provinciales et territoriales d'Athlétisme Canada pour assurer l'application cohérente des exigences nationales.

4. Équipe nationale de course en montagne et sur sentiers

Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le développement du programme de l'équipe nationale de course en montagne et sur sentiers d'Athlettes Canada, notamment :

  • Soutenir la participation d'Athlétisme Canada aux championnats et événements internationaux de course en montagne et sur sentiers.
  • Aider aux communications entre athlètes et entraîneurs ainsi qu'à l'administration de l'équipe.
  • Soutenir la sélection de l'équipe, l'inscription, la planification des voyages et de la logistique.
  • Aider à la préparation des événements de l'équipe nationale et aux opérations sur place.
  • Contribuer au développement continu d'un programme national solide et durable de course en montagne et sur sentiers.


5. Mesure et certification des parcours

Coordonner le programme de mesure et de certification des parcours de courses sur route d'Athlétisme Canada, incluant :

  • Gérer les candidatures et la communication avec les organisateurs d'événements à la recherche de la certification de parcours.
  • Maintenir une base de données nationale précise des parcours certifiés et des dates de renouvellement.
  • Soutenir la transition vers des exigences et processus de certification de parcours mis à jour.
  • Fournir des conseils aux organisateurs d'événements concernant la mesure de parcours et les exigences de certification.
  • Aider à développer et coordonner les parcours et la formation pour les évaluateurs de parcours certifiés.

6. Sanction nationale des routes et sentiers

Soutenir la mise en œuvre et l'administration continue du Cadre de sanction routière et de sentiers d'Athlétisme Canada, notamment :

  • Travailler avec les associations provinciales/territoriales d'Athlétisme Canada et les organisateurs d'événements pour soutenir l'adoption et la mise en œuvre des exigences minimales nationales.
  • Participer au développement d'outils, de ressources et de communications pour soutenir une application cohérente à travers le Canada.
  • Surveiller la mise en œuvre et identifier les domaines nécessitant des clarifications, de l'éducation ou un soutien supplémentaire.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le directeur des programmes nationaux et du sport sécuritaire sur la mise en œuvre des politiques et les questions de gouvernance.
  • Aider à s'assurer que les programmes nationaux de courses sur route et sur sentiers d'Athletics Canada sont alignés aux politiques organisationnelles plus larges et aux objectifs stratégiques.

QUALIFICATIONS

Le (ou la) candidat(e) idéal(e) offrira une combinaison de connaissances techniques, d'habiletés organisationnelles et d'une véritable compréhension de la communauté de la course sur route et sur sentiers.

  • Compréhension du portrait global de la course sur route et sur sentiers – Connaissance des règles de compétition, des catégories d'âge, des formats de compétition et de la culture de la communauté de course sur route, sur sentiers et en montagne. La familiarité avec la gestion et la livraison d'événements est fortement recommandée.
  • Solides compétences organisationnelles – Capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs programmes, échéances, projets et filières de communication tout en restant attentifI(tive) aux détails.
  • Expérience en coordination de programmes – Expérience en coordination de programmes, événements ou projets, idéalement dans le domaine du sport, du secteur sans but lucratif, du développement communautaire ou dans un environnement similaire.
  • Solides compétences en communication – Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement avec les athlètes, entraîneurs, bénévoles, organisateurs d'événements et partenaires organisationnels.
  • Bilinguisme – La maîtrise de l'anglais et du français est considérée comme un atout.
  • Accent sur l'athlète et les participants – À l'aise pour communiquer directement avec les athlètes et les participants de manière empathique, respectueuse et réactive, et capacité de travailler efficacement avec des personnes issues de milieux divers et à différents stades de leur parcours sportif.
  • Mentalité collaborative – Capacité à travailler efficacement avec le comité hors piste d'Athlétisme Canada, les associations provinciales et territoriales, les comités locaux d'organisation et les collègues à travers le Canada.
  • Approche orientée sur les solutions – Identifie de manière proactive les occasions d'améliorer les programmes, de résoudre des problèmes et de renforcer le système global de courses sur route et sur sentiers.
  • Indépendance et autonomie – À l'aise pour travailler à distance et gérer ses responsabilités de façon autonome tout en maintenant une forte communication avec ses collègues et les parties prenantes.
  • Passion pour le sport – Véritable intérêt pour la course et engagement à soutenir la croissance et le développement de la course sur route et sur sentiers au Canada.

Conditions de travail

Il s'agit d'un poste entièrement à distance basé au Canada.

Le poste exige du travail occasionnel en soirée et les weekends, notamment autour des compétitions, réunions et activités de l'équipe nationale.

Des déplacements nationaux réguliers seront requis pour les Championnats canadiens, les activités de l'équipe nationale, les réunions et d'autres événements d'Athlétisme Canada.

Des déplacements internationaux occasionnels peuvent être nécessaires pour soutenir l'équipe nationale de course en montagne et sur sentiers ou d'autres activités internationales.

Le poste exige la capacité de travailler de façon autonome dans un environnement à distance tout en maintenant une communication et une collaboration efficaces avec ses collègues et les parties prenantes à travers le Canada.

Athlétisme Canada s'engage à créer un environnement inclusif et équitable et encourage les candidatures de candidats qualifiés issus de milieux et d'expériences variés.

Mise en candidature

La date limite de mise en candidature est le dimanche 15 novembre. Nous remercions toutes les personnes qui soumettront leur candidature. Cependant, seules les personnes sélectionnées pour une entrevue seront contactées. Athlétisme Canada est un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Full Stack Software Engineer

Remote | LATAM | Independent Contractor
