About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer with strong expertise in .NET (C#) and React/JavaScript to join an innovative engineering team building scalable, high-quality web applications.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both front-end and back-end development, takes ownership of their work, and enjoys solving complex technical challenges.

This is an AI-first engineering environment where AI-assisted and agentic development are integral to the software development process. You should have hands-on experience leveraging AI coding assistants and autonomous agents to accelerate development, improve efficiency, and deliver reliable solutions.

Beyond using AI tools, you must be able to critically evaluate, test, and take ownership of AI-generated code, ensuring it meets production standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET (C#) and React/JavaScript.

  • Build responsive front-end experiences and reliable back-end services.

  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services.

  • Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic workflows throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Review, debug, test, and validate AI-generated code to ensure quality, security, and maintainability.

  • Collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams to design and deliver new features.

  • Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize application performance.

  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies, development practices, and AI-powered engineering tools.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack software development.

  • Strong proficiency in .NET (C#) and experience developing back-end applications.

  • Solid front-end development skills with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

  • Hands-on professional experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic development tools to build, debug, and improve software.

  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs.

  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling.

  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows.

  • Understanding of web application security best practices.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to adapt to new technologies and continuously develop technical skills.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

  • Experience customizing AI development workflows, including custom prompts, tool integrations, or multi-agent systems.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Compensation & Engagement Details

  • Engagement: International Independent contractor

  • Compensation: USD $23–26/hour (approximately $3,680–$4,160/month).

  • Timesheets: Hours worked must be documented and submitted through timesheets.

  • Time Off: Days off, sick days, and local public holidays are unpaid and non-billable. There may be opportunities to work on certain holidays.

  • Equipment: The company will provide and ship the required hardware.

  • Expected Start Date: Approximately four weeks after signing the offer to allow for equipment shipment and setup.

Recruitment Process

Candidates can expect the following steps:

  1. Latino Legends Application: Complete our application for through our website.

  2. Recorded Screening Questionnaire: Short recorded responses to help us assess your experience and communication skills. Successful candidates will be submitted to the client's ATS.

  3. Initial Technical Challenge: A one-hour technical exercise. Candidates are not expected to complete the entire task; the goal is to demonstrate their approach and problem-solving skills.

  4. Hiring Manager Interview: Discuss your technical challenge, approach, and implementation decisions.

  5. Peer Interview: Meet with members of the engineering team.

  6. Final Interview: Conversation with the SVP of Engineering.

  7. Reference Checks: Successful finalists will be asked to provide 2–3 professional references from previous supervisors, managers, or team leaders before the formal offer is issued.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Department Description
Silvus Technologies, a Motorola Solutions company, is dedicated to one mission: connecting those who keep us safe. We do so by delivering the most advanced Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) radios powered by our custom and ever evolving Mobile-Networked MIMO waveform. Together, our radios and waveform provide vital communications for mission-critical applications in the harshest environments from underground tunnels to high-altitude balloons. Silvus StreamCaster™ radios are being rapidly adopted by customers all over the world ranging from the U.S. and Allied Nations Departments of Defense to International, Federal, State, and Local Law Enforcement agencies, all the way to the Superbowl, Grammys, and industry-leading drone, robot, and unmanned systems manufacturers. Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”? Silvus’ rapid growth is fueled by a focus on research and innovation and a team of the most passionate, skilled, and creative thinking individuals. If you are looking for a challenging experience, you owe it to yourself to learn how Silvus can be the next chapter of your career.


Job Description

We are seeking a highly strategic professional to spearhead our capture of U.S. Government Security Assistance and international defense funding across the Indo-Pacific region. This role reports into the Senior Director, APAC.

This role is the critical bridge between partner nation tactical C4ISR requirements and U.S. funding streams, specifically Foreign Military Sales (FMS), Foreign Military Financing (FMF), Section 333 (Building Partner Capacity), and other allied funding programs. The Director will operate at the intersection of international business development and high-stakes government relations, ensuring that U.S. security cooperation investments translate directly into the integration of Silvus capabilities across key allied defense forces in the Asia-Pacific region.

The Director will lead the strategy to align partner nation tactical requirements with U.S. security assistance priorities. In this role, they will shape foreign Letters of Request (LORs) while concurrently positioning Silvus within INDOPACOM capability packages and grant programs. By bridging partner nation operational gaps with Department of Defense security assistance mechanisms, you will fulfill our prime directive of 'Keeping Our Heroes Connected' while driving unprecedented growth across the INDOPACOM theater.


ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York.
jobs.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.

Join Filed as an AI Tax Engineer: bring your expertise to the platform tax professionals rely on, work alongside a team of CPAs, and help shape where the profession goes next. Full-time, remote, US-based.

Filed is building the first AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.

The accountant is irreplaceable. The work surrounding them isn't. Filed takes on that surrounding work, from the moment client documents arrive to the plan a firm hands back, so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and the client relationship.

Filed works inside the software firms already use (CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake and ProConnect) across individual, business, trust and exempt organization returns. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Raine and Day One Ventures.

Read more in TechCrunch.

What we should tell you about the role

Filed is built for tax professionals, by a team that includes them. Our CPAs sit at the center of the company. They decide what quality means in everything Filed does, and they shape what we build next.

As an AI Tax Engineer, you'd join that team. This is a strategic role. You'll bring years of practice experience to the product, work with our product and engineering leads on where Filed goes next, and work directly with the firms that run on it. Your judgment ends up in a platform used by firms across the country, instead of staying inside one practice.

We think the profession deserves better than the busywork that has grown up around it, and that the people doing this work should spend their time on the parts that need their expertise. This role is how we make sure Filed delivers on both.

We hire for this role on a rolling basis rather than to a fixed headcount. If you're the right person, we'd rather meet you now than wait for a req to open.

Here's why this is a terrible job

  • You won't sign returns anymore. If client work is the part you love most, this may not be the right fit.

  • There's no off-season. Firms rely on Filed year-round, so we need someone fully committed to this role.

  • There's no established playbook. The role is new, and you'll help define it.

  • We're building something new, so not everything we try will work the first time.

Here's why it's the best career choice you'll make

  • Your expertise shapes a platform used by firms across the country.

  • You'll see how dozens of firms run their practices, and help raise the standard for all of them.

  • No billable hours or utilization targets.

  • Tax expertise drives product decisions here. You'll be at the table when they're made.

  • You'll help move the profession toward more advisory work and less busywork, from inside the company building what comes next.

The teammate we're looking for

  • Has years of practice behind them and strong views on how the work should be done.

  • Cares about the profession and wants to see it valued for judgment, not hours.

  • Can explain a technical tax position clearly to people outside tax.

  • Is curious about how technology can change the work.

  • Is comfortable pushing back on anyone, including us.

What you'll be responsible for

  • Being a tax expert at the center of how Filed works, alongside our team of CPAs, and setting the standard for quality across everything we ship.

  • Partnering with product and engineering to decide what we build next, from document intake through to tax planning.

  • Working closely with customer firms, understanding how they run their practices, and turning that into product direction.

Your hard skillset

  • Licensed CPA with at least 5 years of experience.

  • Based in the US.

  • Deep experience in at least one of CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake or ProConnect.

  • Comfortable across individual and business returns, including partnerships and K-1s.

Your soft skillset

  • Clear writing. Much of your influence will happen in documents and comments.

  • Strategic thinking. You see past the return in front of you to the practice behind it.

  • Ownership. When you spot a problem, you follow it through to the fix.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a small team that moves fast.

  • Credibility with partners and preparers alike.

Growth and levels

  1. This role grows with the product. As Filed takes on more of the work surrounding the accountant, your scope grows with it.

  2. You'll work directly with leadership and help shape how Filed's tax team is built.

  3. Strong performers will have room to lead the function as it grows.

The process

  • Intro call (30 minutes)

  • Practical tax case with our team (60 minutes)

  • Final round with leadership (60 minutes)

Two and a half hours in, you'll know whether this is the right next step in your career.

Department: Tax Experience
Location: Remote (US-based only)
Employment type: Full-time
Compensation: $85,800 to $101,400 base per year, plus equity

About Filed

Filed is an AI tax preparer that helps firms prep faster, scale smarter, and stay in control, without breaking what already works. It's not a replacement for human judgment. It's a new kind of leverage for those who carry the weight of tax season year after year.

About the role

Comms8 is looking for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Finance Admin to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our group.

This is a practical, detail-focused role for someone who is comfortable keeping financial records accurate and up to date, reconciling accounts, processing invoices and expenses, and preparing regular finance reports.

You will support four entities across two jurisdictions and work closely with our team and accountants in the UK and Hong Kong.

Importantly, our UK and Hong Kong accountants handle all statutory filings and audit requirements. You will provide accurate records and information to support them, but you will not be responsible for owning statutory compliance or audit.

The role will initially focus entirely on finance. Once the month-end process is running accurately and consistently, the role will gradually expand to include general administrative support.

What you'll be doing

Finance & Bookkeeping

  • Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across four group entities
  • Complete regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies
  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Prepare and issue client invoices and follow up on outstanding payments
  • Process and record business expenses
  • Prepare payroll data for UK employees and offshore contractors
  • Record and reconcile intercompany transactions between business entities
  • Produce a standard monthly finance pack
  • Prepare a weekly cash and aged-debtors report using an established template
  • Maintain accurate and well-organised financial records
  • Respond to queries and provide supporting information to our UK and Hong Kong accountants
  • Support month-end processes and help ensure the books are complete, accurate and ready for accountant review

You will not be expected to handle statutory filings or audits as these will be managed by our UK and Hong Kong accountants, giving you the opportunity to focus on maintaining accurate books and running the day-to-day finance processes well.

Admin Support

Once you have established a reliable month-end routine, the role will expand to include:

  • Contractor onboarding and offboarding paperwork
  • Vendor, subscription and business-tool administration
  • Document filing and record-keeping across the four entities
  • General administrative support for the operations team

What we're looking for

  • 2–5 years of experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or a similar hands-on finance role
  • Solid experience with day-to-day bookkeeping and bank reconciliations
  • Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing and expenses
  • Good understanding of month-end bookkeeping processes
  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Organised and consistent in maintaining records and following established processes
  • Confident communicating with colleagues and accountants
  • Good written and spoken English
  • Comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies
  • Able to work the required hours with regular overlap with our UK and Hong Kong teams

Experience preparing payroll data, handling intercompany transactions or working with international/remote businesses would be an advantage.

Working arrangement

This is a full-time contractor engagement, not an employment position.

The role is fully remote and open to candidates based across Southeast Asia.

Because you will work closely with colleagues and accountants across the UK and Hong Kong, availability during the required working hours and sufficient overlap with both teams is a mandatory requirement for this role.

Compensation

USD 500–800 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated bookkeeping capability.

What success looks like

In your first few months, the priority will be straightforward: accurate books, clean reconciliations and a dependable month-end process.

Once the finance routine is running smoothly, you will begin supporting selected administrative tasks across the business.

If you are a practical, organised bookkeeper who enjoys keeping financial records accurate and processes running consistently, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

Pay Plan Title:Vice President, Cost Management

Working Title:Vice President, Cost Management – Affordability

FLSA Status:Exempt

Posting Salary Range:$144,763 - $180,479

Office Location:Remote within the United States

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Vice President, Cost Management to join our team! The Vice President, Cost Management serves as the senior leader responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing enterprise-wide affordability and cost-of-care management strategies. This position drives organizational efforts to identify, evaluate, implement, and monitor initiatives designed to improve healthcare affordability while maintaining quality outcomes and member access to care.

The Vice President works collaboratively across Clinical Operations, Care Management, Utilization Management, Network Management, Population Health, Medical Economics, Finance, Pharmacy, and Executive Leadership to identify utilization and service cost trends, develop intervention strategies, establish financial targets, and ensure organizational accountability for implementation and results.

The position is responsible for establishing a disciplined affordability framework that translates analytical findings into actionable initiatives, measurable savings opportunities, and sustainable financial outcomes.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Establish affordability goals and financial targets aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Collaborate with operational leaders to develop intervention strategies that reduce unnecessary cost growth.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to understand root causes of healthcare cost growth.
  • Oversee development of financial impact assessments for affordability initiatives.
  • Prepare executive-level reports, presentations, and recommendations.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules available for some positions with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree and six (6) years of experience working in a government‑sponsored healthcare program, managed care, healthcare operations, population health, medical economics, healthcare finance, utilization management, payment integrity, network management, affordability, or a related healthcare environment, including experience in financial project management, healthcare data or trend analysis, healthcare economics, cost management, affordability management, financial project controls, payment integrity, financial modeling, or overseeing large-scale medical and behavioral healthcare expenditure targets and affordability initiatives. Must include at least two (2) years of experience supervising at least two (2) employees; OR
  • Master's degree and three (3) years of experience working in a government‑sponsored healthcare program, managed care, healthcare operations, population health, medical economics, healthcare finance, utilization management, payment integrity, network management, affordability, or a related healthcare environment, including experience in financial project management, healthcare data or trend analysis, healthcare economics, cost management, affordability management, financial project controls, payment integrity, financial modeling, or overseeing large-scale medical and behavioral healthcare expenditure targets and affordability initiatives. Must include at least two (2) years of experience supervising at least two (2) employees.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within the United States.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship for employment now or in the future (ex: OPT F-1, J-1).

Preferred:

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Economics, Public Health, or related field.
  • Ten (10) years of progressively responsible Medicaid managed care, Tailored Plan, LME-MCO,healthcare economics, medical economics, affordability management, healthcare finance, population health, utilization management, network management, or government healthcare experience.
  • Experience leading enterprise trend-bending initiatives.
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership.

Deadline for Application:Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 11:59pm

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

We offer competitive pay and benefits, flexible vacations, attractive stock options, unparalleled transparency, and a 100% remote environment. We're excited to have you join us for your next career adventure!

🎭 Role & Team

As a Senior Product Manager on the Billing Core squad at gaiia, you will own the product vision for one of the most critical modules of our platform: Billing & Revenue Management. Billing is the backbone of every telecom operation. It touches every customer, every transaction, and every dollar. Getting it right means building a system that is powerful enough to handle complex rating, charging, and invoicing scenarios, yet intuitive enough for our customers' teams to operate with confidence.

You will work closely with your squad (a Team Lead, Full-Stack Developers, a Product Designer, and a QA Specialist) to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and deliver value continuously. You will also collaborate with fellow Product Managers and Product Designers from other squads, and work cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, and Implementation teams who rely on billing as a core part of the customer experience.

In this role, you will develop a deep understanding of telecom billing models, payment processing, tax compliance, regulatory requirements, and the revenue operations challenges our customers face. You will champion solutions that reduce complexity, automate manual workflows, and give our customers the financial clarity they need to run their businesses. You will bring an accounting and finance lens to the squad, making sure what we build holds up for the controllers, accountants, and finance teams who close their books on gaiia.

The Billing Squad

The Billing squad is responsible for building and evolving gaiia's billing engine, rating and charging infrastructure for all supported services, and the agent-facing billing interfaces. It is also responsible for all financial and regulatory reports that need to be provided to controllers, auditors and finance teams.

A successful candidate will be comfortable navigating the intersection of complex business rules and elegant user experiences. Someone who can think in billing cycles and edge cases while never losing sight of the end user.

🪄 What you're going to do

  • Collaboratively define the product strategy for the Billing module with your squad, stakeholders, and leadership team.
  • Identify, research, and prioritize work for your team based on customer feedback, operational data, and business goals.
  • Use data analysis, customer interviews, and competitive research to become an expert in telecom billing and revenue management.
  • Ensure your team consistently tackles the most impactful items by owning and maintaining the backlog.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive product roadmap for billing, aligning it with the company's growth goals and customer needs.
  • Lead the formulation and execution of the product strategy, ensuring the billing module meets customer needs while achieving operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, and Implementation teams to understand billing pain points and translate them into product improvements.
  • Understand the technical implications of billing architecture decisions and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
  • Dive deep into billing edge cases, payment workflows, and tax compliance requirements to design robust solutions.
  • Design solutions that reduce manual effort, minimize billing errors, and accelerate time-to-value for customers.

🌈 What we are looking for

  • Experience with medium to large web application SaaS (B2B or B2C).
  • A contagious passion for digital products and product management.
  • A background in accounting or finance, and a strong interest in billing systems, payment processing, and financial operations.
  • Proficient in human-centered design principles, committed to developing solutions that meet technical demands while effectively addressing user needs.
  • Curiosity about the latest news related to your product and the industry.
  • Proficiency in English communication (French is a bonus); ability to articulate vision and ideas clearly.
  • A collaborative spirit and effective teamwork skills with various stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand and articulate technological challenges and decisions.
  • Innate leadership qualities to guide your team to success.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess business rules, edge cases, and process improvements.
  • Comfort working with complex domain logic. You enjoy untangling how things work under the hood.
  • Ability to foster relationships with customers and understand their operational challenges.

🎖️ Qualifications

Product Management fundamentals

  • At least 5+ years in a Product Management role.
  • Experience with B2B software, especially in billing, payments, accounting, FinTech, or revenue management.
  • Grasp of how your product impacts the company's business strategy and revenue.
  • Competency in using both qualitative and quantitative data to shape your strategic vision.
  • Strong communication skills, ensuring alignment across teams like design, product, engineering, sales, and customer success.
  • Familiarity with flexible agile team processes.
  • Ability to reason about complex business logic (e.g rating, charging, invoicing, proration, credits, and adjustments)

Accounting & Finance

  • Hands-on experience in accounting, finance, or financial operations (e.g. public accounting, controllership, revenue accounting, FP&A), before or alongside your product career.
  • Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals: general ledger, double-entry bookkeeping, accounts receivable, revenue recognition (ASC 606 / IFRS 15), and month-end close.
  • Ability to speak the language of finance teams and turn their reconciliation, audit, and reporting needs into clear product requirements.
  • Experience defining and validating financial and regulatory reports (e.g. A/R aging, revenue, tax, and reconciliation reports), and comfort working with data directly (SQL or similar) to check that the numbers tie out.

AI & Productivity

  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of your workflow for research, analysis, scoping, prototyping and problem-solving.
  • Ability to build and iterate on personal AI-powered workflows that compound your productivity over time.
  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants to extract insights from data, prototype solutions, or accelerate technical and product discovery.

Nice-to-Have

  • CPA designation (or equivalent, such as CA, CMA, CGA, or ACCA).
  • Solid understanding of how billing systems, payment gateways, and tax engines work.
  • Commitment to learning about telecom-specific billing patterns and emerging industry solutions.

💰 Salary

At gaiia, we have a transparent salary philosophy and a robust evaluation and compensation framework. It translates to a fair and impartial model where salaries are published internally, healthy discussions about compensation and performance can exist, and taboos are removed.

The salary range for this role is $140,000-$220,000.

Job Title: Senior Migration Consultant - Clinical Data Programming

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva's Vault Clinical Data Management System (CDMS) is changing how life sciences companies manage clinical trial data, bringing EDC, coding, and Data Quality System (DQS) together in one platform. The Migration Team works within this group, focusing on migrating customers off legacy systems—such as Medidata Rave and Oracle InForm—into Vault CDMS.

We are looking for a Senior Migration Consultant with hands-on experience programming and processing extremely large clinical datasets. In this full-time, customer-facing role, you will serve as a trusted, customer-facing technical lead, partnering directly with Sponsors throughout active migration programs.

What You’ll Do

    • Partner directly with Sponsors and CROs to interpret legacy clinical database structures, protocol specifications, and data mapping requirements, applying Veeva migration best practices.
    • Perform data transformation, mapping, and script validation on large, complex clinical datasets extracted from legacy platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm).
    • Lead end-to-end data migration delivery across complex, active clinical trials per the project plan, coordinating closely with cross-functional technical teams.
    • Develop and configure validation scripts, and custom SQL-based listings to ensure data integrity, auditability, and cleanliness during ingestion into Veeva DQS and Vault CDMS.
    • Provide feedback to the Vault CDMS & DQS product teams based on real-world customer migration challenges, data volume bottlenecks, and client requirements.
    • Contribute to reusable migration tools, data mapping templates, and automation initiatives, mentoring junior team members throughout the migration lifecycle.

Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience with EDC clinical software, covering end-to-end data management (database design, data collection, data analysis, query resolution, datasets, statistical reporting)
    • Solid understanding of clinical trial processes, particularly around data collection and review
    • Programming experience in languages such as SAS, R, Python, or SQL, with the ability to pick up new SQL-based languages
    • Background in the life sciences industry (pharma, biotech, medical device, CRO, or academic/public health), with experience across project assessment, planning, development, training, and implementation
    • Experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within software professional services or consulting
    • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while meeting project timelines
    • Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
    • Willingness to travel up to 10%, potentially including international travel

Nice to Have

    • Knowledge of DBT

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Fleet Operations Coordinator — Remote

Use your organization, communication, and problem-solving skills to help keep a busy transportation operation moving.

Truck Driver Nation LLC is hiring a full-time Fleet Operations Coordinator to work directly with our team and support the day-to-day operation of our U.S. transportation activities from a remote, work-from-home environment.

Previous fleet, trucking, transportation, or logistics experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with transferable experience in operations, scheduling, customer service, administrative coordination, dispatch support, fleet support, or other fast-paced professional environments are encouraged to apply.

This position may be a good fit for someone who naturally keeps track of details, follows up consistently, communicates clearly, and notices potential operational problems before they become larger issues.

What You'll Do

As a Fleet Operations Coordinator, you will help maintain visibility into driver and equipment activity while supporting the administrative and operational needs of the transportation team.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Monitor driver and vehicle status throughout daily transportation operations.
  • Maintain accurate fleet, driver, equipment, and operational information in company systems.
  • Communicate professionally with drivers and internal team members regarding schedules, equipment status, operational needs, and required updates.
  • Follow up with drivers to obtain status information and required documentation.
  • Track vehicle availability and report equipment issues that could affect operations.
  • Assist with coordinating routine vehicle maintenance, service appointments, inspections, and repair-related communication.
  • Maintain records related to vehicle service, maintenance activity, inspections, and other fleet information as required.
  • Help identify scheduling conflicts, equipment concerns, missing information, and other operational issues.
  • Escalate safety, equipment, driver, or operational concerns to the appropriate team member.
  • Assist with coordinating changes that affect driver or vehicle availability.
  • Maintain accurate notes, records, and status updates in company systems.
  • Support communication between drivers and the transportation operations team.
  • Help ensure required operational information is complete, organized, and available when needed.
  • Provide additional fleet and transportation coordination support as required by daily operations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fleet operations, trucking, transportation, logistics, or dispatch-support experience is preferred but not required.
  • Relevant experience in operations, scheduling, administrative coordination, customer service, fleet support, transportation support, or similar professional environments will be considered.
  • Fluent spoken and written English.
  • Strong professional phone, email, and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Good problem-solving and follow-up abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accurate records.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with drivers and internal team members.
  • Comfortable working with computers, email, spreadsheets, and web-based business systems.
  • Computer suitable for daily professional remote work.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection.
  • Reliable and professional work-from-home environment.
  • Ability to work independently and remain accountable in a remote position.
  • Availability during required U.S. transportation operating hours.
  • Familiarity with U.S. trucking, fleet operations, transportation, vehicle-maintenance coordination, or logistics is an advantage.

Who May Do Well in This Role

You may be a strong candidate if you're the person who naturally keeps track of what is happening, what still needs to happen, and who needs to know about it.

Fleet operations involve many moving parts. Driver availability can change, equipment may require attention, schedules can shift, and missing information can quickly affect the rest of an operation.

The ability to stay organized, follow up consistently, communicate changes promptly, and maintain accurate information is especially valuable in this position.

Direct fleet experience can be helpful, but strong transferable skills from transportation, logistics, operations, scheduling, administrative coordination, customer service, or other deadline-driven environments can also provide a useful foundation.

Schedule

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time. Schedule adjustments may occasionally be required based on fleet activity, driver availability, equipment needs, maintenance coordination, or other transportation operating requirements.

Compensation

$20.00–$25.00 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

Ready for Your Next Move?

If you're an organized and dependable communicator who enjoys keeping operations on track, following through on details, and helping solve day-to-day transportation challenges, submit your application to Truck Driver Nation LLC for consideration for this Fleet Operations Coordinator position.

SalesRoads runs a range of outbound programs across industries, audiences, and call difficulty levels.

  • Executive-level programs may pay significantly more per appointment, with lower overall appointment targets

jobs.description:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!

What we're looking for

We're seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team and own a full product area (spanning accounts receivable, accounts payable, and analytics) end to end.

A Senior PM at Alternative Payments means you’ll be handed an area and an outcome, not necessarily a problem statement. You generate the candidate problem set yourself, from data, support volume, customer conversations, and competitive movement, sequence it, and defend that sequence in writing well enough that someone who wasn't in the room can work with you and act on it.

This role is ideal for someone who finds the right problem rather than just solving the one in front of them, who can let go of work that isn't earning its place -including work already in flight - and who owns a launch's full customer experience, not just its ship date.

This role is available to candidates who are eligible to work in New York, hybrid.

What you'll do

  • Set both the success metric and the guardrail metric before work begins, and be able to defend why that metric beats the obvious alternative.

  • Prioritize product roadmap, being able to descope work that isn't earning its place when the evidence says it shouldn't ship.

  • Own the full customer experience around every launch: enablement, support load, pricing implications, and rollout, not just the release date.

  • Write PRDs and technical artifacts that hold up on their own, clear enough that engineering can build against them without a follow-up meeting to interpret them.

  • Engage on system design docs, engage directly with engineering tradeoffs, and use AI coding tools as part of how you build product day to day.

  • Operate inside and help shape a standardized PM structure the team is actively building, so discovery, prioritization, and documentation work the same way across every product area.

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with real proof you've generated a problem set from ambiguity, not only executed one that was handed to you.

  • Structured problem-solving that goes beyond breaking a problem into parts: you find the problem worth solving in the first place, and can identify which constraint is actually the binding one.

  • Genuine sophistication in fintech, payments, or another inherently complex domain. Deep enough that you understand why these problems are hard, not just that you've worked adjacent to them.

  • Written narratives and PRDs that persuade stakeholders and give engineering enough to act on without a clarifying meeting.

  • A strong sense of ownership, holding yourself accountable for outcomes across team boundaries and resolving cross-functional friction directly.

  • Decisiveness under incomplete information: you can make a call on partial data, state the condition that would reverse it, and move forward.

  • Coachability that shows up as genuinely changing your position on something you'd publicly committed to when the evidence calls for it.

  • The ability to reach working expertise in an unfamiliar domain fast enough to be useful in it quickly, rather than waiting to be fully briefed.

Nice to haves

  • Experience in B2B SaaS environments (PLG experience is a bonus, not a requirement).

  • Prior experience owning a product area inside a team that was actively standardizing its process, rather than one with a fully mature playbook already in place.

  • Comfort operating without a dedicated design partner on smaller initiatives, partnering directly with engineering when needed.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, dynamic, and high-impact environments.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.

    • The total compensation range for this role is $160,000 - $220,000, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. We have flexibility on this band for the right candidate, and individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

Why Choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you'll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that's deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there's a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Want to see what we're actually building?

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

Our Values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we're headed.

  • Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn't obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

  • Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We're looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you're excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company, is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions.Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as a Great Place to Work® in 2026.

Description of Role

Senior Director, DMPK Project Leader ensures delivery of all DMPK related activities working collaboratively as part of a cross-functional program team. These include nonclinical PK experiments, in vitro ADME, biotransformation studies, bioanalytical and toxicokinetic analysis. This role supports understanding pharmacokinetic, toxicokinetic, and ADME principles to enable progression of drug candidates across the portfolio.  A qualified candidate will have previous experience in PK modeling ideally for CNS drug candidates and a basic understanding of vital ADME properties for CNS drug candidate progression. Furthermore, a qualified candidate will have end-to-end experience in drug discovery and development including NDA submission; will be able to partner with both discovery and development teams to enable the identification of lead candidates with optimal DMPK properties for progression into nonclinical development and the progression of lead candidates into clinical development.  

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the filing of NDAs for DMPK

  • Deliver high-quality DMPK input and data to projects within established timelines

  • Utilize knowledge of DMPK to support/influence compound profiling, project progression and project strategy

  • Proactively calculate PK and toxicokinetic parameters, estimate safety margins and report results and interpretations to project teams and internal governance bodies

  • Lead, coordinate, and engage with DMPK colleagues, clinical pharmacologists, and toxicologists in project related activities

  • Prepare clear presentations related to the above for internal governance bodies

Qualifications

  • Ph.D. inPharmaceutical Sciences,Pharmacology or a related field

  • Minimum of 10 years of industry experience in a biotech or pharmaceutical setting

  • Expert in DMPK sciences with knowledge of drug discovery and development processes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Experience in DMPK project leadership

  • Previous work in the discovery and/or development of CNS drug candidates

  • Experience with regulatory submissions including NDAs for small molecules

  • Knowledge, experience, and proficiency in supporting GLP-compliant studies

  • Good knowledge of all DMPK assays including the use of in silico tools for PK prediction

  • Proficiency with Phoenix WinNonlinand other software for NCA and PK modelingin small molecule drug discovery and development

  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and communicate scientific findings clearly and effectively

  • Collaborative mindset and operates with a sense of urgency

  • Strong, proactive communication skills

The Senior Director, DMPK Project Lead role based in the US, with occasional travel.

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

The Customer Escalations Team is our first line of service recovery. It works to resolve customer impacting issues quickly and to build strong collaboration across Claims, Account Management, Claims Ops, Data, and other internal teams.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

The Customer Escalations Lead is a player/coach role. The Lead carries a caseload of high-priority and complex escalations, manages the Customer Escalations Advisors on the team, and owns how the team works: its processes, tools, reporting and feedback to Claims. This is not a pure people management role. The Lead is a contributor on the team, with management experience, and stays close to the work.

The role is mid-level and highly visible. It suits someone with a claims adjusting background, similar to our current Advisors, a background in project management, process improvement, and someone who has already led or coached others and is ready to take on formal responsibility for a team. The Lead works across various internal teams and helps shape the playbook for a highly-impactful customer facing team.

What you'll do

Escalation Triage & Resolution

  • Carry a caseload of in-flight escalations raised by customers, Customer Success, or other internal teams, acting as a service recovery advisor
  • Investigate escalations with Claims Adjusters and Claims leadership to assess severity, assign ownership and make sure each issue is resolved
  • Serve as a direct point of contact for client stakeholders during escalations, setting expectations and communicating status
  • Apply claims domain expertise and root cause analysis to find out whether an issue stemmed from people, process, technology, or misaligned expectations
  • Provide regular updates to Account Managers and/or customers for customer-facing communication
  • Act as the first point of escalation for the Advisors, and take on the most sensitive or complex issues when needed

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Manage and coach the Customer Escalations Advisors through regular one-on-ones, feedback, goal setting, and development planning
  • Drive performance reviews and performance management, in partnership with the Global VP of Customer Success
  • Assign escalations and balance workload across the team, including the Lead's own caseload • Set and reinforce a consistent standard for triage, client communication, documentation and follow-through
  • Provide coverage when an Advisor is out, and contribute to hiring and onboarding as the team grows

Process Improvement & Prevention

  • Design and implement streamlined processes within the team and across teams, including intake, triage, handoffs, and ownership of open issues
  • Lead the weekly escalation review to identify patterns, systemic issues and improvement opportunities
  • Recommend and help implement changes to workflows and claims handling based on escalation data
  • Create and maintain playbooks, escalation criteria, SOPs and internal documentation that reduce future escalations
  • Document issue types, frequency, and resolution paths to support learning across the team

Tools & Efficiency

  • Evaluate and implement tools that drive efficiency for the team, such as issue tracking, dashboards, templates, and automation
  • Develop deep expertise on internal tools and drive adoption amongst key stakeholders • Keep escalation data complete and consistent so it can be used for reporting and analysis • Partner with internal teams to surface recurring system issues, misconfigurations, and automation problems

Reporting & Visibility

  • Implement regular internal reporting on escalations
  • Support external reporting to clients in partnership with Account Managers • Report on escalation trends and metrics to Claims Leadership, Account Management, Executive Leadership, and other internal stakeholders to give the organization clear visibility into issues and potential solutions
  • Brief senior leadership on escalation drivers, trends and the status of fixes

Feedback Cycle to Claims

  • Facilitate a regular feedback cycle to Claims based on escalation patterns
  • Collaborate with Claims teams to improve workflows and claims handling hygiene, and to surface coaching opportunities
  • Initiate and lead internal projects to drive solution options to execution
  • Track follow-through on the feedback shared, and confirm that changes reduce repeat escalations

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build working relationships with Claims, Account Management, Claims Ops, Data, Product, and other internal teams, as necessary
  • Operate within a line-of-business-aligned team structure and leverage domain knowledge on the team to assess issue context quickly and suggest relevant resolution paths

Success Metrics

  • Time to Acknowledge and Time to Resolve escalations
  • Volume and frequency of escalations per account or adjuster team
  • Escalation reopen and repeat rate
  • Number of systemic issues identified and resolved
  • Satisfaction of internal stakeholders (Customer Success, Claims Ops, Product) • Internal and external reports delivered on schedule
  • Adoption of new processes and tools by the team
  • Feedback items shared with Claims, and the share of them resolved
  • Development progress and engagement of the Advisors

Qualifications

  • Have claims adjusting experience in Auto, Property, Liability LOBs, or a comparable escalations background, similar to our current Advisors (5+ years is typical for the Advisor role) • Have some experience managing or leading others, such as a team lead, supervisor or formal mentor role, and want to grow as a people leader
  • Have worked directly with clients and are comfortable managing difficult conversations with client stakeholders
  • Are comfortable digging deep into customer escalations and can carry your own caseload while leading a team
  • Have significant experience with root cause analysis, identifying issue patterns and developing practical solutions that were put into practice
  • Have implemented process improvements or tools that made a team more efficient • Can build clear, regular reporting for internal teams and clients, and can brief senior leaders concisely
  • Have strong verbal and written communication skills and a calm, methodical approach to complex problems
  • Work well across Claims, Operations, Product and Customer teams
  • Are comfortable in a fast-growing startup environment where roles evolve and you help shape the playbook

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Why Join This Team

The Customer Escalations Team is a high-impact team and key to enabling success for our customers and carrier partners. The Lead has direct input into how the playbooks and operating motions are built and works alongside Claims, Account Management, and other internal teams. This team helps protect client relationships and improve how Reserv delivers claims service. The role is open to internal and external candidates.

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
