About Piranha Games

Founded in 2000, Piranha Games is an action gaming studio with unparalleled experience developing licensed products for big-name franchises, including AAA licensed titles such as; Need for Speed: Undercover and Duke Nukem Forever. Best known for the Free-to-Play game title MechWarrior Online, PGI is as committed as ever to creating world-class action-based games, having most recently released MechWarrior 5: Clans. Piranha Games is part of the Enad Global 7 group. For more information, please visit www.piranhagames.com

Piranha Games is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. Formal education is not always required. All team members are hand-picked because they are skilled in their individual fields, immensely creative and hard workers. We hire avid gamers and mold them to the standards we believe make amazing products.

Should you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at

We thank you for your interest in this position. Due to the number of applications, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

OVERALL OBJECTIVE AND PURPOSE:

Under the guidance of the Art Director and Lead Character Artist, model characters with a special focus on anatomy, ensuring they and supporting characters meet the same standards in terms of quality and style. Must be able to create stylized realism and to be displayed in your portfolio.

WHY YOU SHOULD WORK WITH PGI

  • Flexible Schedules & Remote Working Arrangements
  • People-focused Events & Initiatives
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Meaningful, engaging projects
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Education & training grants

RESPONSIBLITIES:

  • Implement the overall artistic vision of characters based on designs, concepts and descriptions
  • Work with the Art Director and Lead Character Artist to combine ideas and methodologies of character production to create an efficient, streamlined pipeline, understanding the technical limitations of the engine
  • Design, model, and texture high quality 3D characters, paying close attention to anatomical proportions, scale, and skeletal templates
  • Ensure that the character models can convey a sense of personality in the game (morphology, silhouette, facial expressions, etc.)
  • Collaborate closely with concept artists, animators, game designers, and VFX artists to ensure the visual target is met or exceeded
  • Assist with the integration of a character development process that works in congruence with the creative direction, meets the technical constraints of the game, as well as production deadlines
  • Actively participate in technical and aesthetic problem-solving discussions with the team
  • Display exceptional integrity and understanding of the work; constantly seeking ways to improve the efficiency of the workflow and provide documented feedback to improve in-house tools
  • Stay up to date on best practices and industry trends, work to integrate them into the project and share knowledge with inter-project colleagues
  • Mentor and train junior artists
  • Other ad-hoc responsibilities as requested

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 4-7+ years’ experience working on AAA console and/or PC titles with at least 2 shipped games as a Character Artist
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Graphics, Fine Arts, Game Art & Design or equivalent education, and/or experience
  • Must be able to create stylized realism and to be displayed in your portfolio
  • Possess an exceptional understanding of human and animal anatomy with a keen eye towards form, structure, silhouette and organic movement
  • Solid knowledge of character modeling, texturing, and lighting as related to game development
  • Comprehensive knowledge of a major 3D package (3ds Max, Maya, etc.), Photoshop,
  • Z-brush, Substance Painter, Marmoset Toolbag, Marvelous Designer, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience in the design and development of fantasy characters and creatures.
  • A detail obsessed eye for creating and manipulating texture maps and excellent understanding of the value of UV space
  • Be able to create characters with finished, rough, or no concept art that fits within the style
  • Expertise in incorporating characters in Unreal Engine 5
  • Expert experience using of advanced material shader systems for characters
  • Experience with groom(strands) and hair cards, to support in-game and cinematics characters
  • Equally proficiency in clothing and hard surface modeling
  • Knowledge of animation typology (rigging, skinning, etc.)

We are open to candidates at Intermediate to Senior levels depending on experience. Intermediate: 4+ years, Senior: 7+ years of experience. Compensation will be based on experience and skill level.

jobs.description:
Position Summary
DataSpring is seeking a Product Marketing Manager to execute commercialization program success across our portfolio of provider and member data solutions, including customer-centric positioning and messaging, launches, and sales enablement.

Reporting to the Senior Product Marketing Manager, this role will work across DataSpring's portfolio of provider and member data solutions to translate product capabilities into clear market value, differentiated messaging, effective launches, and commercial success. This role will independently manage assigned product marketing programs and commercialization initiatives while partnering with the Senior Product Marketing Manager on portfolio strategy, market positioning, and cross-functional priorities.

The Product Marketing team serves as the connective layer between Product, Marketing, Growth, and Client Partnership. This role brings our PMM strategy to life: developing messaging and enablement materials, executing go-to-market plans, gathering and translating market insights, and helping ensure DataSpring solutions are effectively understood, adopted, and differentiated in market.

The Product Marketing Manager is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the Senior Product Marketing Manager.

Specific Responsibilities

Product & Solution Commercialization

  • Develop and maintain product, solution, and use case positioning and messaging
  • Translate product capabilities and regular product updates into compelling value propositions, business outcomes, and audience-appropriate content and communications for clients and users
  • Develop and maintain solution narratives that connect customer challenges with DataSpring's offerings
  • Contribute to buyer persona development, segmentation, and ideal customer profile refinement
  • Partner with Product Management, Client Partnership, and Growth to understand roadmap priorities, customer needs, and solution differentiation

Go-to-Market Planning & Launches

  • Support the planning and execution of product, solution, and major release launches
  • Support launch activities, including messaging and content development, audience definition and segmentation, enablement planning, readiness coordination, and success metrics
  • Coordinate cross-functional launch activities across Product, Growth, Client Partnership, Growth Marketing, and Marketing Communications
  • Ensure commercial teams are prepared to communicate new capabilities effectively

Sales & Client Partnership Enablement

  • Create and maintain sales presentations, solution overviews, one-pagers, FAQs, battlecards, and objection-handling resources, with up-to-date proof points and market positioning
  • Create content for, organize, and deliver training and enablement programs for Growth, Client Partnership, and Customer Success teams
  • Support RFP responses, executive presentations, and strategic account opportunities
  • Partner with commercial teams to improve message consistency and sales effectiveness

Market Intelligence & Customer Insights

  • Participate in the feedback cycle by gathering and synthesizing insights from clients, prospects, sales teams, customer-facing teams, and industry sources, including market trends, deal dynamics, objections, and buying drivers
  • Conduct competitive research and maintain competitive intelligence resources, partnering with the Insights team
  • Translate insights into recommendations for positioning, messaging, enablement, and commercialization strategy

Product Marketing Operations

  • Maintain core product marketing assets and source-of-truth documentation ensuring alignment with organizational priorities
  • Manage proof points, customer evidence, and commercialization materials with regular update cadences
  • Support continuous improvement of product marketing processes, frameworks, and best practices
  • Participate in implementation and maintenance of AI-enabled tools and workflows
  • Document and maintain process guides for recurring PMM workflows

Skills

Required:

  • Develop product positioning, messaging, and sales enablement materials
  • Product launch or commercialization initiative support
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills
  • Ability to translate complex concepts into simple, compelling business value
  • Cross-collaboration with Product, Growth, Marketing, and Client Partnership teams
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Preferred:

  • Develop customer-facing commercial content and sales enablement programs
  • Familiarity with regulated healthcare markets and enterprise purchasing processes
  • Experience supporting strategic sales opportunities and RFP responses
  • Owning recurring, cadence-driven communications and operational processes

Experience & Education

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B Product Marketing, Solution Marketing, Go-to-Market Strategy, or a related field
  • Experience marketing B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, healthcare data, health plan, provider, or adjacent healthcare solutions strongly preferred

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

Job Summary:

At Mercer Advisors, our purpose is to amplify and simplify our clients' financial lives through a fully integrated family office offering. We bring together fiduciary professionals across disciplines to do the best work of their careers — as one unified team committed to doing what's right for clients. We continue to reinvest in our people and platform so that our growth creates more opportunities for teammates and more value for clients.

Regis is Mercer Advisors' multi-family office offering designed for ultra-high net worth families with complex, multi-generational wealth. Regis clients often have the means to build their own family office, and they require a deeply integrated wealth management experience with the highest level of service, coordination, and sophistication. We are a team of world-class fiduciary professionals delivering integrated advice across investments, financial planning, estate strategy, tax strategy, and more with the aim of making every client feel like our only client.

We are seeking an exceptional Managing Partner, Estate Planning - Regis to lead and grow our UHNW-focused estate planning practice. This is a senior practice leadership role responsible for building and directing an elite team of estate planning strategists dedicated to serving our most complex families. You will serve as the firm's highest-level technical authority on estate planning matters, set the standard for planning excellence, and personally engage on the most sophisticated client situations. This is not a review or oversight role. You will bring the deep technical expertise, professional credibility, and collaborative leadership that UHNW families and top-tier estate planning professionals expect from a leader of this caliber.

Essential Job Functions for this role include:

  • Lead and grow the Regis estate planning practice, setting the technical standard, practice philosophy, and quality bar for the team.
  • Build, lead, and mentor an elite team of UHNW-focused estate planning strategists, fostering a culture of technical excellence, intellectual curiosity, and continuous development.
  • Serve as the firm's senior-most technical authority on estate planning, personally engaging on the most complex and high-stakes client situations.
  • Design and implement comprehensive, advanced estate plans for Regis families, incorporating sophisticated wealth transfer strategies tailored to multi-generational, high-complexity balance sheets.
  • Partner with senior wealth advisors, tax strategists, and Regis leadership to ensure estate planning strategies are fully integrated within each client's broader financial plan.
  • Own and deepen relationships with a select portfolio of Regis families, with balance sheets that often exceed $100M+.
  • Collaborate with clients' outside advisors, including independent attorneys, CPAs, trustees, and family office consultants, to ensure cohesive, comprehensive planning outcomes.
  • Lead and represent Regis in prospective client development, industry conferences, and thought leadership initiatives to enhance the firm's profile in the UHNW estate planning market.
  • Partner with Regis leadership on practice development, talent strategy, and operational improvements that strengthen the estate planning team's capabilities and client outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school; LL.M. in Taxation or Estate Planning strongly preferred.
  • Licensed to practice law in at least one state.
  • 20+ years of legal experience in estate planning, with the majority spent advising clients with balance sheets of $50M or greater; significant experience with $100M+ families required.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and leading high-performing estate planning teams in a wealth management, family office, or private wealth legal environment.
  • Deep technical mastery of federal transfer tax law, trust and estate administration, and advanced wealth transfer planning techniques.
  • Proven ability to design and implement sophisticated multi-generational estate plans that address the full complexity of a UHNW family's balance sheet — across entities, jurisdictions, and family dynamics.
  • Experience advising on business succession, liquidity events (IPOs, M&A exits, ESOP transactions), and the estate planning implications of closely held business interests.
  • Prior leadership experience at an AmLaw 100/200 firm, nationally recognized estate planning boutique, multi-family office, or equivalent private wealth platform.
  • ACTEC Fellowship strongly preferred.
  • AV Preeminent® Martindale-Hubbell rating preferred.
  • Comfort and credibility operating within a regulated RIA structure and a team-based financial advisory environment.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%.

This professional role requires availability during standard business hours of Monday through Friday from 8AM to 5PM. At times, the role may have early or late hours to meet business tasks and deadlines for external and internal client needs.

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

We are expanding and seeking an Account Director to join our HG team and provide leadership and senior-level support to our accounts. This role involves deeply understanding our clients' goals, KPIs, and products to develop strategic affiliate partnerships that align with their objectives. The Director is responsible for client relationship management, strategy ideation, collaborating with and developing junior staff, guiding them to achieve goals, overseeing progress, and effectively managing account economics.

The role is based in the Chicago office, although we’re open to remote hires. This is an exciting and critical role in building and scaling user acquisition with a top-tier agency in a growth stage.   • Delivering creative and well-thought-out ideas to achieve client objectives, effectively managing team deliverables, and monitoring performance metrics.

  • Continuously analyze campaign performance metrics (ROI, ROAS, conversion rates, affiliate partner performance) using data-driven insights to optimize strategies.

  • Identify opportunities to grow client accounts through upselling, campaign optimization, and revenue-generating initiatives, supporting effective strategy development.

  • Lead efforts to maintain operational excellence, streamline processes, and ensure high-quality deliverables that meet company and client standards.

  • Effectively communicate program performance and strategic direction to clients and team members.

  • Build and nurture strong client relationships, understanding their goals, challenges, and opportunities in affiliate marketing.

  • Prepare and deliver compelling and engaging client presentations, explaining strategic recommendations and providing insightful analysis on growth initiatives.

  • Lead and mentor a team, providing guidance and support in executing campaigns and achieving goals.

  • Act as an advisor and the highest point of escalation for clients.

  • Formulate and test new tactics, including outside traditional affiliates, to improve performance.

  • Prepare and manage budget vs actual reports for hours on accounts on a monthly basis and provide narratives for their portfolio of clients to management.

  • Ad hoc support in operational and sales, depending on capacity, including support with performance reviews, automation support, tool discovery to support account management, sales pitches, and other areas required to build the agency.

  • Proficiency in third-party affiliate tracking platforms such as Impact, CJ, ShareASale, etc.

  • Experience interacting with various publishers and high-value clients, showcasing strong communication skills.

  • Strong attention to detail.

On behalf of Defra, we are looking for HR Caseworkers (HEO) (Inside IR35)for a4-monthcontract based remotely.

In the Defra group, we deal with a vast range of issues that profoundly impact on people’s lives. We are responsible for England’s environment, our countryside and rural economy, the food and farming sectors and have lead responsibility for protection from a wide range of natural threats and hazards. We have developed a set of three strategic objectives covering our policy outcomes and corporate objectives. These objectives help us to deliver our ambitious vision to build our green and healthy future and provide a framework for all the important work we carry out.

Ourobjectivesare:

  • To pass on to the next generation a natural environment protected and enhanced for the future.
  • To lead the world in food, farming, and fisheries with a sustainable model of food production.
  • To be an outstanding organisation focused on making a difference, with world class delivery capability.

Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs .

25 Year Environment Plan - GOV.UK .

Defra Group HR is strengthening its HR casework service through additional HEO capacity. These roles will work across HR Casework and the Professional Standards Unit, providing practical, responsive support while helping move towards a more preventative service that builds managerconfidence and capability.

As an HR Caseworker, you will:

  • Provide advice, coaching and guidance to managers in Environment Agency and Natural England dealing with low-risk employee relations issues. This could include absence and performance management, probation, ill health retirement and employee moves on medical grounds. Postholders will coach managers to understand the relevant HR policy, consider the options and associated risks, and provide HR advice and guidance to managers, supporting them to progress cases towards timely and appropriate outcomes in line with employment law, organisational policy and ACAS guidance.
  • Support our increased focus on early intervention and prevention across Defra group (Defra, Environment Agency, Natural England, Animal and Plant Health Agency, Rural Payments Agency and Veterinary Medicines Directorate). This will include helping to deliver manager training, tutorials and bookable drop-in sessions on topics such as difficult conversations, informal resolution, performance, disciplinary and grievance matters. Existing materials for early intervention will be used and developed to extend support across the Environment Agency and Natural England.
  • Work within the Professional Standards Unit, supporting the Speak Up campaign and supporting expansion of the mediation offer. This may include coordinating and promoting Speak Up activity, supporting implementation of the 12-month plan, supporting mediation and casework continuous improvement activity to increase line managerconfidence and capability, coordinating stakeholders and helping improve the accessibility and effectiveness of these services.
  • Support casework data and reporting, maintain guidance and shared resources, and help ensure documentation and processes are ready for the introduction of a new system.
  • Collectively, the roles will provide immediate additional capacity while helping establish more sustainable, consistent and user-focused approaches to HR casework.

Essential:

  • Experience of working in an operational HR environment and applying HR policies to employee relations issues, with experience managingcomplex and high-risk casework.
  • Stakeholder management experience.
  • Strong communication, coaching and interpersonal skills, including the confidence to influence and appropriately challenge managers in difficult or sensitive situations.
  • Able to assess information, identify risks, manage competing priorities and work collaboratively across HR and the wider business.
  • Some experience of coaching, delivering training, briefings, workshops or learning sessions, either virtually or face-to-face.
  • Comfortable presenting information clearly to groups, explaining HR policies or processes in an accessible and practical way, and adapting their approach to meet different levels of knowledge and experience.

Desirable:

  • Confidence in facilitating discussion, responding to questions and using existing training materials to support learning and build manager capability would be beneficial.
  • CIPD Level 5 or Associate-level qualification, or equivalent relevant HR experience, would also be advantageous

Please be aware that this role can only be worked within the UK and not Overseas.

As a Disability Confident employer, Defra encourage applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates. Applications from candidates who identify as having a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role will be prioritised for review. Where application volumes are high, additional role-specific and desirable criteria may be applied as part of the shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance.

jobs.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

For the Project Manager level

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • The ability to run several projects at once without losing control of any of them.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

jobs.excerpt: Overview Find the problem.  Decide what to build.
jobs.description:
Overview
Find the problem. Decide what to build. Ship it to production and prove it worked.

Reporting to the CTO.

Company Details
Periskope helps businesses run customer conversations and operations on WhatsApp. Chats, groups, ticketing and automation live in one workspace, used by teams around the world.

  • $2.5M+ ARR

  • ~12 People

  • Profitable · Global customers

  • Seed · Saison Capital and Alliance

Requirements

  • 2–5 years: In engineering, product, a founder's office, or your own startup.

  • Product intuition: You can look at a screen and say what is wrong with it, and why.

  • Proof you build: Something real you made with AI tools. A product, an internal tool, an automation people still use.

  • Hustle: You unblock yourself. You do not wait for a spec, a designer or permission.

  • Appetite for depth: You do not need to know production systems today. You need to want to own them.

  • Clear communication: You explain decisions, flag uncertainty early, and move work forward in a remote team.

Responsibilities

  • Customer problems: Talk to users every week. Turn what you hear into a clear call on what to build next.

  • Concept to production: Scope it, build it with agents, deploy it, and iterate on real usage.

  • A product surface: Own a part of Periskope end to end, and the metric it moves.

  • What ships: Challenge agent output, test assumptions, and stay accountable for the code and the result.

  • Production reliability: When something breaks, find out why and fix it. Learn the data models, APIs and WhatsApp infrastructure underneath.

Job Details

Remote for candidates based in India.

Interview Process
Share your profile and one thing you took from idea to shipped: the problem, what you built, how you used agents, and what changed. Shortlisted candidates move through three steps.

  1. Conversation · Async on WhatsApp
    Talk through your work and product decisions with Bharat (CTO).

  2. Build together · 90 minutes
    Take a real Periskope problem from brief to working build, live with Bharat.

  3. Final conversation · 20 minutes
    Discuss the role and mutual fit with Swapnika (CEO).

Why This Role Exists
For years, building software needed two people. A PM decided what to build. An engineer wrote the code. Most of the time went into the handoff between them.

That split no longer makes sense. AI agents now write most of our code. Typing code stopped being the bottleneck. Judgment took its place: knowing which problem matters, what the smallest useful fix is, and whether it holds up in production.

A Product Engineer is one person doing the whole loop. You talk to the customer, make the call, direct the agents, ship the change and watch what happens next.

How the Work Flows

  1. Listen: Sales calls, support chats, churn reasons, usage data.

  2. Decide: Pick the problem that matters. Cut it to the smallest useful fix.

  3. Build: Direct agents. Review every diff. Test what they assume.

  4. Ship: Release to real customers, behind a flag if it is risky.

  5. Measure: Check usage and tickets. Keep it, fix it or kill it.

Then back to listening. A good loop takes days, not quarters.

Who This Is For
You do not need an engineering title. You need taste, speed, and a real wish to build things that run in production.

  • Engineers: Who care more about the customer than the stack.

  • Product managers: Who are tired of writing specs for someone else to build.

  • Founder's office operators: Who already do a bit of everything and want to ship software too.

  • Ex-founders: Who want to build product again, with less overhead.

Not a Fit If

  • You want a defined lane. This role does not have one.

  • You see building as someone else's job.

  • You think agents ship production code on their own. They do not. You own every line they write.

Important Note
ClanX is a recruitment partner, helping Periskope hire a Product Engineer.

Highlights

Talk to users. Ship with agents. Own the outcome.

About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
We are hiring our first E-commerce Lead to launch and own from zero to one.
Menlo builds in public, and our community of developers, builders, and robotics fans wants to wear it, carry it, and be part of it. Companies like 1X and Figure have shown how a great store turns a robotics brand into something people can hold. We want ours to be better, and we want one person to own the whole thing. This is a founding, full-stack commerce role. You will pick the platform, build the storefront, source the products, set up fulfillment, run the launches, and own the numbers. You will start with merch and community products. Because Asimov is open, modular, and built with a right to repair, you will also have a path to grow the store into kits, spare parts, and hardware components over time. If you have wanted to build a store end to end, with real creative range and a brand people already love, this is it.

What You'll Do

  • Stand up from scratch, including platform selection, storefront build, checkout, payments, and tax setup across Singapore, Vietnam, the US, and international customers

  • Build the first product line with our brand and design team, from apparel and accessories to limited drops that reflect the Menlo and Asimov identity

  • Own merchandising and the launch calendar, including pricing, product mix, seasonal drops, and tie-ins with product launches and community moments

  • Set up and manage fulfillment, from print on demand and 3PL partners to inventory, packaging, and global shipping

  • Own the store P&L, including margins, unit economics, and forecasting, and report on what is working

  • Drive growth and conversion through analytics, email and lifecycle flows, landing pages, and merchandising experiments

  • Run customer experience end to end, including support, returns, and the post purchase journey

  • Partner with DevRel, community, and supply chain to plan the path from merch into Asimov kits, spare parts, and modular components

  • Represent the store voice so every touchpoint feels like Menlo: open, technical, and built in public

What We Look For

  • Proven experience launching or running a direct to consumer store, ideally on Shopify, and taking it from setup to steady operation

  • A generalist who can move across merchandising, operations, and growth without waiting for a bigger team

  • Comfort with zero to one, where you make the call, ship it, and iterate

  • Solid grasp of fulfillment and logistics, including 3PL, print on demand, inventory, and cross border shipping

  • Data fluency, so pricing, margin, and conversion decisions are grounded in numbers

  • Strong brand and product taste, with an eye for what a technical, design-led audience will actually want

Nice to Have

  • Shopify Plus experience, or hands on comfort with themes, apps, and Liquid

  • Existing relationships with print on demand and 3PL vendors

  • Experience selling physical or hardware products, including spare parts or kit style catalogs

  • Merch or community commerce experience for a developer, gaming, or open source brand

  • Genuine interest in robotics, open source, and building in public

Why Join Menlo
This is your store to build, not a queue of tickets. You will own a surface end to end, for a brand people already love and a community of developers who want to represent it. The range is real: you go from shipping the first t-shirt to shaping how we sell kits, parts, and hardware down the line. If you want to turn a brand people love into something they can hold, this is where it happens.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

  • Strong understanding of capital markets and OTC derivatives, including Interest Rate, FX and Commodity derivatives.
  • Experience with Jira, actively managing and prioritizing a product backlog.
  • Highly organized, driven, and capable of working autonomously.
  • Highly skilled collaborator and excellent communicator, able to clearly articulate priorities and the user impact of initiatives to stakeholders.
  • Able to multi-task effectively across concurrent projects, and skilled at documenting detailed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Proficient at rapid prototyping
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering client value.

jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

OnTrac is seeking a hands-on Product Manager to join a modern product team building cloud-native applications on Google Cloud Platform. This is a builder's role, not an oversight role. You will own the backlog, write the stories, sit with engineers and designers every day, and decide what gets built next based on evidence from real users.

You start from the user and the outcome, not the process. You are as comfortable in a Jira ticket, a Figma file, or a query against product data as you are in front of a client sponsor. When a story is unclear, you rewrite it. When an engineer is blocked on a decision, you make it. When a release ships, you check whether it worked.

The ideal candidate is curious, decisive, technically fluent, and accountable. You structure ambiguous problems, form and test hypotheses, and lead with the answer. You take full ownership of what the team ships, escalate early with a recommendation attached, and never wait to be asked.

This is not a program management or portfolio oversight role. We are looking for someone who is in the weeds of one product with one team, day in and day out.

ENGAGEMENT

  • Expected start date: as soon as possible
  • Location: Chicago, IL or United States remote
  • You must be located in, and authorized to work in, the United States for the full duration of the engagement

PRIMARY DUTIES

These duties are representative rather than exhaustive.

  • Backlog Ownership: Own the product backlog end to end. Write user stories and acceptance criteria yourself, slice work into small shippable increments, and keep at least two sprints of ready work in front of the team at all times.
  • Product Discovery: Run discovery with UX and engineering: user interviews, usability tests, prototypes, and lightweight experiments. Make sure what the team builds is grounded in user research and evidence, not opinion.
  • Daily Team Partnership: Work alongside engineers and designers every day. Join stand-ups, answer questions in the moment, review work in progress, and accept or reject stories against acceptance criteria.
  • Prioritization and Trade-offs: Prioritize by user value and business outcome. Make scope, sequencing, and trade-off calls quickly, explain the reasoning, and adjust when the evidence changes.
  • Outcome Measurement: Define success measures with the client sponsor at the start of the engagement. Instrument features, track adoption, task success, conversion, or satisfaction after each release, and feed what you learn back into the backlog.
  • Technical Fluency: Understand the architecture well enough to discuss APIs, data, and integration trade-offs with engineers and architects. Pull and analyze product data yourself rather than waiting for a report.
  • Release Management: Plan and sequence frequent releases through CI/CD with the engineering team. Write release notes and coordinate rollout with client stakeholders.
  • Roadmap and Vision: Translate the client's goals into a clear product vision and a near-term roadmap that the team understands and can act on.
  • Agile Delivery: Take part fully in Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives, and SAFe events such as PI Planning, bringing a refined, sized, and dependency-mapped backlog. Work with the Scrum Master on flow and predictability.
  • Client Engagement: Be the product voice to client sponsors. Run demos, hold regular one-to-one touch points, anticipate their questions, and shape decisions with clear, evidence-based recommendations.

PATHWAY TO SUCCESS

Be prepared, work with intentional effort, and offer no surprises for our clients and teammates. Anticipate the next question, the next risk, and the next decision before others do.

Measures are set with the client and PMO for each engagement and typically include:

  • Outcomes shipped: Features released that move the agreed user and business metrics.
  • Backlog health: Ready, well-written work always in front of the team, with few stories returned for clarification.
  • Release cadence: Small, frequent releases rather than large, infrequent ones.

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Recruiting has run on the same model for decades: firms charge a fixed percentage of a hire's first-year salary for work that is largely manual, sourcing, screening, and outreach done one candidate at a time. That pricing made sense when the work required a person doing it by hand. It doesn't anymore.

Market Context

Foundry is an AI-native recruiting firm built around a simple idea: use AI agents to handle sourcing, screening, and candidate evaluation, and keep a small human team focused on what still requires a person: building trust with clients and candidates, exercising judgment on close calls, and closing the placement. That shift in who does the work lets us offer clients a fee that's a fraction of what traditional firms charge, without cutting corners on quality.

This is where we believe recruiting is headed. AI-native service firms are starting to emerge and prove the model works, and we're building toward that shift deliberately.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

  • Customer Development — Lead pilot placements with design-partner companies, convert them to paid retained relationships, and build the go-to-market motion

jobs.description:
About Fragrances of Ireland Ltd

About Us

INIS - the Energy of the Sea - is the signature fragrance of Fragrances of Ireland, a family-owned, independent boutique perfumery that has spent more than 40 years crafting ocean-fresh fragrance, seaweed-enriched body care, and home scent inspired by the wild Atlantic coast of Ireland. What began around a kitchen table has grown into a brand beloved by gift retailers and their customers around the world, while staying true to its independent, family-run roots. Our key channel focus is that of Independent Gift Retailers, Lifestyle and boutique retailers who choose curated and considered ranges not available in the mass market. Our growth strategy is deliberate & strategic. We want to build carefully in the right accounts and deepen our loyal independent base - growing the brand without ever losing the boutique character that sets INIS apart.

About the role

This is a growth-path role for an ambitious, early-career salesperson who wants to learn the US gift market from the ground up and grow into greater sales and account responsibility over time. You will work closely with our North America Sales Manager - supporting the accounts and rep network that drive the business today and steadily taking on more opportunity as you develop.

If you are hungry, organized, and want a brand worth believing in and room to prove yourself, this is a rare chance to grow with a beloved, independent company.

What you'll do

Support Sales and Growth (the heart of the role)

  • Support the North America Sales Manager in growing current customer base and developing new Independent, key- account and multi-door opportunities - always in a way that protects the brand’s boutique positioning and complements our current base. Build data driven but compelling category stories tailored to each new customer.
  • Follow up on and qualify leads, with disciplined, timely follow-through that turns interest into orders.
  • Vet and research new accounts and locations, helping decide where the brand will fit.
  • Learn & build the selling story. Build familiarity with category, data driven and merchandising thinking and star contributing and creating presentations that win and grow customers.

Grow into rep-network support

  • Support our independent rep groups - Acting as a reliable point of contact, coordinating information, and, as you develop, taking on more hands-on rep-group management over time with focus on Midwest and West.
  • Produce and send the monthly rep reports and use them to help track territory performance.

Support the operational backbone

A real and valued part of this role is keeping the business running smoothly - and, over time, making these processes faster and simpler for everyone.

  • Manage data files - keeping account, rep, and sales records accurate and up to date.
  • Support trade-show setup and logistics - the multiple registration portals each show requires, plus reservations and show details. Attend key Trade shows in alignment with NA sales manager.
  • Support vendor and key-account paperwork

Qualifications

Essential

  • Min of 2 –5 years of sales, account, or sales-support experience - ideally with some consumer goods Consumer Products Companies (fragrances, beauty, personal care, lifestyle) Experience in the Gifting Industry is welcomed.
  • Comfortable with spreadsheets and data files, and confident putting together clear reports and deriving insights.
  • A warm, credible communication style who builds easy relationships with reps, customers, and colleagues.
  • Strong capability inbuilding strategic selling stories.
  • Strong organisational capabilities - genuinely reliable with paperwork, portals, deadlines, and data accuracy.
  • Hungry, coachable, and ambitious - someone who wants to learn the market and grow into a bigger sales role.
  • Willing to travel, including multi-day trade shows, and able to self-manage in a remote role.
  • Curious about the gifting channel and excited to learn a distinctive, much-loved brand.

Desirable

  • A consumer-goods exposure to category management and merchandising - the direction this role can grow in.
  • Familiarity with the gift, home, or fragrance channels.
  • Experience working with independent sales rep groups.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary plus a performance bonus depending on experience and location.
  • A clear path to grow into greater sales and account responsibility.
  • Remote working.
  • Travel and expenses covered.
  • 20 Days’ Vacation
  • Contribution to personal health insurance plan
  • Company contribution to personal pension scheme.
  • Contribution to Gym membership

Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

Overview:

The 3Cloud Consulting Manager leads a team of engineers and architects and helps support solution development innovation and drives consulting best practices of cloud platform solutions that are foundational to a client’s transformational Azure journey.

The Consulting Manager role provides a career path for Senior Architects to maintain their technical edge while continuing to support client delivery excellence while collaboratively building career development paths for cloud platform architects and engineers. 

Mentorship & People Development

  • Coaching and Mentorship:
    Act as a coach in a player-coach model, providing hands-on guidance and support to architects, and engineers. Foster a culture of continuous improvement anchored in a growth mindset, encouraging team members to seek feedback, learn from challenges, and celebrate progress. Maintain regular one-to-one connections with each team member, provide clear feedback, and help them remove blockers related to client work, pursuits, or internal initiatives.
  • Consultative Leadership:
    Promote a consultative approach across all team members. Encourage strong relationship-building with clients and peers, and lead by example through thought leadership and strategic influence.
  • Skills Inventory and Upskilling:
    Regularly assess individual and capabilities. Develop and implement upskilling plans to ensure every team member has a clear career path aligned with both individual aspirations and organizational growth objectives. Track progress and celebrate milestones in professional development.
  • Vision and Practice Strategy for Delivery Excellence:

  • Mange Career Growth Plans and workload:
    Establish open communication channels within the team. Maintain a clear view of each team member's delivery commitments, growth plans, and internal contributions. Develop and grow team members through regular coaching, clear expectations, and constructive feedback. Build a culture of trust, inclusion, and collaboration. Oversee staffing and resource alignment across teams, balancing utilization, development goals, client needs, and sustainable workloads.
  • Cross-Practice Collaboration:
    Champion a “One 3Cloud” experience by facilitating collaboration with cross-service line teams (such as Data, App Innovation, and Managed Services). Share best practices and innovative techniques that elevate team performance and drive successful execution across the organization. Help individuals build their personal professional brand as they look to expand their internal and external network.
  • Performance Evaluation:

Lead or support performance reviews, promotion recommendations, and compensation input for your teams, using consistent standards that reflect both impact and behavior.

Delivery and Team Support Activities

  • Key and Priority Account Oversight:
    Oversee and support strategic accounts, ensuring that key and priority clients receive exceptional service and attention. Collaborate with account teams to address complex needs and drive successful outcomes.
  • Project Escalation Support:
    Serve as a primary escalation point for project challenges across the organization. Provide guidance and resources to resolve issues efficiently, minimizing disruption to client engagements and maintaining high standards of service.
  • Change Management and Project Extensions:
    Proactively facilitate change orders and project extensions when in-flight projects require adjustments. Ensure all changes are communicated clearly to stakeholders and that project scope, timelines, and deliverables remain aligned with client expectations.
  • Talent Acquisition and Recognition:
    Participate in the interview and selection process for cloud platform candidates, ensuring new hires align with team capacity needs and organizational culture. Support the upskilling and recognition of team members who demonstrate exceptional client impact and contribute significantly to practice growth.

Business Growth and Solution Development

  • Solution Development and Innovation:
    Support evolution and innovation of cloud platform solutions within your designated solution area. Partner with team leaders and principals to design, refine, and implement scalable delivery standards.
  • Solution Definition Frameworks:
    Support Solution Area lead with solution definition frameworks that establish best practices for delivery excellence. Ensure these frameworks are adopted across teams to drive repeatable, high-quality outcomes for clients.
  • Client Relationship Expansion:
    Facilitate the development of customer roadmaps and identify next steps to deepen client relationships beyond current engagements. Champion the “Land and Expand” approach to maximize long-term partnership value.
  • Delivery Escalation and Stakeholder Management:
    Build and nurture strong relationships with key client stakeholders. Serve as a delivery lead escalation point to ensure client expectations are managed and exceeded, and that any challenges are addressed promptly and effectively.

Individual Targets

As a Consulting Manager, you are accountable for achieving the following individual targets that directly support the growth and operational excellence of the Cloud Platform practice:

  • Drive Business Metrics:
    Consistently meet or exceed the business metrics set by leadership for your solution area, including Delivered Revenue, Utilization, Project Profitability, and Gross Margin. Monitor performance against these metrics and take corrective action as needed to ensure organizational goals are achieved.
  • People Retention:
    Foster a positive, growth-oriented team environment that supports the retention of top talent. Implement strategies to enhance employee engagement, satisfaction, and career development, resulting in high retention rates and a strong, stable team.
  • Service Offering Expansion:
    Actively contribute to the development and launch of new service offerings. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify market opportunities, shape innovative solutions, and bring new services to market that address evolving client needs.
  • AI Enablement:
    Champion the adoption and integration of artificial intelligence within the team and across service offerings. Promote continuous learning and upskilling in AI technologies to enhance delivery capabilities and maintain a competitive edge.

A Freelance Motion Designer / Video Editor is needed to join Spot, a modern flat fee recruitment partner helping startups and growing businesses hire properly without expensive agency fees or clunky DIY hiring tech.

.

Based remotely, this is a project based engagement to produce a premium 60 second explainer video for our own brand. We already have the script, storyboard direction and brand assets in place. What we need is someone who can translate that into a sharp, modern, SaaS quality visual story.

.

Spot combines real recruiters, automation and clean hiring tech. We work with founders and scaling teams who want clarity, pace and quality in their hiring process. Our brand reflects that. It is minimal, confident and considered. This video needs to feel the same.

.

  • This is not a cartoon explainer.
  • It is not a template driven slideshow.
  • And it is not a whiteboard style animation.

.

We are looking for a clean, modern SaaS aesthetic. Strong typography. Controlled motion. Abstract UI elements rather than literal screenshots. Smart pacing. Subtle detail. Premium execution throughout.

.

The finished output will sit at the front of our brand and marketing, so design judgement matters as much as animation skill.

.

Deliverables include a 60 second explainer video, British English voiceover, music with subtle sound design, 1080p export, subtitles with SRT file and fully editable source files.

.

  • Clear experience producing modern SaaS or startup explainer content
  • Strong typography and layout capability
  • Confidence animating abstract UI and clean motion systems
  • A restrained, premium visual style
  • The ability to manage a defined project and deliver to deadline
  • We are not looking for whiteboard videos, clip art animation, heavy cartoon styles or generic template explainers.

.

In return, you'll work directly with our founders on a clearly defined brief with strong creative direction, flexible remote working and genuine potential for ongoing collaboration across future brand and product campaigns.

.

Job Title: Director, Gross-to-Net

Job Location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Principal, Market Access Technology & Solutions, Gross to Net Services Lead

Company & Team Overview


Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA - the Human Data Science Company™, offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.


The IQVIA Market Access Technology & Solutions team is a market-leading technology-enabled services division within IQVIA, that helps manufacturers in the US pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry. With offerings across systems integration partnerships and services, and managed business process outsourcing services, and analytics, we create value for our clients by advising and partnering with them on execution of key operational initiatives in today’s challenging landscape.


Position Overview

This Principal-level leader within IQVIA Market Access Technology & Solutions – Managed Services / Business Process Outsourcing team, leads cross-functional, distributed teams to provide advisory services and deliver exceptional gross-to-net (GTN) close and forecast services to US pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. The role combines GTN forecast and accrual model creation and management, balance sheet reserve management, cross-functional stakeholder management, project management for implementations of IQVIA's proprietary GTN application and transitions into steady state, and active support of business development and practice growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Acts as principal owner of client delivery with ultimate responsibility for client satisfaction and delivers high levels of quality/added value, and provides follow-up with client after project deliverable have been completed to ensure client satisfaction.
  • Utilizes quantitative and analytical skills and experience working with datasets related to Demand, Ex-factory Sales, Inventory, Chargebacks, Rebates, Patient Assistance Programs to create Gross-to-Net models for forecasting (Long Range, Latest Estimate, Rolling, etc.) and accruals management
  • Support client’s FP&A and Accounting organizations’ expectations for Gross-to-Net Close, Balance Sheet Reserve and Forecast processing cycles
  • Manages projects related to implementation of IQVIA's proprietary GTN application and transition to steady state ongoing operations
  • Provides direction, advice and intellectual leadership to clients and delivery teams.
  • Provides high level input to, and ensures the development of, client deliverables in agreed-upon SLAs.
  • Leads thought leadership and firm building initiatives.
  • Remains current on industry, client and competitive trends and directions in order to anticipate and identify new business challenges and issues at assigned clients.
  • Mentors, coaches and shares subject matter expertise with others to help develop individuals and our capabilities to deliver world-class solutions for clients.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience in consulting, or pharmaceutical industries with evidence of career progression
  • Strong academic track record including minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and an MBA or relevant graduate degree (desired but not a requirement)
  • Extensive experience in the life sciences industry with strong conceptual understanding of pharmaceutical supply chain and distribution channels, purchase-based and utilization-based contracting, and regulatory compliance, including government programs and pricing
  • Experience advising and supporting Clinical stage / pre-Commercial clients with GTN launch readiness activities for products that covered by pharmacy benefit and medical benefit, with various route of administration.
  • Working understanding of GAAP principles related to revenue recognition and gross-to-net accounting practices (CPA designation, even if inactive is preferred)
  • Ability to support client’s FP&A and Accounting organizations’ expectations for Gross-to-Net Close and Forecast processing cycles, which may include weekend and holiday hours to support SLAs
  • Working understanding of and willingness to keep current knowledge about regulatory impacts to pricing, contracting, market access to support conversations with client’s market access teams
  • Extensive experience working with datasets related to Demand, Ex-factory Sales, Inventory, Chargebacks, Rebates, Patient Assistance Programs
  • Extensive experience creating models for Gross-to-Net forecasting (Long Range, Latest Estimate, Rolling, etc.) and accruals and balance Sheet reserve management
  • Experience creating pre-deal and cross-channel pricing models with scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis capabilities
  • Strong quantitative skillset with experience working in Excel, PowerBI or other similar toolsets

New Nuclear Business Development

Your role

This position focuses on understanding your clients' goals and building the best marketing strategy to achieve the most important business objectives. This involves acting as a true advisor: staying curious, listening to your clients and adapting to changes in the market or the clients' businesses, whether that presents opportunities for growth or the need to pivot. Through it all, you are the clients' guide through the execution of strategy, serving as their main point of contact and managing their expectations, feedback and contributions to the work.

What that looks like:

  • Knowing your clients' businesses and goals deeply so you can build and continually advise on the best marketing strategy for their needs. This means always looking for untapped growth opportunities, pitching strategic initiatives and switching gears when our original strategy isn't producing expected results.
  • Providing guidance and feedback to creative teams that results in ads, landing pages and experiences that drive conversions and pipeline revenue
  • Analyzing data, identifying insights that shape creative and strategic decisions, and reporting those insights clearly to clients
  • Seamlessly shifting from strategic (e.g., consulting in workshops) to tactical (e.g., setting up campaigns) thinking
  • Reading frequently — marketing books, platform updates and other sources — to continually improve your knowledge
  • Seeking smart solutions to the inevitable roadblocks in any marketing program
  • Constantly challenging the team to think strategically with a focus on outcomes: What’s the best path to help our clients hit their revenue goals?

Within the strategy department, you’ll work closely with the strategy director, senior strategists and performance marketers to resolve issues, define processes and better your teammates.

  • Diving into professional development opportunities
  • Sharing wins and challenges with the team
  • Owning responsibilities for the department

  • Build strong relationships with your clients and teammates

The person

Job Title: Clinical Project Manager

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:


The Clinical Project Manager (Sponsor dedicated) will be leading Local Study Teams at country level to deliver committed components of clinical studies according to agreed resources, budget and timelines complying with Sponsor Procedural Documents, international guidelines such as ICH-GCP as well as relevant local regulations.

In addition to leading the Local Study Teams, the Clinical Project Manager may perform site monitoring as needed to support the flexible capacity model. The Clinical Project Manager is responsible to ensure that sites are identified, site qualifications performed, set up, initiated, monitored, closed and documentation archived.

Main Responsibilities

  • Has the overall responsibility for the study commitments within the country and for timely delivery of data to required quality.

  • Leads Local Study Team consisting of CRA(s), CSA(s), for assigned studies.

  • Leads the performance of the Local Study Team at country level ensuring compliance with Sponsor Procedural Documents, ICH-GCP and local regulations.

  • Ensures that clinical and operational feasibility assessment of potential studies is performed to the highest quality.

  • Coordinates the site selection process by identifying potential sites/investigators, performing initial Site Quality Risk Assessment, and conducting Site Qualification Visits to evaluate suitability and quality risks.

  • Ensures timely submission of application/documents to EC/IRB at start up and for the duration of the study. Works together with Regulatory Affairs to ensure timely delivery of application/documents for submissions to Regulatory Authority for the duration of the study, and in line with local regulations.

  • Ensures timely preparation of country financial Study Management Agreement (fSMA) and maintains accurate study budget in Sponsor clinical studies financial system.

  • Ensures timely preparation of local Master CSA (including site budget) and amendments as needed.

  • Ensures timely preparation of country level Master Informed Consent Form (MICF) and subsequent site level ICFs, including any relevant translations.

  • Ensures all country and site level trial essential documents required by ICH-GCP prior to study start have been collected.

  • Plans and coordinates applicable local drug activities (from local purchase or reimbursement to drug destruction).

  • Sets up and maintains the study in CTMS at study country level as well as local websites as required by local laws and regulations.

  • Oversees, manages and coordinates monitoring activities from site activation through to study closure at country and site level in accordance with the Monitoring Plans.

  • Reviews monitoring visit reports (as required and following Sponsor SOPs) and pro-actively advices the monitor(s) on study related matters.

  • Performs any required co-monitoring, Accompanied Site Visits/training visits with study CRAs.

  • Proactively identifies risks and facilitates resolution of complex study problems and issues.

  • Organises regular Local Study Team meetings on an agenda driven basis.

Required Skills and Qualifications:


  • Bachelor degree in related discipline, preferably in life science, or equivalent qualification.

  • At least a year of experience in Clinical Project Management at Local level.

  • Very good knowledge of Oncology or Respiratory therapeutic area.

  • Proven ability to lead and motivate cross functional teams to deliver clinical trials according to or ahead of time plan, budget and with required quality.

  • Clinical Trial Phase III experience.

  • Excellent understanding of the Clinical Study Process including monitoring.

  • Excellent project management skills.

  • Strong ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks, attention to details and negotiation skills.

  • Very good knowledge of spoken and written English language.

  • Good ability to learn and to adapt to work with IT systems.

  • Ability to travel nationally and internationally as required.
