jobs.description:
We’re seeking a skilled IT Engineer to secure and scale the internal infrastructure that powers our mission-critical work.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Administer Google Workspace, manage Identity Provider (IdP), and set up SSO.

  • Manage device enrollment and device scripting in Iru/Kandji.

  • Author, maintain, and audit internal security policies and procedures.

  • Enforce CMMC 2.0 Level 2 and NIST security frameworks with Vanta.

  • Safeguard credentials and secrets across the team using 1Password.

  • Harden AWS account security, IAM policies, and role-based access controls.

  • Secure network access using Tailscale VPN.

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi alongside the infrastructure team.

  • Investigate security incidents and conduct routine vulnerability assessments.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong IT Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your configurations are documented, policies are enforced, and nothing slips through the cracks.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that the systems and policies you put in place are airtight and auditable.

  • You obsess over security. You’re always thinking about the attack surface and how to reduce it without making engineers miserable.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You read the spec, not just the summary.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to communicate security requirements to engineers in a way that makes sense and gets buy-in.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Hands-on experience with CMMC, FedRAMP, or NIST 800-171 compliance frameworks.

  • Experience writing and maintaining security policies and procedures.

  • Experience with MDM platforms such as Kandji, Jamf, or similar.

  • Experience administering Google Workspace at an organizational level.

  • Experience managing SSO and IdP solutions such as Authentik, Okta, or Google Identity.

  • Proficiency with AWS IAM, security groups, and access management.

  • Experience with security and compliance platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or Tugboat Logic.

  • Experience with secrets management tools such as 1Password or HashiCorp Vault.

  • Experience managing and securing macOS, Linux, and Windows endpoints.

  • Experience configuring and managing VPN solutions.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in a defense contracting or government-adjacent environment.

  • Familiarity with Pulumi or other Infrastructure as Code tools.

  • Proficiency in bash/shell scripting and Python.

What we offer

  • Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones.

  • Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

  • Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter.

  • Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact.

  • Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future.

Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI:

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent).

  • Relocation assistance (position dependent).

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Performance bonuses.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Technology home office setup stipend.

  • Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent).

We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are Evotix?

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue Excellence, show Leadership, deliver Impact, earn Trust, and Empower those around them.

The Role

Join Evotix as a Sales Enablement Specialist and help our sales and wider revenue teams access the training, tools and resources they need to succeed. Reporting to the Sales Enablement Manager, you will support onboarding, learning programmes, content and day to day enablement operations across our Assure and 360 products.

This is a hands on opportunity for someone looking to get into Sales Enablement. You will work closely with colleagues across the business, develop your skills in sales enablement and help make learning practical and easy to access.

No previous Sales Enablement experience is necessary for this role.

What You'll Do

    Onboarding and Training

  • Coordinate onboarding for new sales hires and support learning programmes for BDRs and other revenue teams, including scheduling, communications and session logistics.
  • Help prepare and deliver training sessions, workshops and practice activities, building confidence in presenting and facilitation with support from the manager.
  • Track learning progress, training completion and certifications in Allego, and follow up with learners and managers where needed.
  • Support managers with coaching activities, including identifying useful call examples in Gong and helping track agreed development actions.

    • Content and Enablement Resources

  • Create, update and organise practical resources such as guides, playbooks, process documents and training materials, with input and review from subject matter experts.
  • Keep Evotix University and Allego content current, clearly organised and easy for teams to find.
  • Help gather customer stories, competitor information and feedback to support relevant, useful resources.

    • Tools and Programme Coordiantion

  • Provide first line support for enablement resources and tools, responding to routine queries and escalating issues when needed.
  • Help maintain enablement platforms and learning records, including Allego, and support colleagues in using tools such as Gong and Salesforce.
  • Coordinate enablement updates and work with teams including Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Revenue Operations and Professional Services.
  • Support enablement projects by keeping plans, actions and stakeholders organised.

    • Partner Enablement

  • Help coordinate partner onboarding and training sessions, including scheduling, communications and materials.
  • Maintain partner learning resources and help track participation and gather feedback, working with partner teams and the Sales Enablement Manager.

    • Reporting and Improvement

  • Maintain accurate records and help prepare straightforward reports on participation, completion, resource usage and feedback.
  • Collect feedback from new hires, managers, revenue teams and partners; highlight gaps and suggest practical improvements to the manager.

What You Bring

    Essential

  • An interest in sales, learning, coaching or helping others succeed, demonstrated through work, study, volunteering or other experience.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and confidence working with a range of people.
  • A collaborative, curious approach and willingness to learn, ask questions and take feedback.
  • Confidence using everyday digital tools and an enthusiasm for learning new systems.
  • A willingness to develop presentation, facilitation and coaching skills.
  • A team player who enjoys supporting others to do their best work.

    • Desirable

  • Exposure to enablement or sales tools such as Allego, Gong or Salesforce
  • Experience in a sales, customer facing, training, administration or coordination role.
  • An interest in EHS&S, sustainability or B2B SaaS

Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.

Interview Process

We aim to keep our interview process transparent, fair, and respectful of your time. While steps may vary slightly by role, you can typically expect:

  • Initial chat: A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn more about your background, motivations, and answer any initial questions.
  • Hiring Manager interview: A role-focused discussion exploring your experience, skills, and how you approach real-world scenarios relevant to the role.
  • Final Panel interview: A conversation with key stakeholders to dive deeper into collaboration, alignment, and mutual fit. This stage may involve a Task or Presentation to allow you to show off your skills!
  • Offer: If successful, we’ll move quickly to share an offer and next steps.

We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process — just let us know what you need.

Why join Evotix?

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive base salary and company-based performance bonus.
  • Time to Recharge: Unlimited Annual Leave because we trust you to balance your work and wellbeing.
  • Support for You: Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
  • Growth Opportunities: Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
  • Team Culture: Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

Ready to Make a Difference?
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!

Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadKeystead, an AI-native insurance brokerage venture.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadKeystead, an AI-native insurance brokerage venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Keysteadis an insurance brokerage built for the small businesses traditional brokers can't afford to serve. AI agents run the full workflow, from intake and multi-carrier quoting to binding and certificates of insurance, with licensed agents stepping in where judgment matters. Keystead starts with the businesses that need proof of coverage again and again, such as contractors, event vendors, and product brands selling into retail. For these owners, a certificate that takes days to arrive can cost them the job. Keystead issues it in minutes, explains coverage in plain language, and re-shops the market at every renewal.

Market Context

Roughly 35M small businesses in the US are underserved by a broker model built for larger accounts. Across the US and Canada, small business insurance represents a $6.2B commission pool. About $4.5B of that comes from businesses that already carry commercial insurance. Digital buying is proven, with the leading digital insurer serving more than 750K small businesses. The multi-carrier, servicing-first model remains open.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across insurtech and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with small business owners in certificate-heavy verticals, convert them to bound policies, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to commercial P&C insurance distribution, such as agency, brokerage, MGA, or insurtech experience, ideally with carrier relationships or a producer license

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Data Engineer

Experience: 0–5 Years (Freshers Welcome)
Salary Range: $85,000 – $125,000 USD per annum
Location: Seattle, Washington, United States
Work Arrangement: 100% Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Data Engineer to join our growing engineering team. This opportunity is open to candidates with 0–5 years of experience, including fresh graduates and entry-level professionals who are passionate about data engineering, programming, and building scalable data solutions.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of Python, SQL, Git, and REST APIs, along with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Candidates with a willingness to learn, adapt to new technologies, and work collaboratively in a remote environment are encouraged to apply.

Freshers and recent graduates are welcome to apply!

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using Python and SQL.

  • Write SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from different sources.

  • Assist in designing and implementing data integration and data processing solutions.

  • Work with REST APIs to collect, exchange, and integrate data between applications.

  • Support the development and maintenance of ETL/ELT workflows.

  • Perform data cleaning, validation, and quality checks to ensure data accuracy.

  • Use Git for version control and collaborative development.

  • Troubleshoot data processing issues and assist in improving pipeline performance.

  • Collaborate with senior data engineers, software developers, and analysts.

  • Maintain technical documentation for data workflows and processes.

  • Participate in code reviews, team meetings, and technical discussions.

  • Continuously learn and adopt new tools, technologies, and engineering best practices.

Required Technical Skills

  • 0–5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Development, or a related field.

  • Basic to strong knowledge of Python programming.

  • Good understanding of SQL and relational database concepts.

  • Familiarity with Git and version control systems.

  • Understanding of REST APIs and API integration.

  • Basic knowledge of data structures and data processing concepts.

  • Understanding of data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) concepts.

  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and work with datasets.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.

  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Basic understanding of data warehouses and data modeling.

  • Familiarity with libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.

  • Exposure to tools such as Apache Airflow, Spark, or similar technologies.

  • Academic projects, internships, certifications, or personal projects related to Python, SQL, or Data Engineering are a plus.

Freshers & Entry-Level Candidates

We strongly encourage fresh graduates and candidates with limited professional experience to apply.

Candidates can qualify through:

  • Academic or personal projects involving Python and SQL.

  • Internship experience in software development or data-related roles.

  • Relevant technical certifications or training.

  • Practical knowledge of REST APIs and Git.

  • Strong programming fundamentals and willingness to learn.

Professional experience is not mandatory for entry-level applicants who demonstrate the required technical foundation and learning ability.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Annual Salary: $85,000 – $125,000 USD.

  • Full-time employment opportunity.

  • 100% fully remote work arrangement.

  • Opportunities for technical training and professional development.

  • Career growth and learning opportunities.

  • Collaborative and supportive team environment.

Final compensation will depend on experience, technical skills, qualifications, and overall assessment. Entry-level and fresher candidates may be offered compensation appropriate to their experience.

Location & Work Requirements

About the Role

RTC is seeking an experienced Senior Development Manager to help build and grow our philanthropy function. Working closely with the Vice President of Philanthropy, this person will play a key role in shaping fundraising strategy, strengthening development operations, and expanding philanthropic support for RTC's mission.

This is a strategic and hands-on role with a primary focus on revenue generation. The Senior Development Manager will independently manage and grow a portfolio of mid-level institutional and individual donors and prospects, with direct responsibility for cultivating relationships, securing commitments, and stewarding donors. They will also help build the systems, infrastructure, and compelling fundraising narratives needed to support RTC's long-term growth.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful, collaborative fundraiser who brings strong relationship management skills, operational discipline, and the ability to turn strategy into action. They are comfortable building something new while taking ownership of the work that drives results.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Generation & Relationship Management (60%)

  • Independently manage and grow a portfolio of foundation, corporate philanthropy, and select individual donors and prospects, building toward achieving an annual fundraising goal of $1 million within the first two years.
  • Proactively build the pipeline by researching, identifying, qualifying, and cultivating new institutional and individual prospects, with a particular focus on converting new relationships into philanthropic support.
  • Build and strengthen donor relationships through thoughtful cultivation, personalized engagement, and stewardship that inspire long-term partnerships.
  • Develop proposals, grant applications, funding requests, and donor communications that connect RTC's mission and impact to funder priorities.
  • Collaborate across teams to identify opportunities for donor engagement and connect RTC's programs, outcomes, and impact to strategic priorities.

Development Operations & Infrastructure (20%)

  • Maintain strong portfolio and pipeline discipline in RTC's CRM ensuring accurate donor and prospect information, timely tracking of activity, and clear visibility into next steps.
  • Develop and maintain fundraising pipelines, revenue forecasts, dashboards, and performance reports to inform strategy and decision-making.
  • Strengthen development processes and workflows, including prospect management, gift tracking, acknowledgments, grant reporting, and stewardship, to support an efficient, coordinated, and growing philanthropy function.

Fundraising Strategy, Campaigns, & Communications (20%)

  • Partner with the Vice President of Philanthropy to develop and implement fundraising strategies that support RTC's revenue goals and long-term sustainability.
  • Help build and execute annual giving initiatives, targeted fundraising campaigns, and partner engagement strategies that expand and diversify RTC’s funding base.
  • Identify opportunities to engage RTC's board, alumni, and broader network in cultivation, stewardship, and fundraising initiatives.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in nonprofit fundraising, with a proven track record of building donor relationships and achieving fundraising goals.
  • Understanding of the philanthropic landscape in education, workforce development, technology, or other related mission areas.
  • Experience independently managing donor or funder relationships, including cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Experience with institutional fundraising, including corporate and foundation giving, grant proposals, and funder reporting.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop persuasive proposals and donor communications.
  • Comfortable with HubSpot or comparable CRM systems, fundraising reporting, and development operations. Experience building or improving development systems, processes, or fundraising programs is a plus.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to balance strategic priorities and hands-on execution.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach and comfort working in a growing organization where systems and processes are still evolving.

We recognize that strong candidates bring experience through a variety of professional and educational pathways. We encourage applicants who demonstrate the skills and capabilities needed for this position, even if their backgrounds do not align with every qualification listed.

In the first year, the Senior Development Manager will:

  • Build and actively manage a portfolio of qualified institutional and individual prospects, resulting in new and renewed philanthropic commitments.
  • Establish a consistent prospecting rhythm that meaningfully expands RTC's pipeline.
  • Strengthen portfolio management, forecasting, CRM discipline, and stewardship systems so RTC has clear visibility into fundraising progress.
  • Execute targeted fundraising campaigns and donor strategies that expand and diversify RTC's philanthropic base.
  • Build strong working relationships with VP of Philanthropy, CEO, and cross-functional colleagues and help establish a coordinated, high-performing philanthropy function.

All Applicants must be authorized to work within the US without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Position Title: Quality Assurance Registered Nurse (QA-RN)

Work Set Up: Work From Home (PH)

Quick Rundown:

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Registered Nurse (QA-RN) to ensure high-quality patient care by monitoring clinical practices, reviewing medical records for accuracy and compliance, and supporting continuous improvement efforts. This role conducts audits, tracks performance metrics, and collaborates with healthcare teams to maintain regulatory compliance, patient safety, and efficient care delivery.

What You’ll Do:

  • Perform regular clinical audits and chart reviews to ensure quality, safety, and compliance

  • Evaluate patient records, treatment plans, and documentation for accuracy and completeness

  • Identify risks, care gaps, and inefficiencies, and recommend actionable improvements

  • Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, CMS, OSHA) and organizational standards

  • Monitor and optimize scheduling processes to align with clinical priorities and reduce disruptions

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and scheduling teams to improve workflows and patient experience

  • Analyze QA data, track KPIs (patient outcomes, satisfaction, scheduling efficiency), and prepare reports

  • Provide feedback, coaching, and training to staff on documentation, compliance, and best practices

  • Assist in resolving patient concerns, scheduling conflicts, and care coordination issues

  • Support audit readiness and regulatory inspections through accurate documentation and reporting

  • Lead or contribute to continuous quality improvement initiatives to enhance care delivery and operational efficiency

What We’re Looking For:

  • Registered Nurse (RN) with a valid, active nursing license. A Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) is preferred.

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of clinical experience in nursing or healthcare settings. Prior experience in quality assurance, clinical auditing, or healthcare management is highly preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of clinical best practices, healthcare regulations, and quality assurance processes.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.

  • Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR) systems and healthcare scheduling software.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to assess clinical performance and recommend improvements.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to maintaining accuracy in patient records and clinical documentation.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and manage sensitive patient information in compliance with HIPAA and other privacy regulations.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact with healthcare providers, patients, and administrative teams in a professional and collaborative manner.

  • Certification in quality assurance, clinical auditing, or healthcare management (e.g., Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality – CPHQ).

  • Participate in the development and review of clinical protocols and procedures to ensure they align with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Stay informed on the latest healthcare trends, regulations, and technologies that may impact patient care and quality assurance processes.

  • Lead or participate in meetings to discuss patient care improvement initiatives and implement actionable strategies to enhance clinical operations.

Why You’ll Love Joining the CO Fam!

At Clark Outsourcing, we’re redefining what it means to work in a BPO. This isn’t your regular office setup - it’s where careers flourish, friendships grow, and fun is always part of the deal. Our culture is unmatched (seriously, our team swears by it), and we promise you’ll have to experience it yourself to believe it.

Here’s what’s in store for you:

Health and Welfare Benefits: HMO with prescription coverage, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th-month pay, retirement benefits, and more.

Beyond Work: Enjoy our in-office swimming pool (lowkey flex!), CO Club gaming lounge, CSR involvement through CO Stars, scholarship programs, and access to CO Academy for growth.

Travel Opportunities: We send at least 20 staff per year to visit our clients in the US, UK, and Australia, giving you international exposure and experience.

Leave Benefits: Paid holidays, Earned PTO on your first month, Wellness leave (no questions asked), plus special leaves like bereavement, parental leave, and Magna Carta leave.

Extra Perks: Salary loans up to PHP 1M (via BPI), CO Swag Bag, birthday and anniversary tokens, and our COol & flexible workplace.

Growth and Recognition: Yearly performance appraisals, career advancement programs, CO League events, and guidance from our amazing Coaches!

jobs.description:
who we are

Zur Erweiterung unseres Teams in Deutschland suchen wir einen Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Lead*, der als fachlicher Lead unser SAP-Commerce-Cloud-Servicegeschäft verantwortet und zugleich B2B-Kunden bei Strategie, Architektur und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Webshops berät.


* Geschlecht egal – Hauptsache, du passt zu uns!

who we are looking for

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Konzeption von Architekturen und Integrationen in bestehende Systemlandschaften: Du entwirfst tragfähige Lösungen für SAP Commerce Cloud und bewertest Alternativen gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden.
  • Beratung unserer B2B-Kunden zu Strategie, Roadmap und Weiterentwicklung ihrer SAP-Commerce-Cloud-Webshops, inklusive Composable Storefront und Composable-Commerce-Architekturen.
  • Analyse und Optimierung der Prozesse End-to-End, von Katalog, Preis und Bestellung bis zu Fulfillment und After-Sales, mit dem Ziel, Webshops effizienter und wirtschaftlicher zu betreiben.
  • Unterstützung unseres Vertriebs bei Presales-Aktivitäten: Workshops, Fit-to-Standard-Assessments und Aufwandsschätzungen.
  • Begleitung der laufenden Weiterentwicklung der Kundenshops: Bewertung von Upgrades, Release-Wechseln und neuen Funktionen sowie Ableitung einer passenden Roadmap.
  • Planung, Schätzung und Steuerung von Change Requests und Weiterentwicklungen sowie Mitgestaltung unseres SAP-Commerce-Cloud-Angebots, Best Practices und Standards.
  • Fachliche Verantwortung für das Application Management von SAP Commerce Cloud (Public Cloud): Du bist Ansprechpartner für Kunden und Fachbereiche und steuerst Incident-, Problem- und Change-Management im Second und Third Level Support.
  • Sicherstellung der Servicequalität: Priorisierung, Eskalationen, Root-Cause-Analysen, SLA- und Aufwandsreporting sowie regelmäßige Abstimmungen mit Kunden.
  • Fachliche Führung unseres Delivery-Teams aus DACH und Indien: Code-Analyse und Reviews, Patch- und Releasemanagement, Monitoring, Build- und Deployment-Pipelines sowie Pflege von Runbooks und Wissensdatenbank.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Delivery-Teams in Europa, Americas und Indien, um die Projektziele effizient zu erreichen.

what you bring

Was du mitbringst:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) in Projekt und Betrieb, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer Lead- oder Verantwortungsrolle, zum Beispiel als Tech Lead, Solution Architect oder Service Delivery Manager.
  • Praxis im Betrieb von SAP Commerce Cloud v2: Cloud Portal, Umgebungen und Deployments, Monitoring und Logging sowie Patch- und Release-Zyklen.
  • Technisches Verständnis, um Code zu analysieren und zu bewerten: Java und Hybris-Backend (ImpEx, Backoffice, Solr, OCC APIs) sowie Composable Storefront (Spartacus/Angular). Du musst nicht täglich im Code arbeiten, aber ihn bewerten und anleiten können.
  • Erfahrung mit AMS- und ITSM-Prozessen: Incident, Problem und Change, SLAs, Eskalationsmanagement und Ticketsystemen.
  • Fundiertes End-to-End-Prozessverständnis im B2B-E-Commerce, von der Kundenanfrage bis zur Auslieferung und Rechnung.
  • Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Fach- und Managementebene, Erfahrung mit Workshops, Präsentationen und Aufwandsschätzungen.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative.
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Begeisterung für neue Technologien und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Zusätzlich von Vorteil:
  • Kenntnisse im SAP-CX-Portfolio, zum Beispiel Sales und Service Cloud (V2), Engagement Cloud (Emarsys) und Customer Data Platform, sowie im Zusammenspiel von Commerce mit Marketing-, Vertriebs- und Serviceprozessen (CRM).
  • Erfahrung in Architektur und Integration von Commerce-Lösungen mit ERP-Systemen (S/4HANA, ECC), zum Beispiel für Preise, Bestände, Aufträge und Stammdaten.
  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD und DevOps im Commerce-Cloud-Umfeld sowie SAP-Zertifizierungen im Commerce-Umfeld.

what we offer

Warum du als SAP Commerce Cloud Lead bei Evora richtig bist?

  • Du übernimmst eine Schlüsselrolle an der Schnittstelle von Betrieb, Beratung und Weiterentwicklung von B2B-Webshops und prägst, wie wir SAP Commerce Cloud am Markt aufstellen.
  • Wir bieten dir Gestaltungsfreiheit in der Umsetzung und Entwicklung von SAP-Projekten mit echtem Kundenmehrwert.
  • Wir sorgen für deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung durch maßgeschneiderte Projekte, individuelle Karriereplanung und Mentoring.


Bei uns erwartet dich nicht nur ein Job, sondern eine werteorientierte Zusammenarbeit in einem globalen Team. Wir leben und fördern unsere selbstbestimmten Core Values Collaboration, Happiness, Trust, Commitment, Evolution und Entrepreneurship.


Was wir Dir abseits vom Standard anbieten:
  • Deine mentale Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen! Deshalb bieten wir dir Zugang und Unterstützung zu allen mental-health-bezogenen Themen durch unsere Kooperation mit nilo.health. Von Präventionsangeboten bis hin zur Akutbetreuung – wir sind für dich da.
  • Flexibilität ist uns wichtig! Mit einem Remote-Arbeitsvertrag kannst du bequem von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Wir unterstützen dich auch bei der Ausstattung deines Home-Office-Arbeitsplatzes, damit du dich optimal entfalten kannst.
  • Vereinbarkeit von Job & Privatleben! Neben flexiblen Arbeitszeiten bieten wir zusätzliche Kind-Krankheitstage an, um dir familiäre Herausforderungen wie die Kinderbetreuung zu erleichtern.
  • Wir investieren in deine Weiterbildung! Mit einem jährlichen Budget hast du die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Bei uns wird Teamarbeit großgeschrieben! Neben Gesundheitszuschüssen bieten wir dir auch teaminterne Wertschätzungstools. Zudem erwarten dich spannende Veranstaltungen wie unsere Internationale Co-Working Week, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und Team-Co-Workings.
  • Wir stehen für gelebte Chancengleichheit! Bei uns sind alle willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft oder Lebenshintergrund. In Initiativen wie unserem Evora-Women-Call geben wir den Raum, spezifische Themen direkt und ohne Umwege ans Management zu bringen.
  • Wir belohnen deinen Erfolg! Nach Abschluss deiner Probezeit stehen dir verschiedene Optionen wie Firmenwagen, Firmenrad oder Bahncard zur Verfügung. Zudem bieten wir eine gehaltsbezogene Beteiligung an den Unternehmenszielen und -erfolgen.

Die Evora Group ist ein End-to-End-Partner für die digitale Transformation von Unternehmen, die auf SAP, ServiceNow und Microsoft setzen. Wir beraten, setzen um und bleiben, solange wir gebraucht werden. Mit über 500 SpezialistInnen in 11 Ländern verbinden wir Betriebsmodell-Design, Implementierung und laufenden Betrieb zu einem System, das messbare Ergebnisse liefert statt nur Empfehlungen. Als Teil der Allgeier Group gehören wir zu den führenden IT-Service-Unternehmen im DACH-Raum.

Bereit, Teil von Evora zu werden?

Bewirb dich jetzt – wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

The Account Executive develops and maintains client relationships, understands client’s business environment, strategy and identifies customer business objectives or problems that can be solved with technology.  The AE develops a plan to sell technology solutions to the client/prospect and leverages and coordinates all resources for successful sales execution, with assistance from sales leadership.  The AE is expected to cross-sell the array of hardware, software, cloud, and professional services our organization offers. This role also requires the necessary sales administrative activities including use of SFDC, forecasts, deal registrations, presentations, proposals/quotes etc. As well as, maintaining professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops/training and establishing personal networks in professional societies.

Essential Functions:

Responsible for all sales activities in assigned accounts and achieves established sales targets annually. Solution selling of technology-based solutions to solve business and/or solution segment problems. Promotes and sells Pellera’s value proposition and solution offerings (Digital Infrastructure, Digital Workplace, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Advanced Analytics, Application Modernization, Managed and Professional service etc.) to clients and prospects. Drives client engagements proactively with Solutions Practices and Services teams.  Ability to manage and drive a multi-month sales cycle and multi-million-dollar transactions. Develops a list of prospective clients for use as sales leads, based on information from own professional network, OEM partners, trade shows, social media websites, business directories, and other sources. Develops robust ongoing pipeline of business opportunities at a quantifiable three times level of quota expectation.  Establishes and maintains current client and potential client relationships. Responsible for Client Satisfaction. Identifies and resolves client concerns. Works with OEM partners to develop a plan to approach prospective clients. Gains clear understanding of client business requirements. Educates Clients of full portfolio of solutions. Prepares presentations, proposals, and sales contracts. Ability to present solutions to clients, influencers, decision makers and executives. Provide forecast updates on current opportunities and update CRM on a weekly basis. Build a territory plan to meet monthly and annual gross profit targets. Maintain a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as Converge Compliance Policies to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical, and professional behaviors. The assigned Inside Sales team will assist in preparing quotes to your end users and the processing of resulting orders. Main activities include vendor follow up, tracking, delivery and expediting through invoicing to ensure a positive customer experience.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ethical and Critical Thinking Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills. Excellent sales and customer service skills. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines. Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate. Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment. Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

Education and Experience:

Minimum of 3-5 years demonstrated outside sales experience required. Basic understanding of consultative, solutions sales process. Various vendor certifications as necessary.

How to Apply

Social Media & Digital Marketing

o Sold / Leased announcements
o For Sale / For Lease promotions
o Brand awareness pieces
o Testimonials
o Events and podcasts
o New employee announcements
o Personal/professional content
Vendor Paid Advertising

Qualifications as a Commercial Property Administrator:

• Proven experience in commercial real estate administration.
• Mandatory experience with Realworks and Re-leased software.
• Strong understanding of commercial property documentation, forms, contracts, and tenancy/legal processes.

jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Job Overview

The R&D Sterilization Validation Scientist is an essential technical role within the R&D Science team, responsible for designing, validating, and sustaining the sterilization program for Healthmark manufactured and distributed medical devices.

Reporting directly to the Senior Principal Scientist in the R&D Science department in Fraser, MI, this position focuses on integrating sterilization validation into the early stages of new product development and providing advanced scientific support for sustaining engineering, material changes, and product lifecycle management. The Scientist ensures that all designs meet global regulatory standards for sterile barrier integrity, material compatibility, and microbial performance before commercial launch and throughout the product’s lifecycle. This position is fully remote for US candidates, with a preference in Eastern Standard Time. The role will require approximately 30-35% travel to our site in Fraser, MI and external testing labs.

Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties:

1. New Product Development (NPD) Support

  • Serve as the sterilization validation SME on R&D project teams, embedding "design for sterilization" principles into the early phases of healthcare consumable product development.
  • Define sterilization requirements, evaluate new material technologies, and assess material compatibility with various sterilization modalities (e.g., EO, Steam, Gamma, VHP).
  • Author, execute, and review R&D protocols, test methods, and validation reports specific to sterilization validation and material compatibility.

2. Sterilization Validation & Integrity Testing

  • Design and manage validation programs in strict compliance with ANSI/AAMI/ISO 11135, 11137, 14937 and 17665 and ISO 11607 (Parts 1 & 2) and applicable sterilization standards (ISO 11135, ISO 11137, ISO 17665).
  • Coordinate and execute microbial barrier testing, physical integrity testing (e.g., tensile, burst, dye penetration), and shelf-life studies (accelerated and real-time aging).
  • Direct and manage medical device sterilization and biocompatibility testing with external laboratories (ensuring compliance with ISO 10993 standards for material safety and biological evaluation).
  • Partner with external testing laboratories and contract sterilizers to schedule and oversee protocol execution.

3. Sustaining Engineering & Existing Product Support

  • Provide technical support for existing product lines, evaluating the impact of manufacturing process improvements, site transfers, or material supplier changes on product sterilization claims and integrity.
  • Lead product adoption and equivalency assessments to incorporate design modifications or line extensions into existing sterilization validation frameworks.
  • Perform periodic re-validation, review annual sterilization data, and maintain up-to-date Design History Files (DHF) and Risk Management files.
  • Lead complaint investigations for product sterilization compatibility and validation issues

4. Technical Writing & Regulatory Compliance

  • Draft the sterilization sections for regulatory submissions (FDA 510(k), EU MDR Technical Documentation, global filings).
  • Author clearly defensible scientific justifications and technical assessments to support product changes without requiring full re-validation where appropriate.
  • Investigate R&D-related non-conformances, out-of-specification (OOS) lab results, or test failures, determining root causes and implementing corrective actions.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • In-depth knowledge of US and Global standards for terminally sterilized medical devices.
  • Practical experience with industrial sterilization methods, particularly Ethylene Oxide (EO), Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide, and Moist Heat (Steam), plus working knowledge of Gamma/E-beam irradiation, and biocompatibility testing (ISO 10993).
  • Strong technical understanding of biological indicator (BI) and chemical indicator (CI) requirements and performance standards (e.g., ISO 11138 and ISO 11140 series).
  • Prior training and adherence to Good Documentation Practices and Good Laboratory Practices
  • Familiarity with medical device design controls (FDA 21 CFR Part 820.30 and ISO 13485).
  • Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to influence cross-functional project teams (Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory).
  • Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving skills.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Biomedical Engineering, Materials Science, Biology, or a related scientific/engineering field (Master’s or Ph.D. is a plus).
  • 3–5+ years of experience directly focused on medical device sterilization validation.
  • Direct experience working with sterile barrier systems (pouches, wraps, or rigid container systems).

Environmental/Safety/Physical Work Conditions:

  • Ensures environmental consciousness and safe practices are exhibited in decisions.
  • Works in office, laboratory, and manufacturing environments; follows applicable safety procedures and personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements when in the laboratory or on the production floor.
  • Use of computer and telephone equipment and other related office accessories/devices to complete assignments.
  • May work extended hours during peak business cycles.
  • The position requires travel of approximately 30-35%.
  • Able to lift 20 lbs. and stand for longer periods of time.

The physical demands described here are a representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We are looking for a Regional Head of Marketing, APAC who is responsible for strategically executing the regional marketing strategy and plan; provides a consistent approach, for improved brand impact and efficiency, to realize PMI ambition and regional growth plans; collaborates with regional and country business teams and marketing teams; integrates activities to generate profitable sales and volume growth in products and experiences and builds strong customer relationships.
jobs.description:
How will you make a difference to PMI? We are looking for a Regional Head of Marketing, APAC who is responsible for strategically executing the regional marketing strategy and plan; provides a consistent approach, for improved brand impact and efficiency, to realize PMI ambition and regional growth plans; collaborates with regional and country business teams and marketing teams; integrates activities to generate profitable sales and volume growth in products and experiences and builds strong customer relationships.

What you’ll bring to the role:

Assist in the execution of regional marketing strategy and development plans to generate regional revenue and drive conversions. Working collaboratively with Brand & Product Marketing to activate programs in the region. Identifies regional growth opportunities, customer segment trends, and relevant competitive activities that influence customer development performance. Adopting a growth mindset for continual improvement of campaigns to drive performance marketing, working closely with the Growth Marketing Manager and other cross functional leaders Establish sales enablement activities, leveraging marketing and product management for consistent customer engagement, and support for new sales pipeline growth with the sales teams. Managing direct agency relationships as applicable in the design and implementation of campaigns localized to regions. Serve as the central point of contact for regional marketing for the assigned region, and escalation to the Regional MD. Supporting the regional business team to customize assets to reflect the local market. Provide line management support Regional Marketing, coaching, developing, guiding, and being a point of escalation. Define the activities that are locally meaningful, establish awareness of PMI, and focus on lead generation. Contribute to the identification of priorities across regions that positively impact PMI. Develop KPIs and goals aligned with performance marketing metrics, track marketing performance, and develop reports against established goals and objectives; recommend adjustments. Provide proactive data analysis for regional recommendations on trends and future opportunities. Working with the Growth Marketing lead and PMI analytics team. Establish regional marketing operational processes to migrate from ‘growth’ to ‘in life’ approaches aligned to outcome-focused metrics, including field marketing support setup and team coordination. Develop and maintain detailed knowledge of PMI strategy, current and emerging solution capabilities, and strategic direction for advocacy efforts and team capabilities. Working alongside Marketing teams on new activities, to develop and sustain strong relationships with business teams and stakeholders at a global scale. Adopt Marketing Technology and Operations processes and governance, to the extent it is relevant.

Role Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in marketing or equivalent, MBA preferred. Minimum of 10 years of marketing experience; regional or global experience required. Experience working in a sales environment in a growing global organization or similar product environment. Ability to develop high-level marketing strategies. Solid understanding of the technical, financial, and operational elements of the organization Track record of successful vendor management Ability to effectively collaborate across the organization as well as with external partners Knowledge of marketing and relationship management tools and techniques with the ability to present and apply them in an association environment and externally on senior management and top executive level. Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills, including demonstrated team-based operational and strategic results, with the ability to lead, retain, and progress staff. Experience working in an agile, dynamic, and customer-centric environment. Excellent communication, collaboration, presentation, and negotiation skills Proficiency in the business language- English. Possible travel up to 25%.

jobs.title: Vice President of Business Development, Business Process Outsourcing - New Verti
jobs.excerpt: In a world of noise, we find the signal — the pulse of potential.
jobs.description:
In a world of noise, we find the signal — the pulse of potential. We weave the strands of talent, vision, and purpose into organizations that endure. Blending intelligence with intuition, we honor the human art of connection at the heart of every great company.

Remote (USA) | Base $135,000 to $150,000 plus commission | Target Year 1 OTE $300,000

ABOUT THE JOB

Build a new market in the industry you already know.

Our client is a fast-growing outsourcing company that builds dedicated remote teams for US businesses. Their people handle customer support, sales support, scheduling, admin, and back-office work inside the client’s own systems, as part of the client’s team. They became a known name in two niche industries by learning those businesses deeply, and the model worked well enough that they’re now taking it into new markets, starting with an acquisition that opens the door to real estate.

They’re hiring one or two Vice Presidents of Business Development to lead that expansion. Each VP owns a vertical: Real Estate, Home Services and Construction, Waste Management and Environmental Services, or Hospitality. You’ll build the go-to-market from the ground up: who to call, what to offer them, how to price and package it, and how to turn the first few clients into a reputation. You’ll report to the Senior Vice President of Sales and work alongside Marketing and Customer Experience. This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial seat for someone who wants to build a market, not inherit one.

THE MANDATE

Our client is clear about who will thrive in this role, and who won’t.

They’re not looking for someone who has spent their career selling staffing, outsourcing, or BPO services. They’re not looking for a strategist who needs a team to execute, or an account manager who’s most comfortable growing relationships someone else opened.

They’re seeking an industry insider: someone who has spent years in real estate, home services or construction, waste and environmental services, or hospitality, running part of the business or selling into it, who knows the owners and operators by name and understands where the work piles up: the phones, the scheduling, the paperwork, the follow-up that never gets done. You can sit across from a CEO and talk about their business, not about outsourcing. You don’t need to have sold a service like this before. They’ll teach you the offering. You bring the industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own new business for your vertical, from first conversation to signed agreement, with a pipeline you build yourself
  • Design the go-to-market for a new industry: the ideal client profile, the offer, the pricing conversation, and the partnerships that open doors
  • Land strategic partnerships and national accounts, then deepen them
  • Be the face of the company in your industry: conferences, trade associations, client visits, and the dinners where deals get started
  • Work with Marketing and Customer Experience so what you sell is what gets delivered, and what you hear in the market shapes the offer
  • Help set the strategic direction of the division as the new verticals take hold

IDEAL PROFILE

  • 5+ years in B2B business development with deep relationships in one of the target industries: real estate, home services and construction, waste management and environmental services, or hospitality
  • 5+ years in senior sales leadership with a track record of winning in that industry, or selling into it
  • Comfortable building and managing relationships with owners and the C-suite
  • Experience in high-growth environments, using data and technology to drive results
  • An entrepreneur’s mindset: strategic enough to design the plan, hands-on enough to run it
  • Collaborative, efficient, and motivated by results; you want to win the day
  • Energized by networking and industry events
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, management, communication, or a related field
  • Strong written and spoken communication; tech-savvy and quick to adopt new tools
  • Not required: any background in outsourcing, staffing, or BPO

LOCATION & WORK MODEL

  • Remote, anywhere in the US
  • Core hours Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central
  • Travel for industry events, conferences, and client meetings

COMPENSATION

Base salary: $135,000 to $150,000, plus commission

Target OTE: $300,000

Realistic first-year earnings: $200,000 to $250,000 while you build the book

Benefits details will be provided during the interview process.

ABOUT THIS SEARCH

This search is being conducted by Signal & Strand, a boutique recruiting and people operations firm headquartered in Long Beach, CA with national and international reach, on behalf of our client. The company’s name will be shared with candidates as the conversation moves forward. All inquiries are held in confidence.

The Right Hire Changes Everything®

Base Compensation Range
$135,000—$150,000 USD

Equal Opportunity & Non-Discrimination Statement

We—and our clients—do not discriminate in employment or contracting on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, registered domestic partner status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Lawgent är en modern juristbyrå för företag som verkar där juridik, AI, data och europeisk reglering möts. Vi arbetar med bland annat AI och data, GDPR, digital reglering, finansiell reglering och kommersiell juridik, och gör komplex juridik tydlig och användbar. Nu växer vi i hela Sverige.

Det är meriterande om du

Varför Lawgent

  • Obegränsad intjäning: din inkomst växer med de affärer du skapar, utan tak

Vi går igenom upplägget och hur du tjänar pengar hos oss redan under första samtalet.

jobs.description:
Project Manager

The Opportunity: As the Project Manager, you will navigate the execution of projects like a skilled sailor at sea. You assist with charting the course by translating client briefs into clear, actionable project plans, steering through the complexities from inception to completion. With a keen eye on budgets and schedules, you ensure the ship stays on course, raising the flag if turbulent waters are upon us and looking for the solution to get us through.

Your teamwork as a crew member ensures smooth sailing by consistently managing internal team communications to deliver the highest quality work. You can adeptly adjust the sails, regularly soliciting and acting on client feedback to ensure every project reaches its destination effectively.

What kind of person would that be?

Organized and on top of it. Someone people often describe as “dependable” and “reliable”. Flexible, not like Yoga, but open to learning. An active listener (which is a thing). A human, who likes people and forges strong relationships. Assertive and confident when identifying and responding to issues that might put a project at risk. Easily earns trust. Likes to have fun, a real plus. You know when and how to reach out, and can adapt your style to effectively manage up, down, and across.

What you’ll be part of:

One of the fastest growing integrated marketing/PR agencies on this planet. Offices and opportunities across the globe. Fantastic clients and a robust pipeline. Talented people at every position. Kind people. Leadership that cares about your success and provides career mentorship. A commitment to workable processes and taking care to do things correctly the first time. An agency that cares about work culture and gives you a voice in it.

Why Join FINN Partners?

  • Competitive salary, benefits package, and a commitment to work-life balance.
  • A culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration.
  • Career advancement opportunities in a fast-growing company.
  • A wellness subsidy.
  • A manager that provides consistent 1:1 check ins, reviews, and culture-building opportunities to connect with people across the organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Strong attention to detail in all aspects of projects and communication.
  • Delivers professional & friendly interactions with client & team.
  • Act as a communication hub for project team, partners, vendors, and clients.
  • Produces clear, concise, organized and actionable written documents and correspondence, both internal and external. Including but not limited to QA, updating status documentation and time reports.
  • Adept at problem solving and/or knowing who to go to for help.
  • Understand the client's business and project management systems
  • Ability to use agency systems and follow established processes and workflow.
  • Schedule and attend key touch-point meetings, both internal and external. Ensuring the team is prepared with a call agenda and additional required information.

Qualifications:

  • Prior experience as a project manager in an agency setting or comparable is helpful.
  • 1-3 years of experience in project management.
  • Bachelor’s degree is a plus.

Anticipated Salary: $55,000 - $65,000

Compensation is based on experience, qualifications, location, and level at which the candidate is hired.

To Apply:

Please upload your resume and cover letter, as well as indicate your desired salary in

$US Dollars. While we appreciate the interest of all candidates, we will only respond to

those with whom we have a greater interest.

About FINN
Founded in 2011 on the core principles of innovation and collaborative partnership, FINN Partners has grown from about $24 million in fees to nearly $200 million in fees over ten years, becoming one of the fastest growing independent public relations agencies in the world. The full-service marketing and communications company’s record setting pace is a result of organic growth and integrating new companies and new people into the FINN world through a common philosophy. With more than 1,300 professionals across 35 offices, FINN provides clients with global access and capabilities in the Americas, Europe and Asia. FINN Partners clients are also supported through longstanding partner agencies and its membership in the PROI network of leading agencies around the world.

Headquartered in New York, FINN has offices in: Abu Dhabi, Atlanta, Bangalore, Bangkok, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Delhi, Denver, Detroit, Dublin, Fort Lauderdale, Frankfurt, Hong Kong, Honolulu, Jerusalem, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Madison, Manila, Mumbai, Munich, Nashville, Orange County, Paris, Portland, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Shanghai, Singapore, Washington D.C. and Yangon. About Anthology FINN Partners Anthology FINN Partners is Hawaii’s only integrated marketing and communications firm with a full-service market research firm in house. With a full-time staff of 80 professionals, Anthology has enjoyed the privilege of working with Hawaii’s top corporate, nonprofit and government clients. Headquartered in Honolulu, we have a proven track record of executing successful integrated communications campaigns, and a deep bench of best-in-practice professionals across all disciplines needed to market in today’s environment.

jobs.title: Director of Professional Services
jobs.excerpt: Somewhere in your career, you walked into something that was already going wrong.
jobs.description:
Somewhere in your career, you walked into something that was already going wrong. A rollout three weeks from a date it was not going to hit. A team that had stopped telling anyone the truth about status. A client who had already decided you were the problem.

You did not wait for a playbook, because there was not one. You figured out what was actually broken, told people the parts they did not want to hear, and rebuilt the plan so it would hold this time. And when it landed, it landed because of how you ran it.

That is the kind of Director of Professional Services we are looking for.

What We Do

Every school district in America runs on service. Parents need answers, teachers need support, IT teams need systems that work. Most districts cobble that together with disconnected tools, overwhelmed staff, and no real visibility into what is working.

Onflo built the platform that fixes that. Our unified service platform brings together customer service, help desk ticketing, call center operations, AI chat, and IT asset management, purpose-built for K-12 public education. When a district runs on Onflo, their staff spends less time firefighting and more time serving students.

Professional Services is the team that makes that real. A district signs with us because they were promised something. Implementation, ongoing client solutioning, and client care all sit in this function, and together they decide whether that promise holds.

The Role

You would lead the function end to end. Roughly ten people across two layers, with four direct reports: three Implementation Managers, and the Manager of Professional Services who leads the Client Solutions Managers and Client Care Engineers.

The first year is largely about making the function current. Processes exist, but some were built for a smaller book of work and need modernizing. Newer systems do not have documented processes yet. Capacity is managed by judgment rather than a model. You would update what is there and build what is not, while the current book of delivery work keeps moving and districts keep going live. For the right person that is the appeal, not the catch.

What you would own:

  • Delivery quality across implementation and ongoing solutioning engagements
  • Client care outcomes against service levels, delivered through the Manager of Professional Services
  • Post-implementation adoption, so districts realize the value they bought
  • Resource and capacity planning across the function
  • The methodology, templates, and standards the team runs on
  • Commercial performance of the function, including scoping, pricing, and margin, with the VP and Finance
  • Senior escalation point above the Implementation Manager and Manager level
  • Coaching and developing your direct reports

Who Thrives Here

We will be direct with you, because we think you will appreciate it.

Onflo is a small, entrepreneurial team in the middle of a rebrand and a change to how we deliver services. We do not have a perfect playbook. Priorities shift. Communication is not always tidy. Sales will sometimes scope something your team then has to deliver. Product will not always ship on the timeline you would hope. We know that, and we are actively working on it. What we do have is a product that genuinely helps schools, districts who trust us, and a team that cares about doing the work well.

The people who do their best work here build the thing that is missing rather than waiting for it. They are close to the work without taking it over, and they know the difference. They say the unpopular thing early, to Sales, to a district, to their own VP, and they say it without making it personal. They absorb pressure rather than passing it down, because escalations are a permanent feature of this function and the team takes its temperature from whoever is leading it. They take feedback and apply it, and they still hold a point of view.

If you have spent your career waiting for clear direction, a defined process, and stable priorities before you produce, this probably is not your role. If you have spent it figuring it out and delivering anyway, keep reading.

Two Ways In

We are running two candidate paths against the same bar, because the strongest delivery leaders come from two very different places. One is software: you have led implementation, professional services, or customer success inside a technology company. The other is the district side: you have led district-wide or multi-site operational, technical, or change initiatives from inside K-12, in IT, operations, or central-office leadership.

If you are coming from a district, your resume will not say "professional services" anywhere, and that is expected. We wrote our requirements around capabilities rather than job titles, and our screeners are instructed not to filter on vendor vocabulary. If you have run something district-wide from kickoff to the day it actually worked, apply.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7 to 12 years of professional experience, including 5 to 8 years managing people directly
  • Personal ownership of a large-scale, multi-department rollout from kickoff through steady state, vendor-side or district-side
  • Experience building a process, playbook, or operational framework where none existed, and recovering something that was genuinely at risk of failing
  • A repeatable approach to making a new system stick past go-live, with a metric you moved
  • Ownership of operating metrics for a team you managed, including acting when one went the wrong way
  • Enough working knowledge of K-12 systems, single sign-on, student information systems, and data provisioning, to hold a credible conversation and know when to bring in a technical resource. Configuration depth is not required
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management, including with Sales and Finance
  • K-12 or EdTech experience on the vendor side is a plus, not a requirement
  • Able to travel 10% to 25% for internal meetings, conferences, industry events, and occasional on-site work with districts
  • The right person reading this already knows if they are right for it. If that is you, apply.

Compensation and Logistics

$135,000 to $160,000 base depending on experience, plus a discretionary annual bonus. Fully remote within the United States, with core operating hours of 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern. A background check is required at offer, because districts set their own access requirements and we have to meet them.

Explore our website and LinkedIn to learn more about our work and impact.

Onflo is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities our clients serve. All are encouraged to apply. Onflo uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. Learn more at www.DHS.gov/E-Verify

The opportunity

Join MaxAccelerate and take technical ownership of the platforms that organisations depend on to manage their critical assets. We are looking for an experienced IBM Maximo Infrastructure Architect to lead complete Maximo Application Suite 9 implementations for clients around the world.

You will work across multiple client engagements and industry verticals through our nearshore delivery model, combining architecture leadership with hands-on installation and engineering. Alongside client delivery, you will contribute to MaxAccelerate AI, helping build the infrastructure and integrations that support AI-enabled asset management.

This is a fully remote role with the opportunity to work from our Dubai offices, planned to open in 2027. It is a chance to broaden your international project experience, influence our technical standards and help shape how Maximo and AI work together.

What you will do

Lead complete MAS 9 implementations. Own infrastructure discovery, architecture, sizing, prerequisite validation, installation, configuration, testing, production go-live and operational handover.

Design and build the platform. Deliver secure, resilient MAS 9 environments on Red Hat OpenShift across IBM Cloud, Microsoft Azure, AWS, private cloud and on-premises deployments.

Deploy the applications clients need. Install and configure MAS core, Maximo Manage and relevant applications, industry solutions and add-ons, working with functional and application specialists.

Deliver upgrades and migrations. Plan environment readiness, migration rehearsals, cutover, rollback and post-go-live support for clients moving from legacy Maximo or earlier MAS releases.

Engineer for reliable operations. Design and validate high availability, backup, restoration and disaster recovery. Use Prometheus and Grafana to establish monitoring, performance baselines and capacity plans.

Automate delivery. Use IBM MAS CLI, Ansible, Terraform and OpenShift Pipelines/Tekton to create repeatable builds and controlled deployment workflows.

Work directly with global clients. Lead technical workshops, explain design decisions, manage infrastructure dependencies and produce clear architecture documents and runbooks.

Contribute to MaxAccelerate AI. Work with AI and data specialists on secure hosting, connectivity and integration between Maximo environments, enterprise data and AI applications.

Strengthen our delivery team. Troubleshoot complex issues, mentor engineers and share practical lessons across international projects.

Essential experience

Proven full end-to-end MAS 9 installation experience. You must have personally led or delivered complete production implementations, from infrastructure preparation through go-live and handover.

Delivery across multiple industry verticals. Demonstrable Maximo/MAS experience in different sectors, such as energy and utilities, renewables, rail and transport, manufacturing, aviation, oil and gas, or facilities management.

Strong Red Hat OpenShift expertise. Hands-on experience with the oc CLI, operators, containers, persistent storage, networking, certificates, security and platform troubleshooting.

Enterprise infrastructure knowledge. Strong Linux skills and experience with DNS, load balancing, TLS, identity integration and access control.

Cloud and deployment architecture. Experience designing and delivering Maximo/MAS infrastructure across IBM Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including networking, storage, security, availability and hybrid connectivity.

Database platforms and SQL. Hands-on experience with IBM Db2, Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server for Maximo Manage, including connectivity, SQL troubleshooting and migrations. Work with database teams on performance, backup and recovery, using configurations supported by the selected release.

Apache Kafka. Experience deploying, configuring, securing and monitoring Kafka for Maximo integrations and event streaming, including brokers, topics and connectivity, where required by the solution architecture.

Production delivery discipline. Experience with release-specific compatibility checks, upgrades, performance tuning, recovery testing and technical documentation.

Confident client communication. Ability to lead technical discussions, explain trade-offs and collaborate with security, cloud, database and Maximo application teams.

Effective remote working. Ability to manage priorities across client engagements and work with agreed time-zone overlap for international delivery.

DevOps tools and platforms

Strong MAS automation and OpenShift skills are essential. The wider toolset will vary by client project.

MAS automation. IBM MAS CLI and Ansible, including the ibm.mas_devops collection, with experience running and troubleshooting OpenShift Pipelines/Tekton.

Infrastructure as code and scripting. Terraform, YAML and Bash or Python for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operational tasks.

Version control and CI/CD. Git and one or more of Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD or Azure DevOps for controlled changes and deployment pipelines.

Container tooling. OpenShift oc, Podman or Docker, and image registries such as Red Hat Quay.

GitOps and configuration. Argo CD/OpenShift GitOps experience is valuable; familiarity with Helm and Kustomize is advantageous.

Monitoring and alerting. Prometheus and Grafana for infrastructure and application metrics, dashboards and operational alerts.

Additional experience we value

Deployment of Maximo industry solutions, Mobile or other MAS applications.

AI infrastructure, private model hosting, data platforms or secure enterprise integrations.

Relevant IBM Maximo, Red Hat OpenShift or cloud certifications.

Consulting, managed services or nearshore delivery experience.

Fully remote working. Contribute to international projects from your remote working location.

Variety and technical ownership. Work with different clients and industries, taking projects from architecture through successful delivery.

A role in our AI work. Help develop the infrastructure behind MaxAccelerate AI and its connection to enterprise asset management.
